Job Category: Business Operations / Strategy

Job Level: Individual Contributor

Business Unit: Energy Delivery

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Location: Dublin

Department Overview

Electric Operations ensures the delivery of clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy to nearly 16 million people in Northern and Central California. The Electric Operations Team is responsible for ensuring the electric grid's reliability and resiliency through the ongoing maintenance and operations of PG&E's 100,000 miles of distribution lines and over 18,000 miles of Transmission lines. Coworkers in Electric Operations actively engage in the Lean Methodology through the use of visual management in operating reviews to cross-functionally identify and solve problems, and create standard work. By working together as One Electric. One Team. We are delivering for our hometowns. Electric Operations is comprised of approximately 6,500 coworkers.

Position Summary

The Operations Data Analyst extracts operations data for analysis, leadership support and responses to ad hoc data requests. The incumbent maintains operations tools & databases ensuring that it is kept up-to-date using data from various PG&E systems. They develop, maintain and enhance operational metric database tools for the broader analytics team(s). The Analyst identifies and solves current gaps in data requirements and ease of access to ensure fast and consistent responses to leadership inquiries.


PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Manages data management projects from initial request to presenting data results ensuring that the project is completed within budget and on-time.
DATA PROCESSING: Creates automated data routines and processes for reporting and data delivery ensuring accurate data manipulation and data cleansing.
DATA EXTRACTS AND FILE TRANSFERS: Manages extracting data and transferring the data from databases to various analysts to support operational analysis efforts.
DATA ANALYSIS: Analyzes data using various statistical tools to develop ad hoc reports, statistics, trends and profiles.
REPORTING: Develops and communicates clear, concise and actionable data analyses for clients


This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. The assigned work location will be within the PG&E Service Territory. Position will require an in office presence 1-2 days a week in Dublin.

PG&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors.

Bay Minimum: $126,000

Bay Maximum: $200,000

&/OR

CA Minimum: $120,000

CA Maximum: $190,000

This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

Job Responsibilities


Manages complex data analysis projects with limited supervision on only the most complex projects from initial request to presenting data results ensuring that the project is completed within budget and on-time.
Designs data analysis to achieve business objectives, process data, analyze data, write clear and concise data findings and tailor communications to specific audiences. Creates automated data routines and processes for reporting and data delivery ensuring accurate data manipulation and data cleansing.
Manages very complex data extracts and list pulls ensuring data accuracy. Manages extracting data and transferring the data from databases to various analysts to support operational analysis efforts

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You And The Role

Zipline is building an autonomous delivery system that moves medical supplies, food, and retail products where people need them. As Platform 2 scales, Marketing, Commercial, and Growth teams need a shared, trusted view of customer behavior, commercial performance, and where to focus investment. As an embedded partner within the centralized Data Science & Analytics team, you will own the measurement, analysis, and reporting that moves those questions into business action. You will help leaders prioritize campaigns, commercial opportunities, and growth initiatives while building durable performance visibility for a growing autonomous delivery business.

What You'll Do


Own analyses of customer behavior, commercial performance, market dynamics, and Platform 2 growth opportunities.
Define KPI frameworks and metric definitions that give Marketing, Commercial, and Growth teams a consistent view of progress against strategic priorities.
Build and maintain business-facing dashboards and self-service reporting that stakeholders use to assess performance and plan action.
Translate analysis into recommendations that inform campaign investment, commercial prioritization, growth initiatives, and strategic tradeoffs.
Monitor performance to identify material trends, risks, and opportunities requiring a decision or change in business approach. - Partner with Data Science, Product, and business teams to improve data quality, reporting capabilities, and analytical processes.
Use AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring reporting and analysis, reducing manual work and improving the speed of insight delivery.



What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence work in analytics, operations, technology, logistics, eCommerce, or a related environment. - Advanced SQL proficiency and experience querying complex relational datasets.
Experience building business-facing dashboards in Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or a similar platform.
Familiarity with data warehouses such as Snowflake or Redshift and a scripting language such as Python.
Ability to turn ambiguous commercial or growth questions into rigorous analyses, clear measurement approaches, and actionable recommendations.
Strong communication and business judgment, with evidence of helping technical and non-technical stakeholders act on data.
Experience using AI tools to automate analytical workflows or recurring reporting, plus a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or related field.



What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $110,000 - $135,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

Title: Client Reporting Analyst
Description:
Client Reporting Technical Analyst

We’re looking for a technically strong Client Reporting Technical Analyst to support the technology and data behind end-to-end client reporting within a financial services environment. This role will own the flow of reporting data from upstream systems and pipelines through final report generation and distribution, with a strong focus on SQL, data quality, reporting platforms, and production support.




What You’ll Be Doing

Support the end-to-end client reporting workflow, including data sourcing, transformation, report generation, and distribution.
Troubleshoot production reporting incidents, data anomalies, pipeline failures, and delivery exceptions.
Use SQL to query and analyze complex datasets and identify root causes of reporting issues.
Support data pipelines and understand upstream/downstream dependencies, transformations, schemas, and data lineage.
Translate business reporting requirements into technical data and platform specifications.
Support reporting platform upgrades, integrations, UAT, and other SDLC activities.
Maintain data lineage, metadata, data dictionaries, and reporting documentation.
Manage reporting enhancements, automation opportunities, and data quality improvements.
Support ad hoc data analysis for client deliverables, regulatory reporting, and business initiatives.

What We’re Looking For

3–7 years of financial services experience, ideally within a buy-side asset management environment.
Experience supporting client reporting, investment operations, or investment data.
Strong hands-on SQL skills.
Experience with client reporting platforms such as Seismic, Vermilion, or similar tools.
Understanding of data pipelines, ingestion, transformation logic, data warehouses, and table/schema structures.
Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouse environments preferred.
Experience with Eagle PACE, Eagle SRM, or comparable fund accounting/security master platforms strongly preferred.
Familiarity with investment data including performance, holdings, and characteristics.
Experience with data governance tools such as Ataccama or Collibra is a plus.
Python or similar scripting/automation experience preferred.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently trace and resolve complex data issues.
Bachelor’s degree required.




This is a great opportunity for someone who understands both the technical data environment and the investment/client reporting lifecycle and enjoys owning problems from initial investigation through resolution.

Title: Data Analyst, Product Analytics
Description:
Grow Therapy is on a mission to serve as the trusted partner for therapists growing their practice, and patients accessing high-quality care. Powered by technology, we are a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. Following the mass increase in depression and anxiety, the need for accessibility is more important than ever. To make our vision for mental healthcare a reality, we’re building a team of entrepreneurs and mission-driven go-getters. Since launching in February 2021, we’ve empowered more than ten thousand therapists and hundreds of thousands of clients across the country and insurance landscape. We’ve raised more than $328Mm in funding, including our Series D, at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Data Analyst to help us drive data-driven insights and reporting in Product at Grow Therapy, and who will work on a variety of reporting, analytics and experimentation projects. You’ll join a broader data organization of analysts, data scientists, and data engineers, and be part of an Analytics team reporting into an Analytics Manager. This role will support our Lives Covered product group.

What You’ll Be Doing


Partner with Product and other technical stakeholders to prioritize analytical needs and support product launches, decision-making, and ad hoc requests through clear, data-driven insights
Develop, maintain, and evolve core product and performance reporting, including business-critical dashboards built on scalable, reliable datasets
Support experimentation and A/B testing through thoughtful design, execution, analysis, and clear, actionable conclusions
Create compelling data visualizations and storytelling assets to effectively communicate insights to diverse audiences
Collaborate with senior and staff analysts on complex, high-impact analytical projects, including data modeling and OKR development
Work closely with data scientists and data engineers to improve data availability, integrity, accuracy, reliability, and logging/pipeline quality


You’ll Be a Good Fit If


You have 3+ years proven experience in using analytics to tackle business problems that cross multiple product/project areas and teams, ideally in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
You have strong SQL skills and intermediate understanding of experimental design (such as A/B experiments).
You are a wizard at building business critical dashboards/data visualizations (ideally within Hex or Looker, with strong LookML expertise)
You have experience with data modeling (dbt) or are eager to learn
You love data storytelling, creating a compelling narrative by extracting insights from data, and summarizing learnings / takeaways for executives.
You enjoy communicating effectively and building relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You deeply value the importance of expanding access to mental health care.


Employment Type: Full Time, Exempt

Base Compensation: The base compensation range for this position is $124,000–$145,800 USD Annually.

This is a hybrid role with the expectation to work onsite from our San Francisco / Seattle / New York hub location three days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday) and travel 2–3 times per year (e.g., company and department offsites).

The base compensation for this role will vary depending on several factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, and the candidate’s working location.

Grow for Grow: No cost access to therapy through the Grow platform (available to US employees)

Parental Leave: Up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave to support you and your growing family and a new child stipend.

Commuter Benefits: Pre tax commuter benefits to support teammates working from one of our hub locations.

Title: Data Analyst, In-Store
Description:
About The Team

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. Within the team, our product-focused analytics work owns the funnels, personas, and feature-adoption insights that inform what products and features get built, how it's launched, and how it performs in the market.

About The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…


Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.
Build net new data products aimed at improving analytic and reporting capabilities
Partner with Product Managers and Product Marketers on pre-launch hypotheses , beta testing results, post-launch measurement, and ongoing optimization.
Design and ship PLG automations that translate product behavior into opportunity tagging, expansion signals, and CSM workflows.
Apply GenAI and ML techniques — partnering with our GTM Engineer — to product analytics use cases like web-sourced feature adoption opportunities, transactions predictive modeling, and Add-On ICP scoring.
Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis


We're Excited About You Because…


A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
2+ years of experience analyzing product data and partnering with Product Management teams in a SaaS environment.
Expert SQL skills and proficiency with a cloud BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode.
Hands-on experience with product instrumentation and analytics platforms such as Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Heap.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product questions into rigorous, scoped analyses that ship recommendations — not just dashboards.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to product and executive audiences.


Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

This team has real say in what gets built.

You will be the analytical partner to our Sales and account teams — someone who can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Build the tools and analytics sales leaders use to grow their accounts — pacing views, account-health signals, territory and segment views that change what a rep or manager does next
Field requests from Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, leadership, and external stakeholders, and decide what's worth building, what's worth a sharp piece of analysis, and what's out of scope

Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Contribute to the internal tools and semantic layer — prompts, context, and guardrails — that let stakeholders query B2B data in natural language and trust what comes back
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences

Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally supporting a sales, go-to-market, or B2B organization
Proficiency in SQL — able to read, write, and review structured, efficient queries on large data sets, whether you wrote them yourself or an AI coding assistant did; you own the correctness of every query and result before it reaches stakeholders
Experience building production data assets — pipelines, data models, or orchestrated tables (Airflow, dbt, or similar) — not only ad-hoc analysis
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Hex, Mode, or similar
Experience with sales or account analytics — pipeline, bookings, pacing to target, account segmentation — is a strong plus
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Commercial instinct paired with a builder's instinct — a track record of turning a recurring request into a durable tool or dataset instead of answering it one more time
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion

Responsible for redefining hospitality at Graton Resort & Casino while living, supporting, and promoting our values.

Title: P2P Data & Automation Analyst
Description:
GAQ327R181

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

Databricks is executing a multi-year Procure-to-Pay transformation spanning an expense management platform migration, the BrickBuy enterprise procurement portal, a managed services onboarding, and policy and process redesign initiatives. This role sits embedded within Procurement — not in a central IT or analytics function — and operates in accordance with the Finance Data Strategy governance framework to drive rapid P2P process transformation by designing, deploying, and scaling automation and data solutions directly within business workflows.

This is a builder role for someone who wants to own outcomes, not tickets: the person will sit inside the processes they are automating, ship working solutions in weeks rather than quarters, and carry them through adoption — pairing hands-on technical delivery with the change management discipline needed to make new ways of working stick.

The Impact You Will Have


Business process ownership. Own designated P2P sub-processes end to end — intake-to-PO, invoice exception handling, supplier onboarding, expense workflows — including process mapping, baseline metrics (cycle time, touch rates, exception volumes), and redesign. Act as the recognized process owner who is accountable for how the process performs, not just how it is documented.
Requirements & solution design. Translate pain points raised by requesters, approvers, buyers, and AP into structured requirements and solution designs. Work within the Finance Data Strategy governance framework for data definitions, source-of-truth alignment, access controls, and quality standards — solutions must tie to certified Finance data, not shadow datasets.
Embedded automation. Design, deploy, and scale automations directly within business workflows and the systems where work actually happens (ZIP, SAP, NetSuite, expense platform, BrickBuy) — including AI/LLM-assisted triage, auto-routing, data enrichment, exception auto-resolution, and notification/nudge logic. Build in production-adjacent environments with appropriate guardrails rather than standalone tools users must remember to visit.
Rapid iteration. Operate on a ship-measure-iterate cadence: release minimum viable automations in weeks, instrument them from day one, and refine based on usage data and user feedback. Maintain sandbox-to-production discipline consistent with Finance Data Strategy and SOX/control requirements.
Data & measurement. Build and maintain the P2P datasets, dashboards, and metrics that the transformation runs on — cycle time, Fast Pass performance, first-pass yield, policy compliance, automation coverage, and adoption rates — and report against them in existing operating rhythms (e.g., quarterly business reviews), with numbers that tie across reports and to source data.
User adoption & change management. Own the adoption of what you build. Design role-based training and enablement for affected requesters, approvers, and P2P operations staff; produce launch communications, FAQ/help content, and go-live announcements in a style consistent with executive reporting norms (concise, structured, blockers called out explicitly); run feedback loops with change champions across subsidiaries; and actively identify and mitigate resistance rather than assuming usage will follow deployment.
Day-to-day prioritization. Run the intake and backlog for automation and data requests across Procurement: triage incoming asks, prioritize by value, effort, and risk, publish a visible roadmap, and make defensible trade-off calls daily — protecting capacity for transformation priorities while handling operational requests.
Stakeholder engagement. Partner closely with Procurement operations, the Finance Data team, the CIO org, and managed services partners; represent Procurement in Finance Data Strategy governance forums; and ensure automation work lands coherently alongside parallel workstreams (expense platform migration, BrickBuy rollout, Global Procurement Policy adoption, managed services transition).


What We Look For


4–8 years in data analytics, process automation, or operations roles within P2P, procurement, or finance — with demonstrable examples of automations or data products you built, shipped, and scaled yourself.
Hands-on technical skills: SQL and Python (or equivalent), workflow and integration tooling (iPaaS, RPA, or native platform automation), and dashboarding/BI. Experience building on the Databricks platform and applying LLM/AI tooling to business workflows is a strong plus.
Working knowledge of P2P systems and data — ERP (SAP or NetSuite), procurement intake/orchestration platforms (ZIP or similar), and expense management tools — including how transactions, approvals, and master data flow between them.
Experience operating within a data governance framework: certified data sources, data quality standards, access controls, and audit/SOX considerations — comfortable moving fast without going around governance.
Change management fluency: track record of driving adoption of new tools or processes through training, communications, champion networks, and adoption metrics — not just deploying and moving on.
Strong prioritization judgment and stakeholder management: able to run a busy intake, say no with a rationale, and communicate crisply to audiences from frontline requesters to executives.
Experience in a high-growth, multi-entity organization (multiple subsidiaries/geographies) is a plus; formal change management certification (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent) or process improvement certification (Lean/Six Sigma) preferred but not required.

Databricks is executing a multi-year Procure-to-Pay transformation spanning an expense management platform migration, the BrickBuy enterprise procurement portal, a managed services onboarding, and policy and process redesign initiatives. This role sits embedded within Procurement — not in a central IT or analytics function — and operates in accordance with the Finance Data Strategy governance framework to drive rapid P2P process transformation by designing, deploying, and scaling automation and data solutions directly within business workflows.

This is a builder role for someone who wants to own outcomes, not tickets: the person will sit inside the processes they are automating, ship working solutions in weeks rather than quarters, and carry them through adoption — pairing hands-on technical delivery with the change management discipline needed to make new ways of working stick.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Business process ownership. Own designated P2P sub-processes end to end — intake-to-PO, invoice exception handling, supplier onboarding, expense workflows — including process mapping, baseline metrics (cycle time, touch rates, exception volumes), and redesign. Act as the recognized process owner who is accountable for how the process performs, not just how it is documented.
  • Requirements & solution design. Translate pain points raised by requesters, approvers, buyers, and AP into structured requirements and solution designs. Work within the Finance Data Strategy governance framework for data definitions, source-of-truth alignment, access controls, and quality standards — solutions must tie to certified Finance data, not shadow datasets.
  • Embedded automation. Design, deploy, and scale automations directly within business workflows and the systems where work actually happens (ZIP, SAP, NetSuite, expense platform, BrickBuy) — including AI/LLM-assisted triage, auto-routing, data enrichment, exception auto-resolution, and notification/nudge logic. Build in production-adjacent environments with appropriate guardrails rather than standalone tools users must remember to visit.
  • Rapid iteration. Operate on a ship-measure-iterate cadence: release minimum viable automations in weeks, instrument them from day one, and refine based on usage data and user feedback. Maintain sandbox-to-production discipline consistent with Finance Data Strategy and SOX/control requirements.
  • Data & measurement. Build and maintain the P2P datasets, dashboards, and metrics that the transformation runs on — cycle time, Fast Pass performance, first-pass yield, policy compliance, automation coverage, and adoption rates — and report against them in existing operating rhythms (e.g., quarterly business reviews), with numbers that tie across reports and to source data.
  • User adoption & change management. Own the adoption of what you build. Design role-based training and enablement for affected requesters, approvers, and P2P operations staff; produce launch communications, FAQ/help content, and go-live announcements in a style consistent with executive reporting norms (concise, structured, blockers called out explicitly); run feedback loops with change champions across subsidiaries; and actively identify and mitigate resistance rather than assuming usage will follow deployment.
  • Day-to-day prioritization. Run the intake and backlog for automation and data requests across Procurement: triage incoming asks, prioritize by value, effort, and risk, publish a visible roadmap, and make defensible trade-off calls daily — protecting capacity for transformation priorities while handling operational requests.
  • Stakeholder engagement. Partner closely with Procurement operations, the Finance Data team, the CIO org, and managed services partners; represent Procurement in Finance Data Strategy governance forums; and ensure automation work lands coherently alongside parallel workstreams (expense platform migration, BrickBuy rollout, Global Procurement Policy adoption, managed services transition).

What We Look For

  • 4–8 years in data analytics, process automation, or operations roles within P2P, procurement, or finance — with demonstrable examples of automations or data products you built, shipped, and scaled yourself.
  • Hands-on technical skills: SQL and Python (or equivalent), workflow and integration tooling (iPaaS, RPA, or native platform automation), and dashboarding/BI. Experience building on the Databricks platform and applying LLM/AI tooling to business workflows is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of P2P systems and data — ERP (SAP or NetSuite), procurement intake/orchestration platforms (ZIP or similar), and expense management tools — including how transactions, approvals, and master data flow between them.
  • Experience operating within a data governance framework: certified data sources, data quality standards, access controls, and audit/SOX considerations — comfortable moving fast without going around governance.
  • Change management fluency: track record of driving adoption of new tools or processes through training, communications, champion networks, and adoption metrics — not just deploying and moving on.
  • Strong prioritization judgment and stakeholder management: able to run a busy intake, say no with a rationale, and communicate crisply to audiences from frontline requesters to executives.
  • Experience in a high-growth, multi-entity organization (multiple subsidiaries/geographies) is a plus; formal change management certification (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent) or process improvement certification (Lean/Six Sigma) preferred but not required.

Description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. Our mission is simple: to make really high quality essentials for really low prices, produced fairly and sustainably. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.

Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:


Customer First: We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.
High Quality: True quality means premium materials and rigorous production standards you can feel good about.
Essential Design: We focus on timeless, functional essentials instead of chasing trends.
Always a Better Deal: Innovation and transparency ensure value for both customers and partners.
Social & Environmental Responsibility: We commit to sustainable materials, ethical production, and fair wages.


Quince partners with world-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

OUR TEAM AND SUCCESS

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.

If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.

Staff Data Analyst

Our Story

Quince was founded to challenge the idea that exceptional quality must come with an exceptional price tag. Our mission is simple: create products that match or exceed the quality of leading luxury brands and offer them at radically lower prices.

Our Values

Everyone Should Be Able to Afford Nice Things

Quality shouldn't be a luxury. We are committed to making the world's highest-quality products accessible at affordable prices.

Quality Is More Than Materials

True quality comes from both premium materials and exceptional craftsmanship.

We Focus on the Essentials

From the perfect cashmere sweater to hotel-quality bedding, we create thoughtfully designed essentials that elevate everyday life.

We're Innovating to Make Unreal Prices a Reality

Our factory-direct model eliminates unnecessary markups, allowing us to deliver exceptional products at unmatched value.

Always a Better Deal

We believe in radical price transparency for both our customers and manufacturing partners, creating better outcomes for everyone.

Fair Factories

We partner with factories that meet rigorous global standards for workplace safety, ethical practices, and wage fairness.

Our Team

Quince is a retail and technology company founded by leaders with deep experience across retail, technology, and high-growth startups. You'll work alongside exceptional talent from organizations including Stanford GSB, Wish, D.E. Shaw, Stitch Fix, Urban Outfitters, Wayfair, McKinsey, Nike, and many others.

The Opportunity

Quince is seeking a talented and highly analytical individual to join our Growth organization. In this role, you will own measurement and analytics across our growth marketing channels, helping the team make faster, smarter, and more effective investment decisions.

You will develop and maintain attribution frameworks, incrementality testing programs, and performance measurement systems to understand what drives customer acquisition and where marketing dollars generate the greatest return. Over time, you will become a trusted expert on growth performance across the Quince platform, partnering closely with marketing leadership to surface insights, run experiments, and build scalable analytics capabilities that support the company's rapid growth.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a highly analytical problem solver who is excited about using data, technology, and experimentation to drive business growth. You thrive in fast-paced environments where ambiguity is common and answers are not always readily available.

You are energized by ownership, move quickly without sacrificing rigor, and enjoy working in a culture that values data-driven decision-making, intellectual curiosity, and high standards. You are comfortable collaborating across functions and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Responsibilities


Own marketing attribution and measurement frameworks across growth channels, including paid search, paid social, affiliate, and other acquisition programs
Design, execute, and analyze incrementality tests and experimentation programs to measure causal marketing impact
Build and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly performance reporting for growth marketing and company leadership
Develop automated monitoring systems to ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, and timely insights
Create scalable analytics tools and processes that accelerate decision-making across the Growth team
Partner closely with marketing leadership to translate data into actionable channel, audience, and budget recommendations
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify growth opportunities, diagnose performance changes, and uncover key business drivers
Apply statistical and predictive modeling techniques to improve marketing efficiency and performance
Support advanced measurement initiatives, including marketing mix modeling (MMM), attribution modeling, and forecasting
Partner cross-functionally with Data, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to improve measurement infrastructure and business understanding
Preferred: Support app measurement and mobile attribution initiatives


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
5–7 years of experience in analytics, data science, or quantitative business roles, preferably focused on growth marketing, ecommerce, or performance marketing
Hands-on experience building attribution models and designing incrementality or experimental measurement frameworks
Demonstrated ability to independently scope, execute, and communicate complex analyses that drive measurable business impact
Advanced SQL skills and strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, modeling, and automation
Familiarity with major advertising platforms and measurement ecosystems, including Meta, Google, TikTok, and similar channels
Experience applying statistical methods and predictive modeling to business problems; experience with marketing mix modeling is a plus
Strong understanding of experimentation design, causal inference, and marketing measurement best practices
Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to improve productivity, analysis, and insight generation
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and non-technical audiences
Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple high-impact initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Strong sense of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to delivering exceptional results


All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Title: Product Analyst
Description:
About Finch

We are on a mission to revolutionize employment by building the infrastructure that powers every facet of work . To do this, we're looking for individuals who think about problems holistically and in-depth, who are relentlessly curious, self-starters, and determined to drive ideas from inception through to completion.

Finch is a Series B company backed by a fantastic set of firms, angels, and our developers including General Catalyst, Menlo Ventures, Homebrew, BoxGroup, YCombinator, Charley (1st business hire at Plaid), Sima (ex-Head of Biz Dev at Plaid), Henrique + Pedro (co-CEOs at Brex), Jeff + Wayne (co-CEOs at Digits), Immad (CEO at Mercury), Sam (CEO at Vouch Insurance), Karim (CTO at Ramp), and more.

About Our Team

We're a team of problem solvers who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We value velocity, curiosity, empathy, and diverse perspectives. Everyone on the team is excited about the scope of the problems we address and the potential impact our work can have on the global workforce. We realize that the value we provide comes with great responsibilities, and therefore make security and privacy our highest priorities.

We come from a diverse set of backgrounds and each member brings different skills to the group. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and potential will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns.

About The Role

We're looking for a data-driven Product Analyst to support SLA monitoring and tracking, provider expansion, and automation initiatives. This role owns operational workflows end-to-end with a strong emphasis on metrics, tracking, and identifying where processes are off track. This individual will partner closely with product, integrations, and engineering to move work from manual support toward scalable automation.

What You'll Do

Operational Analytics & Reporting


Monitor SLAs and operational performance across multiple product workflows, flagging misses or anomalies as they emerge
Investigate root causes behind performance issues and process breakdowns
Build and maintain actionable reporting and dashboards that surface where processes are on or off track
Own operational workflows end-to-end, with clear visibility into status, bottlenecks, and outcomes


Provider & Connection Lifecycle Management


Help drive the full lifecycle of new provider/connection work, including intake, data mapping, cross-team coordination, parallel run support, and handoff toward automation
Act as a key point of coordination across the stages of provider expansion, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner closely with product, integrations, engineering, and operations teams to identify opportunities to move workflows from manual support to scalable automation
Communicate progress, blockers, and risks clearly to stakeholders across functions


Independent Execution


Independently run with ambiguous or evolving problems, owning ongoing processes without heavy oversight
Set a high bar for execution, both in terms of quality and speed
Drive follow-through on initiatives from identification through resolution


What You'll Bring


Data-driven, analytical, and operationally minded, with a track record of using metrics to identify and resolve process issues
Comfortable working in ambiguous, evolving processes where the path isn't always fully defined
Strong reporting and analytics skills, with experience building and interpreting operational metrics
Proven experience handling structured data (Excel, CSV, JSON, etc.)
Comfortable working in process-heavy, operational environments with multiple moving parts
Able to independently manage and set clear deadlines across multiple simultaneous projects
Strong written communication skills and ability to clearly document processes so they can be optimized over time
Comfortable coordinating with multiple parties and building relationships both internally and externally
Comfortable working with SQL to locate the right data sources, join tables, and build dashboards you can verify and trust — 1+ years of experience working across multiple datasets preferred.
Working knowledge of Python for data analysis, scripting, or automation
2–4 years of experience in business operations, product operations, business/data analysis, or a related analytical role at a financial, tech, or fintech company.


Success Looks Like


Familiarity working with payroll/HR systems or retirement
Experience in a technical support, product operations, or business analyst role — preferably with an API-based or hyper-process-oriented product
Experience building dashboards and tracking metrics in tools like Sigma
Familiarity with Snowflake or other cloud data warehouses
Comfortable digging through logs (e.g., Datadog) to help investigate operational or technical issues.


What We Offer


Competitive equity with a 10-year exercise window
Full medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% for employees, 85% for dependents)
Unlimited PTO (with a 3-week minimum)
401(k) plan
Regular team offsites and meetups
Hybrid work: 2+ days/week in our SF Office


$80,000 - $86,000 a year

Finch’s compensation package includes a competitive base salary benchmarked against real-time market data, as well as equity for all full-time roles. We want all full-time employees to be invested in Finch and to be able to take advantage of that investment, so our equity grants include a 10-year exercise window.

We also offer exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum salary range for this role is: $80,000 - $86,000.

Title: Strategic Operations Analyst
Description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About The Role

The Strategic Operations team serves as the internal operating system for Zipline's global operations organization. We partner across Maintenance, Fulfillment, Flight Test, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Commercial Operations to solve complex operational problems, build scalable systems, and enable data-driven decision making.

As a Strategic Operations Analyst, you'll work on some of the highest-priority operational challenges at Zipline. One week you may be building executive metrics that shape fleet strategy; the next you could be standing in a maintenance hub conducting time studies, designing a new operational process, or building an internal software tool that saves hundreds of hours across the organization.

This is not a traditional analytics role. Success requires curiosity, technical depth, and the ability to move seamlessly between data analysis, software development, process design, and operational execution.

You'll own ambiguous problems from end to end—understanding how work happens today, identifying opportunities for improvement, building solutions, and measuring their impact.

What You’ll Do


Partner directly with leaders across Strategic Operations, Maintenance, Fulfillment, Flight Test, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Commercial Operations to solve high-impact operational challenges.
Build analytical models and metrics that provide visibility into fleet health, operational performance, cost, quality, and reliability.
Design scalable operating mechanisms including processes, workflows, documentation, and decision frameworks.
Develop internal software tools, dashboards, and automations that eliminate manual work and improve operational efficiency.
Design new methods for collecting operational data where none exists, including field observations, time studies, surveys, and instrumentation.
Investigate complex operational problems by combining quantitative analysis with direct observation in production and commercial environments.
Lead cross-functional projects from problem definition through implementation and measurement.
Communicate findings and recommendations to executive leadership through clear visualizations, written narratives, and presentations.
Travel up to 20% to commercial sites, manufacturing facilities, and flight test locations to understand operations firsthand and validate solutions.



Required

What You’ll Bring


Strong analytical skills with experience using SQL to analyze large datasets.
Experience using Python, R, or similar languages to automate analyses, build tools, or solve operational problems.
Experience designing metrics, dashboards, and reporting systems that influence business decisions.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and independently drive them to completion.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear business recommendations.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively across technical and operational teams.
High ownership, strong organizational skills, and a bias toward action.
Willingness to travel approximately 20%.



Preferred


Experience building internal software applications, workflow automation tools, or operational systems.
Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Mode, ThoughtSpot, Looker, or Power BI.
Experience in logistics, manufacturing, aviation, robotics, supply chain, or another operationally intensive environment.
Experience with experimentation, statistical analysis, forecasting, or optimization.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, or a related quantitative field.



What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $130,000-$170,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other characteristics protected by state, federal or local law or our other policies.

Please Note

We have received reports stating that certain individuals are reaching out to people under false pretenses, claiming to be Zipline employees, affiliates, agents, or representatives. They may seek to gain access to your personal information or to acquire money from you by offering fictitious employment opportunities or by claiming that they are contacting you on Zipline’s behalf.

Genuine Zipline employees or representatives will never ask you for money or payment in exchange for employment opportunities or other related services. Any such offer of employment or any other service in exchange for fees that claims to be from us is deceitful and part of a fraud.

Voluntary Self-Identification

For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst, Security Analytics
Description:
About Us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

About The Role

As our security programme grows, we need a scalable way to measure control effectiveness, automate evidence collection, and provide continuous visibility into our security posture.

As our Security Analyst, you’ll join the Security team and build the data and automation capabilities that underpin our security programme. You’ll work across Security to design scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and automations that transform security data into insights that inform decision making. Your work will enable better operational decision making, reduce manual effort, and strengthen our ability to support customer, auditor, and regulatory commitments.

You’ll help make security governance continuous. You’ll partner with Security Engineering, IT, and Engineering teams to automate evidence collection, measure control effectiveness, and establish the foundations for a data-driven security programme.

This is a rare opportunity to build Wayve’s security analytics capability from the ground up. You’ll define the architecture, data models, and automations that become the foundation for how we measure and improve security.

We’d love to hear from you if you’re motivated by replacing manual processes with scalable engineering solutions and believe security data should be automated, continuously available, and actionable.

Key responsibilities Build our security data platform


Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that collect, transform, and enrich security data from systems across our business.
Integrate data from identity, cloud, engineering, and security platforms to create a unified view of Wayve’s security posture.
Build robust data models that provide high fidelity datasets for security analytics, operational reporting, and measuring control effectiveness.
Design analytics products and visualisations that provide meaningful insights into the health, maturity, and performance of the security programme.
Ensure data quality, lineage, reliability, observability, and maintainability across our security analytics platform.


Drive automation and continuous assurance


Build automated evidence collection capabilities that reduce manual effort across governance, customer assurance, and security operations.
Develop analytics that support continuous control monitoring and demonstrate control effectiveness through measurable outcomes.
Partner with stakeholders across Security to translate security controls into measurable, automated indicators where practical.
Design and implement automation that replaces repetitive operational processes with scalable engineering solutions.


Enable data-driven security decisions


Partner with SMEs to develop meaningful KPIs and metrics that help Security understand performance, risk, trends, and operational health.
Work with stakeholders across Security to understand analytical requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Continuously improve how security data is collected, modeled, and consumed across the organisation.


About you Essential


Experience designing and operating reliable data platforms or analytics engineering solutions in production environments.
Experience building production-quality data pipelines and automation using Python, SQL, or similar technologies.
Experience modeling data for analytical use cases.
Strong understanding of modern data engineering practices, including data modeling, ETL/ELT, API integrations, data quality, and observability.
Experience working in cloud-native environments and integrating data from cloud platforms and SaaS sources.
Experience building integrations and automation using APIs rather than relying solely on out-of-the-box platform capabilities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights.
Experience designing dashboards and metrics that support operational or business decision making.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across Security, Engineering, and other technical teams.


Desirable


Experience working within cybersecurity, security engineering, or security governance.
Awareness of security frameworks such as TISAX, ISO 27001, NIST CSF.
Experience measuring control effectiveness, building security metrics, or implementing continuous assurance capabilities.
Familiarity with security telemetry, identity systems, cloud platforms, endpoint security, or vulnerability management tooling.


What success looks like

During Your First Year You Will


Establish the foundations of Wayve’s security analytics and automation capability.
Establish security data pipelines that provide continuous visibility into the health and effectiveness of our security controls.
Deliver automated evidence collection for selected key security controls, significantly reducing manual effort across the Security organisation.
Develop KPIs, and metrics that enable Security to make data-driven decisions and clearly demonstrate control effectiveness.
Create reusable security data products and automation that become the foundation for reporting, continuous assurance, and operational excellence across the Security organisation.
Help transform the Security programme from periodic assessment to continuous measurement, providing timely, reliable insights that support its growth and maturity.


Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in our interview process, please let us know.

We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.

LOCATION: Remote

Who is IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)?

As a business unit of IDEX Corporation, IH&S has a long history of driving growth in life sciences and healthcare by embracing innovation and redefining the supplier-customer relationship. The work we do every day allows us to discover key insights and break new ground to create some of the most meaningful technologies that have a lasting impact on companies, industries, and society. IDEX Health & Science (IH&S)

Title: Data Analyst, Enterprise Data Governance Team
Description:
Job Details

Job Description:

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in transforming Intel's enterprise data ecosystem and enabling data-driven decision-making? As a Data Analyst on the Enterprise Data Governance Team, you will help improve Intel's business performance by applying data analysis, governance operations, process execution, and measurement practices to complex enterprise data challenges.

In addition to domain analytics responsibilities, this role serves as a key execution partner to EDGT. The role supports the operationalization of enterprise data governance decisions, standards, controls, and processes across one or more data domains. The role is expected to engage across multiple enterprise data domains over time to support consistent governance execution, adoption, and maturity.

This position acts as a bridge between business stakeholders, EDGT, domain owners, data stewards, architecture teams, platform teams, and development teams. The role translates governance decisions into executable actions, supports fit-gap and readiness assessments, manages governance work visibility, and helps ensure standards are adopted and sustained across the enterprise.

The role will also support Governance Operations, Platform, and JIRA responsibilities within the proposed EDGT capability-based model. This includes EDGT operations, JIRA/work tracking, tooling roadmap coordination, capacity visibility, operating rhythm support, templates, documentation, and process orchestration. A critical part of this role is the development and ongoing measurement of data governance metrics that help Intel track progress on its enterprise data governance journey during IAO and beyond. The successful candidate will help define, maintain, and improve governance KPIs, scorecards, maturity indicators, adoption measures, and value-realization metrics that show how governance is progressing across domains, where gaps remain, and where leadership attention is needed.

Key Responsibilities Include


Support execution and adoption of Enterprise-approved data governance standards, guidelines, controls, procedures, and decision frameworks.
Support Governance Operations, Platform, and JIRA activities, including work tracking, backlog visibility, status reporting, dependency tracking, capacity views, templates, and operating rhythm support.
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve data governance metrics, KPI frameworks, dashboards, scorecards, and maturity measures.
Track governance progress during IAO and ongoing enterprise transformation, including adoption of standards, data quality outcomes, stewardship engagement, metadata maturity, issue remediation, and governance value realization.
Provide executive-ready reporting and insights that show governance progress, risks, trends, gaps, and recommended actions.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities that drive business insights and operational improvements.
Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into actionable data specifications, governance requirements, and execution plans.
Perform fit-gap analyses, readiness assessments, and risk assessments of data systems, processes, and domains to evaluate alignment with EDGT-approved governance standards.
Serve as the day-to-day bridge between EDGT, domains, architecture, tooling, stewardship, and execution teams.
Partner with domain, architecture, platform, and business teams to translate governance decisions into sustained practices and measurable outcomes.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in a related field such as data science, information systems, supply chain, material science, industrial engineering, business analytics, or a related discipline.
3+ years of relevant experience in data governance, data quality, data processes, business analysis, operations, and technology-enabled process improvement.
Experience analyzing complex datasets and translating insights into business recommendations.
Experience working across business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements, document processes, clarify ownership, and support execution.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, metrics, or KPI measurements.
Experience with JIRA or similar work-management tools to track work items, owners, status, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to perform fit-gap analysis, readiness assessment, risk identification, or implementation support for data, process, or system changes.
Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, organization, and follow-through skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering, information systems, data science, business analytics, or a related field with 2+ years of relevant experience.
Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Python.
Experience with business intelligence, reporting, dashboarding, data visualization, and executive-level performance reporting.
Experience developing enterprise KPI frameworks, governance scorecards, maturity models, value-realization reporting, or adoption metrics.
Familiarity with data governance, master data management, metadata management, data lineage, data quality, data stewardship, or governance operating models.
Knowledge of Intel's Product Life Cycle, supply chain planning, manufacturing execution, product architecture, planning BOM, or dependent planning and execution processes.
Familiarity with tools such as Collibra, Informatica, JIRA, Confluence, SAP, LRP, Atlas, or related governance, workflow, and enterprise data platforms.
Ability to influence stakeholders, structure ambiguous work, drive execution, and communicate governance progress in a clear, measurable, business-focused way.

Title: IT Infrastructure Capacity Analyst
Description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate


Extreme ownership. Full autonomy. Own things end to end often taking on scope outside your core role without being asked to get things done.
Velocity. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
First principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.


Role Scope


Model IT and hardware capacity across the pipeline: what compute, network, and support gear each site needs and when.
Reconcile demand against orders, inventory, and lead times, and flag the gap before it hits a schedule.
Build the capacity views planning and procurement run on, refreshed automatically.
Chase discrepancies to ground: a miscounted rack now is a missed energization later.


What We're Looking For


The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.
You've done capacity, demand, or supply planning for hardware-heavy operations.
You've built models in SQL or spreadsheets that survived contact with messy source data.
You reconcile relentlessly: your numbers tie out or you know exactly why not.
You translate an analysis into an action: order now, shift that, escalate this.
You automate refreshes rather than rebuilding by hand.
Bonus: Data center or hardware supply chains. ERP data. Python. Forecasting methods.


We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application-- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

Compensation Range: $200K - $300K

The mission of this role will be to maximize the value of our advertising inventory through operational excellence and creative analytics. This role’s responsibilities will be to model the short and long term economic value of our ad products, identify new supply opportunities for our users, and scale our findings into actionable reports. The ideal candidate will enjoy working with numbers and identifying patterns and trends, and will be eager to develop skills in econometrics, user segmentation, process management, and product & business intelligence.

What You'll Do


Maximize the value of advertising inventory through manual and automated processes.
Design, execute, and analyze innovative pre/post and A/B tests to identify new opportunities.
Synthesize data into dashboards and reports using Excel, SQL, and Tableau.
Refine data processes, set up tools, and create automation to improve operational efficiency.

Assist with daily operations and analytics as needed.
Role may also require researching recent trends in the mobile advertising, mobile gaming, and advertising technology industries.

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field
At least 2 years of experience in a data-intensive role
Prior experience in mobile gaming or advertising is a big plus
Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, lookups, conditional functions, charting, and keyboard shortcuts
Advanced skills in SQL including joins, creating tables, case statements, and subqueries
Prior experience using dashboarding software (especially Tableau) or Python/R is a big plus
Strong problem-solving skills, teamwork, and creativity
Strong work ethic to consistently meet deadlines in a fast-paced business
Intellectual curiosity to dig through large volumes of data in order to uncover the insights within it
Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail, time management skills, and openness toward growth
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills
Enthusiasm about mobile gaming is a plus

Title: Data and Analytics Engineer
Description:
Who we are…

We are Payactiv, a FinTech company in the heart of Silicon Valley, devoted to giving workers access to their earned wages when they need them. Payactiv is the pioneer and industry leader in Earned Wage Access. We are the only Certified B Corporation and Public Benefit Corporation in our industry. Our app provides millions with financial services that help them avoid debt, manage their finances, and regain flexibility to pay for things on their own schedule.

What you will do…

Payactiv is seeking a hands-on Data and Analytics Engineer to own and support our business reporting, analytics, dashboarding, and marketing/operational data request workflows. This is a highly technical role responsible for managing analytics dashboards and BI reporting, supporting our Snowflake data warehouse environment, fulfilling data requests for user lifecycle messaging, and ensuring the accuracy, quality, and reliability of business-critical reporting.

The ideal candidate has strong SQL skills, experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and the ability to partner directly with business teams including User Lifecycle & Growth, Customer Success, Customer Support, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, and executive stakeholders. This person should be comfortable translating business questions into accurate data outputs, maintaining trusted dashboards, and supporting recurring and ad hoc reporting needs.

Key Responsibilities


Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries against the Snowflake data warehouse.
Build and maintain curated datasets, views, and reporting tables to support business reporting, analytics and list generation.
Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and define data solutions
Build trusted, scalable data sources and products that give the business reliable, actionable insights and accurate lists for user acquisition and lifecycle messaging
Manage, maintain, and enhance analytics, BI dashboards and data visualizations used across the organization.
Lead the development of self-serve tools that enable analytics to scale across the company
Implement dashboard changes, updates, new metrics, filters, and views based on business needs.
Validate accuracy of data pulls, reports and dashboards by reviewing data logic, source tables, joins, calculations, and definitions.
Present recommendations and reporting results to internal stakeholders and leadership
Support ad hoc data requests from various internal teams.
Support data quality checks, reconciliation, and validation across list generation and reporting workflows. Monitor and maintain data quality, integrity, and consistency across different environments.
Be a cross-functional champion and collaborate closely with Engineering, User Lifecycle and Growth, Data Scientists, BI and other teams to understand data sources, business rules, and reporting requirements.
Maintain documentation for key dashboards, metrics, assumptions, report logic, and data definitions.
Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and improve recurring reporting and data request processes.
Prepare, validate, and deliver data extracts, Excel-based reports, and lists for business stakeholders.
Use automation where appropriate to improve recurring reports, QA checks, and data delivery workflows.



What you need…


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
4+ years of experience in data analytics engineering, business intelligence, reporting, data engineering, or database development.
Strong hands-on SQL experience, including complex joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions, and query optimization.
Experience working with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.
Strong Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, data validation, and working with large CSV/data extracts.
Experience with BI/dashboarding tools; Sigma Computing experience is a plus.
Experience supporting business teams with ad hoc reporting, data pulls, dashboards, and operational analytics.
Ability to validate data accuracy, troubleshoot reporting discrepancies, and explain data logic to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Python experience for data extraction, automation, QA, or reporting workflows is a plus.
Strong attention to detail, especially when working with legal, compliance, financial, or executive-level reporting.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



What we offer…


Company-sponsored health, dental, and vision insurance.
Health, dental, and vision reimbursement account.
401(k), traditional and Roth, with a company match.
Tuition assistance or tuition reimbursement.
Unlimited paid time off.
Monthly gym reimbursement.
Paid time off to volunteer.
Paid family leave.
Complimentary office lunches.
Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment with modern data technologies.
Opportunity to influence business reporting, analytics, and data quality across the organization.
Salary Range: $130K to $165K (Based on experience) plus Bonus
