Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
About The Role

Thatch is rewiring how health benefits work. We build software that gives employees real control over how they use their benefits.

We're looking for an Analytics Engineer to own the data models, metrics, and dashboards the company runs on. You'll define how we measure the business, from source data through the numbers that leadership, growth, finance, and operations use every day. This work touches real money and real healthcare decisions. Consistency and reliability matter, but so does making the data simple to use for the teams who depend on it.




What you will do

Take ownership of meaningful metrics and data products, from definition through adoption.
Build and maintain dbt models that define how we measure the business.
Design and maintain dashboards used by growth, finance, and operations to make day-to-day decisions.
Improve data quality through testing, monitoring, and validation.
Enable self-serve analytics so teams can answer their own questions and move faster.




What we are looking for

Experience building analytics models and dashboards in a production environment.
Strong SQL skills and experience with dbt or similar tools, and working knowledge of python for ad-hoc analysis.
Strong intuition for metric design, including grain, aggregation, and edge cases.
Eagerness to work closely with stakeholders to define problems and translate them into metrics, models, and analytic tools.
Good judgment when balancing speed, accuracy, and maintainability.




We hire across levels and care most about the scope you've owned, the impact you've had, and how you make decisions.




Tools and tech stack

dbt and SQL for modeling.
Snowflake as our data warehouse (migrating from Redshift).
Omni for BI, with tools like Hex for ad hoc analysis.
GitHub with CI/CD for version control.
AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) are woven into our daily development and analysis workflow.




You won't work directly in our application layer day-to-day, but understanding source data from systems like Ruby on Rails is important.




Experience that stands out

Experience with data testing, CI/CD, and building reliable, observable data systems.
Partnering closely with finance, growth, or go-to-market teams.
Building self-serve analytics tools that reduce ad hoc requests.
Working in healthcare, fintech, or other complex, regulated domains.




How we work

We move quickly and are biased toward action.
We ship early, learn from real usage, and iterate.
We operate with trust, ownership, and high empathy.
We value clarity over ceremony and quality over shortcuts.




What to expect

We aim to move quickly, and most candidates complete the process within 2–3 weeks. You can expect:

An initial conversation with a recruiter.
A conversation with the hiring manager.
A take-home analytics exercise.
A review of your work, including modeling and coding exercises with the team, and a discussion with cross-functional partners.
A final conversation with engineering and company leadership.

Title: Senior Analyst, Self-Checkout
Description:
Our values start with our people, join a team that values you!

Bring your talents to Ross, our leading off-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

As Part Of Our Team, You Will Experience


Success. Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving
Career growth. We develop industry leading talent because Ross grows when our people grow
Teamwork. We work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution
Our commitment to Diversity, Equality & Inclusion, and our community. We celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. We strive to be a positive force in our community.


Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. With 2025 revenues of $22.8 billion, we are a Fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

General Purpose

The Sr. Analyst Store Strategy and Method Improvements will play a key role in analyzing all store technology, processes, and business model improvements with a focus on self checkout. Responsible for analyzing significant amounts of data accurately and quickly to reveal results such as labor save, Return on Investment, budget impacts, and capital investment. Serves as a subject matter expert on self checkout, complete store visits to collect both qualitative and quantitative feedback and develop and present summaries of results.

The base salary range for this role is $73,500 - $110,400. The base salary range is dependent on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, relevant education, certifications, seniority, and location. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards vary by position and location.

Essential Functions

Perform comprehensive data analysis


Design and conduct financial and operational analysis to identify process improvement opportunities as well as track pilot performance
Design (with limited guidance) and complete ad hoc analysis as requested
Ensure alignment between labor standards, business objectives, and the labor management system


Identify, Test, and Implement Process and Technology Improvements


Identify industry best practices, competitor practices, and technology opportunities to improve store efficiency, execution, and reduce labor spend at both Ross and dd's
Support cross-functional teams comprised of Analysts, Managers and Directors from Store Planning, Store Operations, Strategy, Loss Prevention, Shortage Control, Finance, and the field to implement pilots and chain-wide initiatives to improve efficiency
Prepare and present clear, fact-based presentations to illustrate findings and gain credibility based upon recommendations


Create New and Maintain Existing Labor Standards


Become an expert (if not already proficient) in the development of engineered labor standards through the use of the Maynard software suite
Develop and conduct measurements for current and future processes. Estimate and later validate the reliability of method improvement labor saves
Support Manager who serves as key point of contact for organization to understand impact of changes in the business on labor


Competencies


Ensures Accountability & Execution
Plans, Aligns & Prioritizes
Leading by Example
Communicates Effectively


Qualifications And Special Skills Required


Bachelor's degree required (preferably in an analytical field)
Strong candidates will have a minimum of 2-3 years post college experience
Outstanding analytical ability - must have a data driven approach to solving problems. Requires very strong quantitative skills, a good sense of how to dissect problems and a strong ability to "connect the dots"
A detail-oriented approach: Must pay very close attention to details and have the drive to get things right
Ability to build effective relationships with a wide variety of internal customers, including store and field leadership. Must be able to listen, understand and communicate with multiple levels from peers to Executives
High comfort level working in ambiguous, rapidly changing environments and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
High degree of reliability including accountability for daily, weekly, and long-term projects
Advanced financial and statistical modeling skills, computer skills including Microsoft Access, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint - proficiency of Excel and PowerPoint required
Six Sigma, Lean, or MOST labor standards experience preferred


Physical Requirements/Ada

No unusual physical requirements. Requires no heavy lifting, and nearly all work is performed in a comfortable indoor facility.

Routine deadlines; usually sufficient lead time; variance in work volume seasonal and predictable; priorities can be anticipated; some interruptions are present; travel or other inconveniences have advance notice; involves occasional exposure to demands and pressures from persons other than immediate supervisor.

Job frequently requires sitting, handling objects with hands.

Job occasionally requires standing, walking, reaching, talking, hearing, and lifting up to 10 pounds.

Vision requirements: Ability to see information in print and/or electronically.

This role requires regular in-office presence, including to engage in in-person team interaction, meetings and collaboration, client support, mentoring, coaching, and/or feedback. However, this role can perform duties effectively using a combination of in-office and remote work.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None

Title: Business Systems Analyst
Description:
The Opportunity

Do you like solving messy problems, organizing chaos, and turning data into decisions? Are you curious about how cloud technology, finance, and strategy intersect—? If so, this role was built for you.

This is a high-impact opportunity to join Adobe’s Cloud FinOps program, where we help teams understand, optimize, and make smarter decisions about cloud usage and investment. Work closely with finance, engineering, product, and leadership to drive meaningful cost efficiency—while building systems, dashboards, and processes that scale. We’re looking for someone motivated, thoughtful, and organized. Deep cloud expertise is helpful—but curiosity, grit, and the ability to break problems down and build solutions matter more. If you’ve ever enjoyed consulting-style problem solving, building your own frameworks, or automating something just because it annoyed you that it was manual—this role will feel like home.

The Challenge

As a FinOps Cloud Analyst, you’ll play a central role in how cloud efficiency data is created, shared, and acted on across Adobe—directly contributing to savings initiatives with millions of dollars in impact.

You will:


Design and run processes that collect, analyze, and distribute cloud cost, usage and efficiency metrics across every product team in Adobe
Create dashboards, tools, and automation that reduce manual work and scale insights (Tableau, SQL, Python, Cursor, or similar tools welcomed)
Help shape operating strategies for cloud optimization—identifying data, opportunities, and risks and turning insights into executable programs with achievements based roadmaps
Support internal “customers” by answering inquiries, surfacing trends, and proactively delivering the information teams need
Model financial impacts of cloud infrastructure and operating decisions and present insights to key decision makers


Key Skills and Experience Needed:


General: Are a full stack finance athlete with added capabilities across customer insights development, strategy creation, multi-functional leadership and program execution
Program Management: Ability to simultaneously oversee and lead multiple cloud business initiatives with high organizational skills. Ease in collaborating with finance, engineering and product managers to define project scope, objectives, timelines, and deliverables. Comfort in proposing / correcting pathways not just documenting what others say.
Technical Capability: An ability to automate the manual and engage with the ever changing business analytics and AI landscape
Finance & Analytics: Solid grasp of financial modeling and budgeting. You love numbers and Excel. Comfort working with ambiguity and can synthesize information into numbers with ease.
Customer Engagement: Skilled at building trust, influencing without authority, and soliciting feedback to incorporate into programs and communications. Not afraid to ask questions to get clarity.
Executive Communication: An uncanny ability to synthesize information from a variety of sources to present succinct, thoughtful decisions and opportunities. Capacity to seek executive guidance and support to overcome roadblocks. Competence in Power Point presentation and story telling.
Grit: Demonstrated perseverance through complex challenges and the ability to turn incomplete information into actionable decisions.


Why This Role Is Exciting


You’ll sit at the intersection of finance, technology, and strategy
Build—not just maintain—dashboards, processes, and automations
Gain exposure to executives and teams across all products and roles
Develop highly transferable skills in cloud economics, analytics, and AI-enabled work
Own your outcome - You’ll be trusted to figure things out and shape how FinOps operates


If you’re eager, analytical, and ready to grow fast—this role offers both responsibility and runway.

BA/BS or equivalent experience in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. MBA is preferred.
5+ years of experience in finance, analytics, consulting, or program management (flexible for exceptional candidates)
Project/Program management experience (PMP certification not required)
Consulting experience preferred
High proficiency in Power Point, Excel and Jira – Tableau, SQL a plus
History of working with large data sets and managing multiple concurrent work streams

Title: Compensation Analyst
Description:
Job Requisition ID

JR2021092

Job Category

Human Resources

Time Type

Full time

We are looking for a creative, data-driven Compensation Analyst to join our team. If you are a problem solver with strong analytical prowess, excellent communication skills, and a genuine passion for data analytics, this role is for you.

As a Compensation Analyst, you won’t just crunch numbers—you will contribute to the strategic development and implementation of our compensation programs. You will collaborate with team members to develop modern analytic tools, automate legacy processes, and help compose the future of our compensation strategy. The ideal candidate is enthusiastic, hardworking, and thrives on building elegant analytical models.

What You’ll Be Doing


Evolve Compensation Strategy: Help us redefine and evolve how we believe about base, variable, and equity compensation structures.
Advanced Analytics: Apply quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify problems, develop hypotheses, and recommend data-backed solutions for compensation programs and processes.
Data Visualization & Modeling: Build and develop dynamic dashboards and analytic models to provide actionable business insights and interpret market or internal trends.
Workday Optimization: Partner with the HRIS/Systems team to implement, test, and define requirements for Workday performance and compensation modules, ensuring seamless updates to structures and job profiles.
Drive Automation: Streamline and automate monthly, quarterly, and annual compensation reporting and analysis using modern data tools and AI workflows.
Market Benchmarking: Conduct global market benchmarking, assess peer groups, and ensure consistent market pricing practices while maintaining internal equity.
Storytelling with Data: Provide sophisticated compensation analytics, clearly conveying complex findings and recommendations to collaborators.


What We Need To See


BA/BS degree, preferably in a quantitative-focused major (e.g., Finance, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics) or equivalent experience.
5+ years of dedicated, progressive experience in Compensation.
Core Tech Stack: Advanced proficiency in Excel (complex formulas, VBA, Power Query) and a strong working knowledge of HRIS systems (preferably Workday).
Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives.
Soft Skills: High learning agility, flexibility, and unmatched quantitative problem-solving skills.


Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd


AI & Automation Savvy: Experience bringing to bear AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT Advanced Data Analysis, Microsoft Copilot) to accelerate data cleaning, script writing, and compensation reporting.
BI & Visualization: Proven experience building interactive dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or other advanced analytic platforms.
Coding & Automation: Familiarity with Python, R, or SQL for data manipulation and automating repetitive workflows.
Project Mastery: Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills with a track record of driving initiatives from concept to completion.
Scalable Processes: Demonstrated experience developing and implementing scalable, repeatable processes backed by detailed ongoing documentation.

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Integration meets Innovation

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

As a Product Data Analyst  you will play a critical role in Celigo’s success and help execute quantitative research tasks throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure that we’re solving the right problems and providing the right solutions for our target audiences and users. The Product Data Analyst  works strategically, proactively, and collaboratively to inform and influence product roadmaps and business goals.

We are seeking a Product Data Analyst to partner closely with UX Research, Product Management, Design, Content, Engineering, and Customer-facing teams to uncover actionable insights from behavioral and product usage data.

This role sits within the UX Research team in the Product organization and will partner closely with  product managers and designers to uncover actionable insights from behavioral and product usage data.

This is not a reporting-only role. It is a strategic position focused on uncovering, identifying, and transforming complex data into clear recommendations that drive measurable improvements in user experience, adoption, retention, and business impact.

What would you do if hired?
Partner with members of the Design, Content, and Product Management teams to uncover what they need to learn from quantitative data sources (and why) and then identify, pull, and analyze the necessary data to provide them with actionable insights rather than tables of raw data.
Collaborate closely with designers to define, track, and report on metrics that demonstrate the business and user impact of their work as well as craft measurable hypotheses for new and existing features.
Be curious, proactively analyze data, and surface insights that influence product strategy, roadmap decisions, and customer experience improvements.
Help train peers to effectively utilize user research findings and usage metrics to guide and improve design decisions.
Support research operations tasks such as pulling recruitment lists and answering ad-hoc data questions.
Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting frameworks that empower cross-functional teams.
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Identify leading indicators of engagement, activation, retention, and expansion.
Collaborate with Product Operations, Engineering, and Data teams to ensure clean, reliable event tracking and instrumentation.
Influence stakeholders across functions to gain support for research-based, user-centric solutions.


Who are we looking for?Skills & Abilities
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills, along with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to multitask and operate as a consultant across multiple product areas.
Ability to analyze and synthesize data, and guide product managers, designers, and engineers on how to act on the findings.
Aptitude for learning complex technological concepts.
Actively seeks and offers candid, constructive feedback with curiosity, humility, and openness.

Education & Experience  

4–6+ years of experience in Product Analytics or a similar role supporting B2B SaaS or enterprise software products.
Strong SQL skills and experience querying large datasets from multiple applications in a data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake).
Experience working with product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Google Analytics) and BI tools (e.g., Sigma).
Experience in defining and measuring KPIs such as activation, engagement, retention, churn, and feature adoption.
Work samples (case studies, portfolio, website, or similar) demonstrating the depth and breadth of your abilities, and their impact on the business.
Experience working in B2B SaaS, enterprise, or technically complex platforms.
Proven experience working with multi-disciplinary teams (Design, Engineering, Business, R&D, and others) to ideate, iterate, launch, and refine new product designs.
Experience with statistical tools (e.g., R, Python). Experience with methods such as cluster analysis, multivariate regressions, and two-proportion Z-tests is a plus.
Degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

Proficiency in the use of databases, spreadsheets, project management tools at a moderately to highly complex level 


Advanced skills in data querying (SQL) and experience with associated BI Tools (PowerBI, Tableau, etc.)

Title: Analyst, Rebates - Calgary or Saskatoon
Description:
Nutrien is a leading provider of crop inputs and services, and our business results make a positive impact on the world. Our purpose, Feeding the Future, is the reason we come to work each day. We’re guided by our culture of care and our core values: We put safety first. We act with integrity. We are stronger together. We deliver with excellence.

Through the collective expertise of our nearly 26,000 employees, we operate a world-class network of production, distribution, and ag retail facilities. We efficiently serve growers' needs and strive to provide a more profitable, sustainable, and secure future for all stakeholders.  Help us raise the expectation of what an agriculture company can be and grow your career with Nutrien. 

We are currently hiring for two openings within this position.

What You'll Do


Lead monthly reporting, quarterly forecasting, and strategic annual budgeting activities
Develop and maintain analytical models to deliver actionable insights on supplier profitability and rebate performance
Manage rebate programs in Segmentation/Vistex, including setup, maintenance, and product-level impact analysis
Ensure accurate data setup and integration across ERP, and rebate accrual systems
Support supplier contract lifecycle through financial analysis, negotiation input, implementation tracking, and redemption oversight
Serve as liaison between Vistex consultants and internal teams to ensure business requirements are clearly defined and delivered
Conduct financial modeling, sensitivity analysis, and business case evaluations to support strategic decisions and new business initiatives
Present financial analyses quantifying P&L impact and communicate key findings to stakeholders
Recommend and implement automated solutions to enhance regular business activities to ensure efficiency within tasks
Align with strategic supplier managers on new or changes in reporting requirements to deliver accurate analytical and performance rebate program metrics
Collaborate cross-functionally with Strategic Supplier Managers, FP&A, and other key stakeholders, working independently as needed


What You'll Bring


Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in data sciences, finance, or economics. MBA a plus. Experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
3+ years of related experience required, preferably in Finance or Business Analysis
Demonstrate a high level of attention to detail and accuracy in your work
Excellent organization and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities
Understanding of business forecasting and analytics is required, with prior experience in vendor rebate analytics as a strong differentiator
Ideal candidate would have experience with FP&A, SAP, Vistex, reporting, analytics, and Excel modeling; however, candidates who offer a combination of several of these qualifications will be considered
Curiosity to find ways to create efficiencies to improve processes over time
Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills preferred
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, demonstrating initiative & problem solving
Strong written, presentation, and verbal communication skills; ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization


What You'll Get


Purpose-Driven Work – Make an impact as part of a global team feeding the future and support farmers locally and around the world
Excellent Benefits – Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, plus a retirement program with generous employer matching for your future
Grow Your Career – Tuition assistance for future education and ongoing learning and training opportunities for career advancement pathways across the organization
Support When it Matters – Employee Assistance Programs, inclusive leaves, and paid time for holidays, volunteering, vacation, and wellness
Thrive in a Strong Culture – Guided by our core values we put safety first, act with integrity, are stronger together, and deliver with excellence in a collaborative, high-performing environment


Ready to make an impact with us? Apply today!  

The estimated salary that Indeed, Glassdoor and LinkedIn lists does not represent Nutrien's compensation structure. Nutrien is an equal opportunity employer.  We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.  

This job will remain posted until filled. In accordance with Nutrien policies, you will be required to undergo a background check, and may be required to undergo a substance test. While we appreciate all applications we receive, only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Applicants must meet minimum age requirements, as permitted by law. 

Our Recruitment Process: Application > Resume Review > Pre-screen/Interview > Offer > Pre-Employment Conditions > Welcome to Nutrien 

To stay connected to us and for the latest job postings and news, follow us on:  LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

Job Category: Developer

Job Type: Full Time

Job Location: Remote

Job status: Open

Job Description

About xCroTek

xCroTek is a product- and service-based AI software company that builds innovative, AI-powered solutions to drive intelligent automation and digital transformation. We specialize in creating scalable, impactful technologies for modern businesses.

Job Overview

We are seeking a skilled DOMO Developer to support our enterprise analytics initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing existing DOMO data marts, integrations, and reports, and will play a key role in optimising our data ecosystem. This role will involve creating detailed data mapping documents, defining business rules, and ensuring data consistency and accuracy across multiple systems.

Key Responsibilities


Analyse existing DOMO data marts, data pipelines, and source system integrations.
Review and optimize DOMO reports, dashboards, and overall implementation.
Work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into data mapping documents and apply business rules.
Develop, maintain, and optimise complex SQL queries for data validation, transformation, and reporting purposes.
Perform in-depth data analysis and data modeling to support reporting and decision-making.
Collaborate with data engineers and architects on data integration and modeling best practices.
Provide insights and recommendations to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and scalability.
Leverage Snowflake (or other cloud data warehouses) for data exploration and integration support.


Required Skills


1–5 years of hands-on experience in business intelligence and analytics development.
Strong expertise in DOMO platform (data flows, data sets, cards, dashboards, and Magic ETL).
Excellent proficiency in SQL (writing, optimizing, and debugging queries across large data sets).
Solid understanding of data analysis, data modeling, and ETL processes.
Experience in documenting data mapping and business rules.
Exposure to Snowflake or similar modern cloud data platforms (BigQuery, Redshift, Azure Synapse).
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Effective communication skills to bridge technical details with business needs.


Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience in data governance, data quality, or metadata management.
Familiarity with integration tools (e.g., DOMO Workbench, APIs, or cloud connectors).
Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.


How To Apply

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a brief cover letter explaining their interest in the role to hr@xcrotek.com. Please include “DOMO Developer/Data Analyst” in the subject line.

Apply with a one-page cover letter and CV to hr@xcrotek.com

Position Overview:

Finning Canada is looking to hire a permanent, full-time Procurement Data Specialist in Edmonton or Calgary who will report to the Procurement Performance Manager.

The Procurement Data Specialist will be an expert and owner of all procurement master data. Responsibilities include collaborating with internal stakeholders, external suppliers and Caterpillar to gather and process information requirements to facilitate the daily and long term requirements vital to the ERP system and identify value-added opportunities across the organization. This role will also be responsible for analyzing and evaluating data for accuracy, updating master data as well as troubleshooting and resolving problems related to procurement master data. Manage and optimize procurement data and systems by maintaining the integrity of supplier, item, and related master data within the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system, while supporting overall system functionality and data architecture.
Partner with internal and external stakeholders to gather business requirements, support data analysis, and translate operational needs into system and process improvements that enhance procurement performance.
Support ERP systems and continuous improvement initiatives by contributing to system enhancements, configuration changes, and integration activities in collaboration with IT and cross-functional teams to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
Develop and maintain data governance standards by establishing data policies, controls, and best practices to ensure consistency, accuracy, compliance, and system integrity across procurement processes.
Design and deliver reporting and insights by developing and maintaining reports, dashboards, and analytical outputs to support decision-making, performance tracking, and operational visibility.
Provide mentorship and guidance to Procurement Data Coordinators and support cross-functional teams in data processes, reporting tools, and system usage.
Lead and contribute to continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to optimize procurement systems, workflows, and data processes, and ensuring initiatives are tracked through to completion.

Post-secondary degree in Business or Supply Chain, related to Data Management, Operations Management or related field
2+ years experience in a Data Management or Supply Chain role
Strong computer skills and proficient in MS Office Suite – specifically Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Experience with MS Power Automate or similar workflow automation tools
Experience with analytics and the development of reports, metrics and dashboards using tools such as PowerBI
SQL and Excel (VBA) knowledge is an asset
Previous experience with SAP Ariba would be an asset
Knowledge and understanding of end-to-end supply chain management
Working knowledge of ERP and data base systems

Highly developed analytical and problem solving skills

Advanced Data Analyst - FC Live Service Forecasting

Our FC Data & Analytics team is looking for an Advanced Analyst to join our group, leading forecasting and performance modelling for FC’s live service business. Reporting to a Senior Analytics Manager, you will be part of a growing team providing data and insights around player behaviour and live content performance within the FC franchise. We’re looking for someone who combines strong quantitative forecasting expertise with business intuition, bringing the ability to translate historical trends, player behaviour, and live content strategies into actionable projections that inform decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and live service operations - helping shape how FC plans and measures performance at scale.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Own the forecasting framework that underpins performance measurement, planning, and strategic decision-making across FC’s live service business.
Employ an extensive toolkit of financial modelling techniques, time series analysis, and a deep knowledge of their use cases.
Develop a robust model that projects our live service funnel metrics to a high degree of fidelity, incorporating player behaviour, in-game content, and macroeconomic trends.
Collaborate with partners across Product Management, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on projections, and keep the business updated on how our latest live service performance impacts our model’s assumptions.
Establish scalable forecasting processes that enable us to work with our cross-functional partners to efficiently & effectively refine our projections over time.
Lead presentations to diverse audiences including senior and executive level management, distilling complex model results into clear insights & recommendations.
Run risk and opportunity scenarios based on live content plans, new feature additions, and other potential changes in the FC product.
Mentor and collaborate with other analysts in order to collaboratively develop our forecasts, working together to drive evolutions in our modelling in this space.


What We're Looking For


A degree in a quantitative discipline (Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or similar)
7+ years of experience in a data-driven role performing quantitative analysis with big data to help guide decisions
4+ years of experience developing financial/product performance projections and forecasts using various modelling techniques
Strong experience in statistical and/or time series modelling for predictive purposes
Expertise in SQL and working with large-scale, complex datasets
Proficient in analyzing large datasets using programmatic tools (e.g. Python, R)
Experience with data visualization software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI)
Strong capabilities in project management processes
Very comfortable presenting analysis in an executive facing environment

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

The Metadata/Data Lineage team is undertaking multiple complex enterprise-wide initiatives as part of RBC’s ongoing plan to improve data governance and data lineage management across the organization. In this role you will be responsible for strategically planning and managing successful implementation of data lineage extraction and documentation. The role will coordinate, develop, lead, communicate and execute activities to ensure objectives are accomplished on time.

What Will You Do?


Analyze, validate, and document data lineage from complex legacy systems across AML, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Wealth Management
Design and execute SQL queries and Python scripts to extract data relationships and lineage information from undocumented or minimally documented legacy systems
Build and maintain reusable frameworks and tools that scale across multiple systems and departments
Research and prototype AI/agent-based approaches to automate data lineage discovery
Collaborate cross-functionally with business teams, data engineers, and platform teams to understand data flows and validate lineage
Work independently to identify blockers, develop solutions, and escalate issues appropriately
Perform data quality assessments and identify gaps or inconsistencies in lineage data
Document findings and approaches to help scale lineage discovery to other systems across the bank


What Do You Need to Succeed?

Must Have


3-5 years of data analysis, data engineering, or software development experience
Strong SQL and Python programming skills for data extraction, parsing, and tool development
Experience with regular expressions and Bash/Unix scripting for data manipulation
Demonstrated ability to learn new systems quickly, especially legacy or undocumented code
Internal locus of control: ability to identify and remove your own blockers and drive solutions independently


Nice to Have


Experience with AI/agent frameworks, LLMs, and multi-model LLM concepts (MCP)
Familiarity with mainframe systems, JCL, or other legacy enterprise systems
Experience with data modeling, schema design, or metadata management
GitHub Actions or CI/CD pipeline deployment experience


What’s in it for You?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.


A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work


Job Skills

Big Data Management, Cloud Computing, Database Development, Data Mining, Data Warehousing (DW), ETL Processing, Group Problem Solving, Quality Management, Requirements Analysis

Title: Jr. Data Analyst - ACX Corporate Support Edmonton
Description:
Join the ride!

Position : Jr. Data Analyst

Collision Centre: ACX Corporate Support Edmonton

Location: Edmonton, Alberta

Classification: Full-time, Immediate hire

Part of a bigger team!

ACX Corporate Support Edmonton is proud to be part of the AutoCanada Collision Centres’ network and a division of AutoCanada. AutoCanada is the largest Canadian owned and publicly traded automotive dealer group operating in Canada and the US. We are innovative, data-driven and our commitment to our Team Members, customers and operational excellence fuels our success. 

Our Team Members are at the heart of our success, building long-lasting, trust-based relationships with customers across Canada. Our national network provides opportunities and support to build the career that’s right for you. Working here is fast-paced, non-stop, and a little unpredictable—and we love it. 

Your area of focus.

You'll join the ACX (Collision Centre & Hail) Analytics & Innovation team at AutoCanada in an entry-level role focused on keeping our reporting suite running and helping migrate it from Tableau to Power BI. You'll grow into designing new dashboards, running data validation, and supporting stakeholders across our national collision repair network. Reporting into the Analytics & Innovation Lead, you'll get hands-on mentorship, direct exposure to shop managers, regional directors and senior leadership, and visibility into our AI and innovation work as your skills develop.

What drives your day-to-day?


Maintain and monitor the existing Tableau dashboard suite, ensuring reports run accurately and on schedule during the migration period.
Perform routine data validation across dashboards and reports, investigating discrepancies and partnering with Data Engineering when source data needs to be corrected.
Produce recurring monthly reports and one-off ad hoc reports for shop managers, regional directors and corporate stakeholders.
Manage the ACX user list across Tableau and Power BI, provisioning access and keeping permissions aligned with role.

Title: Operations Reporting Analyst
Description:
Branch: Gas

Affiliation: MoveUP

Employment Status: Full-Time Regular

Salary: $3,478.00 bi-weekly

Short-term Incentive Eligible: No

Workplace Flexibility: No

Posting End Date: Open until filled

As the province’s largest energy provider with more than 100 years of knowledge and experience, we proudly deliver renewable energy, natural gas, electricity and propane to 1.3 million customers.

We're actively seeking new talent to join our mission of delivering a stronger energy future in B.C. As one of BC's Top Employers with a diverse team of over 2,700 employees, we are committed to a safe and inclusive culture where each of us can connect, belong, and grow. Join us, and together, let's shape a brighter future for B.C.

Position Overview

Are you passionate about transforming complex operational data into meaningful insights? As an Operations Reporting Analyst, you'll play a key role in helping leaders make informed business decisions by analyzing operational performance, identifying trends, and developing reporting solutions that drive continuous improvement.

In this role, you'll partner with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful reporting, benchmarking, and analytical insights that support operational excellence and strategic planning.

In this role, you will


Analyze operational metrics, activities, and costs to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement.
Develop, maintain, and enhance ERP-based reports and queries that support business operations and decision-making.
Conduct benchmarking, cost, and performance analyses to help establish targets and evaluate operational results.
Perform trend analysis, forecasting, and scenario modeling to assess potential business impacts and support strategic planning.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, investigate data gaps, and deliver actionable insights.
Present findings and recommendations that improve reporting practices, processes, and operational performance.
Support continuous improvement initiatives, system enhancements, and implementation projects.
Create training materials and procedural documentation that help users effectively understand and utilize reporting tools.


Requirements


Education: Successful completion of Diploma in Accounting, Finance, or a related field from an accredited post-secondary institution.
Experience: Minimum of six (6) years’ experience of recent and related experience, of which one year experience involves complex data analytics.
Strong analytical skills including the ability to organize, interpret and present data through reports, summaries and procedural documentation.
Excellent organizational skills, initiative and ability to balance priorities and meet deadlines.
Working knowledge of statistical analysis, cost-benefit analysis and related analytical techniques.
Advanced knowledge of ERP financial systems (e.g. SAP) and reporting tools (including SAP BW) used to support cost accounting as well as other specialized software used within the department.
Ability to work with limited supervision and direction.
Strong interpersonal, presentation, verbal and written communication skills.


Our engaging workplace offers a wide range of challenging opportunities, while being safe, inclusive, and diverse. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, while supporting life-long career development. We also encourage volunteerism and nourish the need to give back to your community.

The Data Analyst Independently performs data analysis; document, recommend, and make process and

configuration changes to data functions and/or systems; and perform strategic data analysis to support

management. Requires in-depth and broad understanding of the company’s data configuration and

needs to analyze and resolve problems.

Create, run, and disseminate weekly and monthly reports as directed by stakeholders and team.
ERP support, testing and implementation including CPP
Warehouse Management System support & testing for warehouse
Excel support for store, management for stores and Home Office.
Corporate EDI support.

Comprehensive knowledge of the products Country Supplier sells.

PRPA's primary data steward for all forms of data, including geospatial (GIS) data, which support day-to-day operations at PRPA.

Title: Analyst Statistician
Description:
Mandate

The Analyst/Statistician advances evidence based decision making across the university by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data related to enrolment, student success, academic programs, operations, and strategic initiatives. The role leverages modern analytics tools—including Power BI and emerging AI driven technologies—to transform complex information into actionable insights. This position supports institutional planning, accreditation, assessment, and compliance reporting while collaborating with academic and administrative units to strengthen the university’s strategic capacity.

Objectives

This position strengthens the university’s ability to make informed, strategic decisions. By integrating advanced analytics, Power BI dashboards, and AI driven insights, the Analyst/Statistician helps shape academic planning, improve student outcomes, and ensure accountability to internal and external stakeholders.

This position requires a bachelor’s degree in education, Statistics, Social Sciences, Data Science, or a related field and 3 years related experience. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Include


Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills.
Proficiency with statistical software (e.g., SAS, SPSS, R, Python) and database tools (e.g., SQL).
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Collaborative and independent work.
High level of attention to detail, clear documentation, and ability to work with sensitive information.
Experience with data visualization tools, including Power BI.
Predictive modeling, time series analysis, forecasting.
Familiarity with AI assisted analytics tools (e.g., natural language query features, automated insights, predictive modeling platforms) and the curation of results.


Preferred


Master’s degree in a relevant field.
Experience in higher education or institutional research, especially in the BC context.
Knowledge of student information systems (e.g., Banner).
Experience applying AI tools to data analysis, forecasting, or workflow automation.
Familiarity with accreditation standards and government reporting requirements.

Description:
Your Job

Flint Hills Resources is seeking a Product Analyst/Data Analyst to join our team in Wichita, KS. As an IT Product Analyst/Data Analyst, you will serve as a highly capable contributor who helps ensure strong delivery execution and continuity within the product team. You will play a critical role in translating product direction into high-quality delivery outcomes and in extending the team's impact across the broader technology ecosystem. This role is well-suited for someone ready to take accountability for delivery outcomes, influence how work gets done, and contribute meaningfully to business and technology objectives.

What You Will Do


Work closely with the business to understand problems at their root and drive solutions through technology — whether through your own development work or by collaborating across the business, software engineering, data architecture and solutions architecture.
Develop and maintain scripts, agents, and lightweight applications using tools like Python to automate processes, move data, and solve business problems.
Understand data models, system integrations, and application behavior to effectively translate business needs into sound technical approaches.
Analyze data, build reports and dashboards, and surface insights that inform product and business decisions — including understanding how application data and APIs translate into graph and analytical data models.
Own projects end-to-end — from problem statement through delivery and adoption — maintaining accountability for outcomes throughout.
Contribute to roadmap development, collaborating closely with product and business leadership to identify new features, enhancements, and incremental improvements aligned with product direction.
Continuously innovate and push the team forward — challenging the status quo, identifying opportunities to transform how work gets done, and raising the bar for those around you.



Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)


Experience in IT, data, software engineering, or a business role with demonstrated technical aptitude
A passion for or experience writing scripts, queries, or code (e.g., Python, JavaScript, SQL, AI agents, or equivalent) to solve problems, automate processes, or move and validate data
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions
Experience communicating technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship



What Will Put You Ahead


Experience with Cypher, graph databases, or data modeling
Experience with data engineering or API integrations — building pipelines, moving data, or connecting systems
Experience with cloud technologies, specifically AWS (e.g., SQS, CloudWatch, Lambda)
Experience with AI agents, LLMs, or prompt engineering
Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, data modeling, or analytics — including building reports, dashboards, or data products that inform business decisions
Experience in procurement, accounts payable, source-to-pay, or operations

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch company, Flint Hills Resources is an industry-leading refining company making the oil and transportation products that keep the world moving. We make a large supply of fuel for gas stations and airports in addition to transporting crude oil, natural gas liquids and refined products through 4,000+ miles of pipeline – delivering energy to farmers, manufacturers and families. Title: Master Data Analyst
Description:
*This position is not eligible for sponsorship




Data Analyst – Master Data & Enterprise Reporting

Location: La Crosse, WI – Kwik Trip Support Center (Onsite/Hybrid)

Job Type: Full‑time




About the Role

As a Data Analyst on Kwik Trip’s IT Data Services team, you will help ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of the data that powers decision‑making across the company. You will develop and maintain SQL‑based data solutions, support enterprise reporting platforms, and implement master data management (MDM) processes that improve data quality and integrity. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex data challenges and collaborating across business units.




What You’ll Do

Support and manage Kwik Trip’s MDM tools (Informatica, SAS, and future platforms).
Build MDM jobs and pipelines that ingest, match, merge, and distribute data to downstream systems.
Develop and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and ETL processes.
Create and maintain ETL jobs using tools such as Microsoft SSIS, Informatica ETL, and SAS DataFlux.
Support enterprise reporting platforms including Power BI, SSRS, and Sigma.
Build dashboards and reports that provide clear, actionable insights to business partners.
Implement and manage MDM best‑record and matching processes to improve data quality.
Assist in creating and maintaining data dictionaries, data flow diagrams, and integration documentation.
Partner with software vendors to resolve issues, manage upgrades, and stay informed on future enhancements.
Serve as a subject matter expert for enterprise data and support business units with data‑related needs.




What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
At least two years of related professional experience.
Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases and enterprise software.
Ability to write complex queries and work with advanced database tools.
Experience troubleshooting ETL jobs, SQL procedures, and data integration issues.
Understanding of Master Data and Data Quality concepts.
Ability to develop data requirements and specifications.
Familiarity with version control and release management.
Strong problem‑solving, communication, and collaboration skills.




Even Better If You Have

Experience with SSIS and Azure Data Factory.
Experience with Informatica MDM, SAS DataFlux, or similar tools.
Experience creating dashboards in Power BI, SSRS, or Sigma.




Work Schedule

Monday through Friday, daytime hours.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Purpose of this Position:

The Enterprise Data Analyst is responsible for both designing and developing our data architecture and performing data analysis to support business decision-making. This role encompasses the end-to-end process of data collection, transformation, storage, and analysis. The Enterprise Data Analyst will work with departments across the organization to provide data solutions to our internal teams, ensuring data is reliable, accessible, and actionable, driving insights and strategic initiatives throughout the organization. They will also assist in deploying special projects for the other departments as requested.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes to support data reporting and dashboards.
Organize, model, and store raw data in our data warehouse and data lake.
Analyze and interpret data using statistical methods and tools.
Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
Ensure the reliability, efficiency, and quality of data by developing and implementing processes for data cleaning, transformation, and validation.

Competencies:

Ability to learn internal software and systems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage competing projects and priorities effectively.
Ability to interact with varying organizational levels confidently.
Ability to communicate technical information coherently to a variety of stakeholders.
Ability to confidentially interact with and interpret organizational information.
Strong analytical skills.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience:

Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of experience in data analysis, interpretation, and visualization; or an equivalent combination of education and experience, including 6+ years of experience in data analysis, interpretation, and visualization.
Experience with enterprise software or the transportation and logistics industry is a plus.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
Working knowledge of at least one major programming language (e.g., Python, C#, Java, or Scala) required.
Proficiency with statistical analysis and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) required.
Familiarity with big data technologies and platforms such as Delta Lake, Spark, and Databricks required.
Experience with SQL and relational databases is highly preferred.
Knowledge of schema design, data modeling, and data analysis is preferred.
Familiarity with data orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect is preferred.
Preferred certifications in Azure, Power BI, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering include, but are not limited to:
Azure Data Engineer Associate
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
DataCamp Data Engineer Certification
DataCamp Data Analyst Certification
DataCamp Data Scientist Certification
Other related cloud, analytics, or data engineering certifications

Why McLeod?

At McLeod Software, we believe that our employees are our greatest competitive advantage. Each employee contributes directly to McLeod Software’s growth and success. When you join McLeod, you’re joining a company that’s built for the long haul—with a clear vision, strong leadership, and a commitment to investing in our people.

Title: Data Specialist
Description:
Role

The Data Specialist manages the credit union's data infrastructure, ensures the accuracy and accessibility of core and third-party data, and partners with departments across the organization to turn data into actionable insights that support member service and business decisions. This is an in office position.

Major Duties And Responsibilities


Data Warehouse & Database Management: Manage the data warehouse solution; validate and reconcile data from core banking and third-party systems for accuracy and completeness. Administer SQL Server/database environment — updates, table management, indexing, performance tuning, and backup/recovery processes. Maintain data lineage and documentation so data sources, transformations, and definitions are traceable and auditable. Monitor data quality on an ongoing basis (not just at point of extract) using validation rules, exception reporting, and reconciliation checks
Dashboards & Reporting: Partner with management to design, build, and maintain data dashboards that support operational and strategic decision-making. Develop self-service reporting capabilities so departments can pull standard reports without ad hoc requests, freeing capacity for higher-value analysis
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary point of contact for data-driven requests and custom extracts from internal departments (Lending, Marketing, Compliance, Finance, etc.). Translate business questions into data requirements and deliver clear, actionable outputs. Provide basic data literacy support/training to help staff interpret and use dashboards and reports effectively
Emerging Responsibilities / Current Trends: Data governance: Support development and enforcement of data governance policies — data ownership, access controls, retention schedules, and standardized definitions across systems. Data security & privacy compliance: Ensure data handling practices align with GLBA, NCUA guidance, and other applicable member privacy/security regulations, including monitoring for unauthorized access and supporting audit/exam data requests. Cloud & integration management: Manage or support cloud-hosted data solutions and API-based integrations with fintech/third-party vendors, ensuring secure and reliable data flow
Carries out supplementary tasks aligned with the role and department objectives


Experience

Knowledge and Skills


Two to Five years of similar or related experience, including time spent in preparatory positions


EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES


Microsoft SQL Certification, Associates Degree, College Degree


Interpersonal Skills


Work with third party data providers, management, and subject matter experts, developing data visualizations. Dialog is of technical nature that may require communicating abstract data relationships


Other Skills


Knowledge of technology programs utilized by the financial industry including but limited to JackHenry Symitar, Fiserv, Origence, Internet/Intranet applications, and Microsoft Office products. Has programming platform experience using Object Oriented Architecture, HTML, XML, SOAP, and REST api. Has database management skills with stored procedures, views, and SQL Server 2016 and above

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver

  • Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
  • Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
  • Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
  • Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
  • Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
  • Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
  • Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships

Transform

  • Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
  • Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
  • Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
  • Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
  • Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making

What We’re Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
  • Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
  • Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
  • Intermediate SQL for analytics
  • Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
  • A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
  • Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent

Nice-to-have

  • Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
  • Mentoring or coaching experience
  • Experience in Python or PySpark
  • Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.

Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits

  • 4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
  • 1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
  • Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
  • Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
  • Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
  • Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
  • Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
  • On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
  • Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.

Behaviours We Value

  • Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
  • Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
  • Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
  • Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
  • Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term

We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Accurate & Timely Reporting


Generate precise Revenue Management reports.
Support team and senior leadership with ad-hoc reports.
Produce daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
Present 14-day rooms forecast.
Assist in 30, 60, and 90-day revenue forecasts.
Contribute to Food & Beverage and Spa reporting.


Tool Ownership


Manage external tools (Lighthouse, D360/A360, STR).
Ensure data accuracy and enhance tool automation.


STRATEGY: IMPLEMENTATION

OTA Management


Oversee OTA extranets for rate and inventory accuracy.
Maintain rate parity across platforms.


Content Audit


Monthly audit of hotel content on distribution channels.


Rate And Promotion Handling


Load rates, promotions, and packages for proper distribution.


Documentation And Meetings


Maintain Hotel Rate Code and package allocation template.
Participate in weekly Revenue Maximization Meetings.


Strategic Proposals


Provide proposals for long and short-term hotel strategies.

Education


Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, Accounting, Finance, Mathematics, or Business Management preferred


Experience


Minimum 2 years of Reservations Management experience is preferred
Minimum 2 years of Revenue Analytics/Strategy (or equivalent) experience is highly preferred
Experience with Opera (PMS and S&C) and Passkey GroupMax is highly preferred
Hospitality industry experience is highly preferred
