Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for you to join our team as a Data Analyst. This position focuses on data analysis for law enforcement support, requiring a combination of investigative data expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to work under high-pressure, mission-critical environments. This role will involve working with diverse data sets, ensuring accuracy and integrity while supporting ongoing criminal and civil investigations.

Our ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to engage with law enforcement agencies. We are looking for more than just a "Data Analyst"—this role requires a technologist with excellent communication skills, customer service, and a passion for data and problem-solving.

Contributions

Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis and Trend Recognition: Compile and analyze data from multiple sources, identifying trends across various data sets, locations, and targets.
Data Accuracy and Assessment: Monitor data for accuracy, integrity, authenticity, and relevancy. Identify intelligence gaps and assess data viability for investigative purposes.
Investigative Support: Collaborate with teams to examine data gathered from criminal and civil investigations, developing methodologies to exploit investigative information.
Quality Control & Reporting: Participate in the development of work products, conducting periodic progress reviews and ensuring quality control of findings. Regularly report findings to lead personnel.
Data Entry: Perform data entry from both hard and soft copies into large-scale data processing systems, utilizing tools like optical character readers, scanners, and digital cameras as appropriate.
Law Enforcement Support: Provide critical law enforcement support, interacting with various agencies through multiple channels of communication, while managing data under tight timelines in a high-pressure environment.
Data Visualization and Tools: Leverage MS Excel, Power BI, or similar tools to design and build formulas, charts, pivot tables, and manipulate unstructured data from different platforms.
You will be part of our Data Exploitation Practice!


Qualifications

Required:


Ability to hold a position of SECRET clearance level with the US government.
4 years of Military or law enforcement background or exposure.
Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of work experience OR 9 years of work experience and no degree.
3+ years of experience in SQL and Python
5+ years of experience using data analytic/visualization tools such as MS Excel, Power BI, or others to design charts, create formulas, and analyze unstructured data (can be job or education-based).
2+ years of experience manipulating unstructured data from different platforms; and experience in IT, statistics, computer information systems, auditing, investigative, mathematics, and units of measure
Skilled at multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment while maintaining clear communications with stakeholders.
Must be local to El, Paso TX or willing to drive on site 5 days a week.
Applicants selected will be subject to a Government background investigation and must meet eligibility and suitability requirements.


Preferred


Law enforcement/drug data desired.
Ability to manage multiple tasks in a high-paced environment, including collaboration with various teams.
Strong analytical skills for identifying trends, gaps, and ensuring data accuracy and
Experience with documenting processes and developing SOPs for data handling and
Demonstrated experience in reverse engineering and validation of data processes.
Ability to communicate findings and updates effectively during briefings and team

Works independently with internal and external customers to clearly articulate and define business problem(s) to be solved; reviews data sources and preps needed data; performs required analysis; applies accepted statistical methodologies where applicable; documents the process that was followed and data sources/tools used; ensures results have been validated (statistically, if necessary); and prepares/presents findings that are informative and audience appropriate to drive decision making across various levels of the organization.

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree and four years of related experience or two years of Healthcare Analytics experience; or an equivalent combination of education and related work experience.
Strong oral and written communicate skills.
Strong understanding of data (types, content reliability, etc.).
Strong problem solving and data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
Strong understanding/use of dashboards, data visualization tools, and advanced and custom graphics.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. Including but not limited to Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook.
Proficiency with OLAP tools and databases.
Knowledge of one or more of the following: SQL, R or SAS/SPSS



Duties And Responsibilities


Data Management:
Reviews data sources and preps needed data.
Identifies existing and new data sources.
Performs data prototyping, if necessary, to agree what data can/not be used.
Preps data for use in analysis, goes back to source if problems are found, and identifies other options/alternatives if problems cannot be resolved.
Performs review of data to ensure completeness/accuracy/timeliness for the purpose of the analysis.
Ensures existing, approved, corporate tools used can accept/integrate the data.
Where necessary (and if practical to be done within the delivery timeframe of a project), facilitates the identification and use of new tools and works with the Technical Review Committee to authorize its use.
Analytics and Technical Acumen:
Performs required analysis, applies accepted statistical methodologies where applicable, and documents the process that was followed and data sources/tools used.
Determines what kind of analytics will be performed (descriptive, predictive, prescriptive) and defines/documents overall framework.
Where appropriate, applies linear regression (correlation, contingency table, ANOVA, inference, chi-square, t-test) and/or time series methods (data set-up, conversions, trends, decomposition, models, forecasts, confidence).
Utilizes appropriate tools to load, integrate, and analyze data.
Conducts analysis and documents findings, identifies unexpected anomalies and root cause (if possible) and determines if analysis can continue, identifies alternatives if anomalies cannot be resolved
Ensures reproducibility of outcomes.
Documents entire analysis process, including business problem, data sources, methods and tools used, project reference, and outcomes.
Implements pre-emptive actions, where possible.
Project Definition and Coordination:
Lead meetings with internal and external customers to clearly articulate and define business problem(s) of medium/high complexity and impact (department/function specific, external customer centric, or part of a corporate project).
Types of projects include descriptive and predictive analytics.
Applies a whole company perspective, draws upon previous knowledge and experience, and -- where necessary -- researches new/other approaches to identify and agree upon objectives, approach, and success measures.
Works with customer to submit appropriate paperwork (ISS, TPDR, etc.) and ensures necessary agreements are in place for external customers.
Defines delivery milestones and negotiates timeframes, monitors progress, and periodically notifies customer of status.
Effective Communication:
Works primarily with department heads or function leads to prepare/present findings that are informative and audience appropriate
Reviews findings and outcomes with customer, ensures business problem/objectives have been met, and prepares documentation of the analysis
Where necessary, manage divergent views in the audience and advises the internal/external customer on any recommendations or options that will facilitate data and analysis driven decision making.
Prepares a presentation of the analysis, process followed, and reviews it with the customer to ensure the results are audience appropriate.
Performs all other miscellaneous responsibilities and duties as assigned or directed.
Trains others on MicroStrategy and Excel.
Functions as a team player within the department and embodies collaboration.

  • Proficiency with OLAP tools and databases.
  • Knowledge of one or more of the following: SQL, R or SAS/SPSS


Duties And Responsibilities

  • Data Management:
    • Reviews data sources and preps needed data.
      • Identifies existing and new data sources.
      • Performs data prototyping, if necessary, to agree what data can/not be used.
      • Preps data for use in analysis, goes back to source if problems are found, and identifies other options/alternatives if problems cannot be resolved.
      • Performs review of data to ensure completeness/accuracy/timeliness for the purpose of the analysis.
      • Ensures existing, approved, corporate tools used can accept/integrate the data.
      • Where necessary (and if practical to be done within the delivery timeframe of a project), facilitates the identification and use of new tools and works with the Technical Review Committee to authorize its use.
  • Analytics and Technical Acumen:
    • Performs required analysis, applies accepted statistical methodologies where applicable, and documents the process that was followed and data sources/tools used.
      • Determines what kind of analytics will be performed (descriptive, predictive, prescriptive) and defines/documents overall framework.
      • Where appropriate, applies linear regression (correlation, contingency table, ANOVA, inference, chi-square, t-test) and/or time series methods (data set-up, conversions, trends, decomposition, models, forecasts, confidence).
      • Utilizes appropriate tools to load, integrate, and analyze data.
      • Conducts analysis and documents findings, identifies unexpected anomalies and root cause (if possible) and determines if analysis can continue, identifies alternatives if anomalies cannot be resolved
      • Ensures reproducibility of outcomes.
      • Documents entire analysis process, including business problem, data sources, methods and tools used, project reference, and outcomes.
      • Implements pre-emptive actions, where possible.
  • Project Definition and Coordination:
    • Lead meetings with internal and external customers to clearly articulate and define business problem(s) of medium/high complexity and impact (department/function specific, external customer centric, or part of a corporate project).

      • Applies a whole company perspective, draws upon previous knowledge and experience, and -- where necessary -- researches new/other approaches to identify and agree upon objectives, approach, and success measures.

      • Defines delivery milestones and negotiates timeframes, monitors progress, and periodically notifies customer of status.

    • Works primarily with department heads or function leads to prepare/present findings that are informative and audience appropriate
      • Reviews findings and outcomes with customer, ensures business problem/objectives have been met, and prepares documentation of the analysis
      • Where necessary, manage divergent views in the audience and advises the internal/external customer on any recommendations or options that will facilitate data and analysis driven decision making.
      • Prepares a presentation of the analysis, process followed, and reviews it with the customer to ensure the results are audience appropriate.
  • Performs all other miscellaneous responsibilities and duties as assigned or directed.
    • Trains others on MicroStrategy and Excel.
    • Functions as a team player within the department and embodies collaboration.

Department Summary

University Advancement (UA) supports the University of Oregon’s (UO) mission of providing exceptional teaching, discovery, and service by strategically positioning the university to create awareness, build long-term relationships, and secure resources that increase understanding and further its aims. The division consists of approximately 200 employees primarily working out of Eugene, with offices in Portland and Bend. We are committed to fostering equity and inclusion in a welcoming, safe, and respectful environment that recognizes the value of all members of our community.

The Advancement Strategies and Technology Innovation (ASTI) department is focused on finding the solutions for foundational issues that will best position UO Advancement to achieve its goals around engagement and fundraising. The department has a unique function in that it is based in UO Advancement, but also has strong working partnerships with The Office of Development as part of University Advancement has a mission to maximize philanthropic impact at the University of Oregon. We do this by identifying, connecting and engaging alumni and friends around the globe with their passions to advance the vision and priorities of the university.

Prospect Development is responsible for the implementation of the prospect management system and for the identification of prospects, strategic prospect review and providing intelligence for the purpose of aiding development officers in optimizing portfolios and fundraising to their highest capacity. This department's work is critical to the future success of fundraising at the University of Oregon and the Advancement initiative to identify the next generation of philanthropic leaders. Prospect Development collaborates with each development team and the department as a whole to promote a systematic and quantifiable framework through which development staff manage relationships and to analyze and identify prospects and related strategies.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Associate Director of Prospect Development, the Prospect Management Analyst audits and tracks prospect records while maintaining data integrity throughout the pipeline. Using a comprehensive knowledge of the Prospect Management System, this position reviews and revises policies, procedures, and reports, and engages key stakeholders in discussions and system review. In addition, this position conducts analytics and produces reports on prospect management data that provide essential information to development leadership and stakeholders about development activities and fundraiser performance.

With a customer service focus, the Prospect Management Analyst communicates, provides information, and strategizes with frontline fundraisers and their assistants on a regular basis. This position provides hands-on instruction for data input and information retrieval and plays an integral role in training fundraisers and Advancement staff on Prospect Management System policies.

The ideal candidate for this position will develop an in-depth knowledge of University Advancement’s donor database system that allows them to maintain data integrity by auditing their own work and that of colleagues. This position provides key services to constituents within the department and uses data visualization and analysis to provide information that informs department strategies and metrics. The Prospect Management Analyst should be able to work collaboratively, think independently, and work effectively with a variety of constituents and stakeholders. A PM Analyst that would thrive in this position is one who is detail oriented, enjoys working with large datasets, and can find patterns and impacts within the data to formulate a story of information.

College level courses in statistics (at least six quarter hours); research methods and techniques (e.g., research

design, sampling, surveying, etc.); and computer software application or packages (e.g., Statistical Analyses System, Lotus 1-2-3, etc.);

OR

Three years of experience assisting with the gathering, compiling, analyzing, and reporting of research information and statistical data plus assisting with the drafting of this information into narrative or statistical reports

OR

An equivalent combination of training and experience.

Transcripts must be submitted for all required and/or related courses.

Professional Competencies


Ability to gain in-depth knowledge of a complex database system, including an understanding of how to use, support, modify and train others in the use of database systems.
Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Excel and Word.
Ability to exercise independent judgment, as well as operate as a productive team member.
Ability and willingness to work in an environment of frequent interruptions and competing priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including a willingness to proactively reach out to constituents and colleagues in person, via phone, and email.
Ability to build strong relationships with constituents, including developing rapport and trust.
Ability to interpret, analyze, and visualize data.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and adhere to the highest ethical standards.
Ability to interact, communicate, and work effectively with individuals, recognizing and respecting the many and varied identities of each person.
Commitment to promoting and enhancing diversity, equity, and inclusion.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience providing training on complex systems and/or internal policies and procedures.

Title: Data Analyst, Enterprise Data Governance Team
Description:
Job Details

Job Description:

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in transforming Intel's enterprise data ecosystem and enabling data-driven decision-making? As a Data Analyst on the Enterprise Data Governance Team, you will help improve Intel's business performance by applying data analysis, governance operations, process execution, and measurement practices to complex enterprise data challenges.

In addition to domain analytics responsibilities, this role serves as a key execution partner to EDGT. The role supports the operationalization of enterprise data governance decisions, standards, controls, and processes across one or more data domains. The role is expected to engage across multiple enterprise data domains over time to support consistent governance execution, adoption, and maturity.

This position acts as a bridge between business stakeholders, EDGT, domain owners, data stewards, architecture teams, platform teams, and development teams. The role translates governance decisions into executable actions, supports fit-gap and readiness assessments, manages governance work visibility, and helps ensure standards are adopted and sustained across the enterprise.

The role will also support Governance Operations, Platform, and JIRA responsibilities within the proposed EDGT capability-based model. This includes EDGT operations, JIRA/work tracking, tooling roadmap coordination, capacity visibility, operating rhythm support, templates, documentation, and process orchestration. A critical part of this role is the development and ongoing measurement of data governance metrics that help Intel track progress on its enterprise data governance journey during IAO and beyond. The successful candidate will help define, maintain, and improve governance KPIs, scorecards, maturity indicators, adoption measures, and value-realization metrics that show how governance is progressing across domains, where gaps remain, and where leadership attention is needed.

Key Responsibilities Include


Support execution and adoption of Enterprise-approved data governance standards, guidelines, controls, procedures, and decision frameworks.
Support Governance Operations, Platform, and JIRA activities, including work tracking, backlog visibility, status reporting, dependency tracking, capacity views, templates, and operating rhythm support.
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve data governance metrics, KPI frameworks, dashboards, scorecards, and maturity measures.
Track governance progress during IAO and ongoing enterprise transformation, including adoption of standards, data quality outcomes, stewardship engagement, metadata maturity, issue remediation, and governance value realization.
Provide executive-ready reporting and insights that show governance progress, risks, trends, gaps, and recommended actions.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities that drive business insights and operational improvements.
Gather business and technical requirements and translate them into actionable data specifications, governance requirements, and execution plans.
Perform fit-gap analyses, readiness assessments, and risk assessments of data systems, processes, and domains to evaluate alignment with EDGT-approved governance standards.
Serve as the day-to-day bridge between EDGT, domains, architecture, tooling, stewardship, and execution teams.
Partner with domain, architecture, platform, and business teams to translate governance decisions into sustained practices and measurable outcomes.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in a related field such as data science, information systems, supply chain, material science, industrial engineering, business analytics, or a related discipline.
3+ years of relevant experience in data governance, data quality, data processes, business analysis, operations, and technology-enabled process improvement.
Experience analyzing complex datasets and translating insights into business recommendations.
Experience working across business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements, document processes, clarify ownership, and support execution.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, metrics, or KPI measurements.
Experience with JIRA or similar work-management tools to track work items, owners, status, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to perform fit-gap analysis, readiness assessment, risk identification, or implementation support for data, process, or system changes.
Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, organization, and follow-through skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering, information systems, data science, business analytics, or a related field with 2+ years of relevant experience.
Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Python.
Experience with business intelligence, reporting, dashboarding, data visualization, and executive-level performance reporting.
Experience developing enterprise KPI frameworks, governance scorecards, maturity models, value-realization reporting, or adoption metrics.
Familiarity with data governance, master data management, metadata management, data lineage, data quality, data stewardship, or governance operating models.
Knowledge of Intel's Product Life Cycle, supply chain planning, manufacturing execution, product architecture, planning BOM, or dependent planning and execution processes.
Familiarity with tools such as Collibra, Informatica, JIRA, Confluence, SAP, LRP, Atlas, or related governance, workflow, and enterprise data platforms.
Ability to influence stakeholders, structure ambiguous work, drive execution, and communicate governance progress in a clear, measurable, business-focused way.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Ignite Your Potential. Impact What Matters.

Hi, we’re HUB – a network of doers with diverse stories and a shared goal to support our clients and communities. To do it, we believe in supporting each other, because great work happens when people come together, and that means building a team where anyone can spark an idea, and where everyone can make a difference. Where pushing ourselves forward helps us give more to others.

When you partner with us, you’re at the center of a vast network of risk, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management specialists that bring clarity to a changing world with tailored solutions and unrelenting advocacy – so you’re ready for tomorrow.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly skilled Data Analyst with strong, hands-on experience in Applied Epic and Power BI to join our team. This role is central to maintaining, structuring, and leveraging data from Applied Epic to support operational decision-making, business performance tracking, and strategic initiatives across the organization. The successful candidate will take ownership of data quality metrics, build and maintain Power BI reporting infrastructure, develop Epic automation, and drive system efficiencies. Demonstrated expertise in Applied Epic's data structure and reporting capabilities, combined with advanced Power BI skills, is essential to success in this role. This is a great opportunity for someone who is detail-oriented, analytical, and excited about transforming insurance and brokerage data into actionable, visual business intelligence.

What You'll Do


Extract, analyze, and interpret data directly from Applied Epic, using advanced knowledge of its data structure, tables, and relationships to support business reporting and analytics
Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that present KPIs and operational metrics to stakeholders at all levels of the organization
Develop and manage data models and ETL processes connecting Applied Epic to Power BI, ensuring scalable, reliable, and efficient reporting solutions
Build and maintain Epic automation (including VBA-based tools and scripts) to streamline data extraction, reduce manual processes, and improve system efficiency
Establish and enforce data quality and validation processes to ensure accuracy and consistency across all Applied Epic-sourced reports and downstream systems
Write and optimize queries (SQL and/or Epic-native reporting tools) to support ad hoc and recurring reporting needs
Partner with underwriting, finance, operations, and leadership teams to gather reporting requirements and translate them into effective Power BI solutions
Support projects involving the migration, integration, or optimization of Applied Epic data with other business platforms (e.g., finance systems, CRM, data warehouses)
Maintain documentation of data definitions, report logic, and dashboard structures to support long-term data governance

Department Summary

University Advancement (UA) supports the University of Oregon’s (UO) mission of providing exceptional teaching, discovery, and service by strategically positioning the university to create awareness, build long-term relationships, and secure resources that increase understanding and further its aims. The division consists of approximately 200 employees primarily working out of Eugene, with offices in Portland and Bend. We are committed to fostering equity and inclusion in a welcoming, safe, and respectful environment that recognizes the value of all members of our community.

The Advancement Strategies and Technology Innovation (ASTI) department is focused on finding the solutions for foundational issues that will best position UO Advancement to achieve its goals around engagement and fundraising. The department has a unique function in that it is based in UO Advancement, but also has strong working partnerships with The Office of Development as part of University Advancement has a mission to maximize philanthropic impact at the University of Oregon. We do this by identifying, connecting and engaging alumni and friends around the globe with their passions to advance the vision and priorities of the university.

Prospect Development is responsible for the implementation of the prospect management system and for the identification of prospects, strategic prospect review and providing intelligence for the purpose of aiding development officers in optimizing portfolios and fundraising to their highest capacity. This department's work is critical to the future success of fundraising at the University of Oregon and the Advancement initiative to identify the next generation of philanthropic leaders. Prospect Development collaborates with each development team and the department as a whole to promote a systematic and quantifiable framework through which development staff manage relationships and to analyze and identify prospects and related strategies.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Associate Director of Prospect Development, the Prospect Management Analyst audits and tracks prospect records while maintaining data integrity throughout the pipeline. Using a comprehensive knowledge of the Prospect Management System, this position reviews and revises policies, procedures, and reports, and engages key stakeholders in discussions and system review. In addition, this position conducts analytics and produces reports on prospect management data that provide essential information to development leadership and stakeholders about development activities and fundraiser performance.

With a customer service focus, the Prospect Management Analyst communicates, provides information, and strategizes with frontline fundraisers and their assistants on a regular basis. This position provides hands-on instruction for data input and information retrieval and plays an integral role in training fundraisers and Advancement staff on Prospect Management System policies.

The ideal candidate for this position will develop an in-depth knowledge of University Advancement’s donor database system that allows them to maintain data integrity by auditing their own work and that of colleagues. This position provides key services to constituents within the department and uses data visualization and analysis to provide information that informs department strategies and metrics. The Prospect Management Analyst should be able to work collaboratively, think independently, and work effectively with a variety of constituents and stakeholders. A PM Analyst that would thrive in this position is one who is detail oriented, enjoys working with large datasets, and can find patterns and impacts within the data to formulate a story of information.

Minimum Requirements

College level courses in statistics (at least six quarter hours); research methods and techniques (e.g., research

design, sampling, surveying, etc.); and computer software application or packages (e.g., Statistical Analyses System, Lotus 1-2-3, etc.);

OR

Three years of experience assisting with the gathering, compiling, analyzing, and reporting of research information and statistical data plus assisting with the drafting of this information into narrative or statistical reports

OR

An equivalent combination of training and experience.

Transcripts must be submitted for all required and/or related courses.

Professional Competencies


Ability to gain in-depth knowledge of a complex database system, including an understanding of how to use, support, modify and train others in the use of database systems.
Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Excel and Word.
Ability to exercise independent judgment, as well as operate as a productive team member.
Ability and willingness to work in an environment of frequent interruptions and competing priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including a willingness to proactively reach out to constituents and colleagues in person, via phone, and email.
Ability to build strong relationships with constituents, including developing rapport and trust.
Ability to interpret, analyze, and visualize data.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and adhere to the highest ethical standards.
Ability to interact, communicate, and work effectively with individuals, recognizing and respecting the many and varied identities of each person.
Commitment to promoting and enhancing diversity, equity, and inclusion.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience providing training on complex systems and/or internal policies and procedures.
Experience with Salesforce CRM database..
Experience with Tableau or other data visualization software.
Experience working in higher education development.
Experience in developing and maintaining policies and procedures.

All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Back up for Process Assistant duties

1+ years of project management experience

Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
Lynden Door in Lynden, WA has an immediate opening for a Reporting Analyst. At Lynden Door we strive to be a relational company that provides world class industry leading quality, value, service, and innovation.

Role Overview

The Reporting Analyst supports business leaders and core team members by maintaining costing, price guides and other sales tools, and by providing timely and accurate reporting and analysis of business operations. The Reporting Analyst will have the opportunity to build momentum in our ongoing transformation of data and enhancing our platforms and business processes.

Do you love turning raw numbers into decisions that actually move a business? We're looking for a Reporting Analyst to be a go-to person for pricing, costing, and performance data across our organization. If you are someone who is confident writing SQL queries and leveraging PowerBI, finds real satisfaction in clean data, performs reasoned analysis, and appreciates high-functioning excel-based business tools, read on!

Hours: Full-time, in-office, 8:00- 5:00 Monday to Friday.

Responsibilities


Perform margin and pricing analysis to support key business initiatives.
Own and maintain Costing Books alongside Estimating, Sales, and Purchasing.
Manage Residential price books — including deep-dive margin and price gap reviews.
Manage Commercial/Architectural Price Guides and multipliers.
Leverage Power BI to create and maintain production reporting.
Work with a broad range of stakeholders to understand and document their data needs.
Establish and maintain connections between data sources and solutions.
Employ reporting and data modeling best practices.
Partner with stakeholders across the company to understand and document their data needs.
Work with Production to build consistent costing methodologies for material, labor, and freight.
Surface margin performance trends tied to mix shifts and volume commitments.
Build ad-hoc reports and dig into data issues — researching root causes, correcting master data, and documenting solutions.
Maintain department KPIs and help evolve how the whole team experiences reporting.


What You Bring


Knowledge and experience writing SQL and leveraging PowerBI.
Strong organizational skills and sharp attention to detail.
A problem-solving, analytical mindset.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive data.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust across teams and cultures.
A collaborative, service-minded approach to work.


Role

What Makes This Role Rewarding for a Data-Minded Person:


You'll own the numbers that matter. From margin analysis to KPI tracking, your work shapes pricing strategy and business decisions — not just reporting after the fact.
Variety. Solving pricing puzzles, investigating data discrepancies, and translating findings into action across multiple business functions.
Excel is your playground. This role rewards advanced Excel skills — building, modeling, and collaborating at a level that goes well beyond most user's knowledge and ability.

Title: ERP Data Specialist
Description:
Who We Are

Price Industries Limited, North America’s leading manufacturer and distributor of air distribution products (www.priceindustries.com). The founding principles of Price have never changed – business integrity, first-class service, innovation and a commitment to people. Our dependable quality, reliable delivery, and knowledgeable follow-up service have made Price a market leader in supplying air distribution, critical controls, and noise control products.

After more than 60 years, Price remains a privately held family company with a deep heritage and commitment to innovation and service. Our long-standing vision, values, and the Price way of doing business are the cornerstones of our success.

We are a dynamic, progressive and innovative organization looking for new talent in our growing Winnipeg manufacturing facility. If you thrive on new challenges, and working in a friendly, team-driven environment, you should consider the following opportunity.

What You Can Expect


Health and Dental - Employees and their families enjoy paid benefits covering an extensive list of medical and dental expenses and services.
Manulife Virtual Pharmacy - Access pharmacy services anytime, anywhere through the Manulife app, with eligible prescriptions delivered directly to your home.
Manulife Mental Health and Counselling Services - Access confidential mental health and wellness support through the Manulife app, with convenient options to book counselling, consultations, and guided programs all in one place.
Life and Disability - You will be provided with life insurance in a multiple of your salary with an option to purchase additional coverage.
Pension Matching Program - Invest in your future with each pay cheque through our Defined Contribution Pension Plan and we will match your contribution (up to 3% of your salary).
Wellness Reimbursement Program - Employees are eligible for a fitness centre or club membership reimbursement of up to $300 per year, this includes Fitness related App’s.
Personal and Professional Development - We are committed to helping you reach your potential through training and education.
Community Involvement - Generously supporting health, charities, youth, and education opportunities is our passion, and you’re invited to be a part of that.
Our convenient Price Café offers free Tea and Coffee.


Purpose

Serve as the primary point of contact for ERP data and reporting at the site, ensuring alignment between corporate data strategy and plant operations by supporting data accessibility, reporting continuity, and informed decision making throughout the IFS ERP implementation.

The Successful Candidate's Responsibilities Will Include

Data Consultation & Navigation


Support the data domain throughout the ongoing IFS ERP implementation, ensuring all data-related activities contribute toward the final goal of system commissioning.
Guide users through the organization's data landscape, helping users locate specific data points, dashboards, and KPI information within existing systems.
Consult with business units to support users understand available data resources.
Serve as the liaison between the corporate data team and plant users, translating data strategies into actionable operational insights.
Provide expert guidance to users on data accessibility, ensuring users have timely access to the information required to support informed operational and business decision-making.


Reporting Continuity & Analysis


Gather, interpret, and document reports from existing systems to ensure the new IFS platform delivers equivalent or enhanced reporting capabilities post-implementation.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and anomalies, translating technical data into meaningful insights that reflect real-world manufacturing conditions.
Develop a deep understanding of where data originates and what it represents in a production environment.


Data Triage & Corporate Alignment


Proactively identify, analyze, and triage all data-related requests from users, assessing their scope, impact, and urgency.
Provide timely support for data and reporting requests within the capabilities of the existing platform whenever possible.
Collaborate with the corporate team to evaluate complex data requirements or system gaps, escalating issues as needed to ensure proposed solutions align with enterprise standards and maintain KPI consistency across all plants.
Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to understand their specific data requirements and ensure the requirements are met during and after the IFS commissioning.


Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess:


Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Proven experience in data analysis, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
Experience working in an IFS environment is considered an asset.
Strong proficiency in reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel) and an ability to learn new ERP data structures quickly.
Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to "connect the dots" between data and real-life operations.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a service-oriented mindset to support and train non-technical users.
Ability to triage requests, manage multiple priorities, and act as a bridge between plant needs and corporate standards.
Self-motivated with a strong willingness to learn new business processes and data systems.
Strong affiliation with Price’s core values


Should this excellent opportunity interest you, please submit your resume, including salary expectations.

We appreciate the interest shown by all applicants, however only those being considered for an interview will be contacted.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

Description:
Description -

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. This position sits at the intersection of analytics, data quality, product data stewardship, monthly reporting operations, and forecasting enablement. In this role, you will partner closely with data engineers, data scientists, and the supplies forecasting teams to ensure data processing pipeline integrity, maintain key business reference and enrichment data, and automate data verification and acceptance processes.

Responsibilities


Own and support monthly validation processes for print telemetry outputs, dashboard semantic layers, and related usage/share reporting handoffs
Serve as a key analytical partner for Forecasting and business stakeholders, helping answer usage, share, installed base, product readiness, and release approval questions through structured analysis and clear communication
Develop and maintain automated and well-documented processes that support recurring validation, issue diagnosis, data quality checks, and stakeholder decision-making
Conduct root-cause analysis on data discrepancies across sources, grains, tables, dashboards, and processing layers, especially where definitions, filters, platform coverage, or reporting timing create mismatches
Provide consultative support for quick-turn ad hoc requests, escalation support, and deep-dive investigations while helping route work through the appropriate intake, prioritization, and transition processes
Collaborate with dashboard, data engineering, and business intelligence partners to improve transparency, repeatability, and maintainability of analytics outputs
Provides guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members
Applies advanced subject matter knowledge, leads, and contributes to complex projects, and exercises independent judgment in resolving business issues and establishing policies
Develops and builds productive internal/external working relationships and may provide mentoring and guidance to lower-level employees


Education & Experience Recommended


Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field.


Knowledge & Skills


Analytics and problem solving: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, metric design, data validation, anomaly detection, and ability to diagnose complex data issues across multiple factors
Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, documentation, data lineage, privacy awareness, and the ability to communicate quality risks and remediation paths
Business intelligence and visualization: experience with Power BI, Qlik, advanced Excel, or similar tools to build stakeholder-ready dashboards, analyses, and presentations
Python for data analysis, validation, automation, time-series analysis, reproducible workflows, and tooling to support recurring quality checks and investigations
SQL, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
Databricks and modern analytics tooling: ability to work in notebooks, queries, dashboard-supporting datasets, and AI-assisted development environments while maintaining reproducible and reviewable outputs
Forecasting and time-series: ability to support forecasting partners, interpret restatements and metric volatility, and contribute to forecasting automation or time-series analysis workflows
Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation (role-dependent)
Strong documentation habits for code and process development, data analyses and investigations, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance. Familiar with version control (e.g., Git), Jira, and Confluence


Cross-Org Skills


Effective Communication
Results Orientation
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency
Customer Centricity


Impact & Scope


Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives.


Complexity


Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors.

Description:

Position Summary:

As an HSE Data & Analytics Specialist, responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing digital tools, software solutions, automations, and data systems that support Health, Safety, and Environmental programs. This role is responsible for developing and managing digital tools, data systems, and analytics that support Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) programs. The position serves as the bridge between HSE and technology, driving automation, data integrity, reporting, and decision-making through dashboards, applications, and system integrations.

• Participate in the development and rollout of digital training modules.

• Support major projects by creating digital tools for risk assessments, JSEAs, LOTO libraries, and high‑risk task workflows.

• Ensure HSE digital tools follow IT and cybersecurity protocols.

• Other responsibilities as assigned

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field.

• Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI

• Must possess the ability to think and analyze situations in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to be innovative, initiate and manage change, and deliver results.

• Strong written and oral communication and interpersonal skills are essential, most importantly strong team-building skills within a rapidly growing environment.

• Must be capable of positively influencing the management team when necessary.

• Independent, detail-oriented, creative, tenacious, and flexible are essential characteristics.




• 2+ years programming experience or digital system administration

• Experience working with HSE teams or in industrial safety settings (preferred).

As a Data Analyst on Kwik Trip’s IT Data Services team, you will develop reporting solutions and dashboards that help business teams make informed decisions. Title: Database Reporting Specialist
Description:
The Montana State University Alumni Foundation is seeking an objective, detail-oriented Database Reporting Analyst to join our collaborative team in a flexible hybrid or remote role. In this position, you will be producing accurate, dependable data and meaningful insights that help strengthen lifelong relationships, support fundraising efforts, and advance the mission of Montana State University.

This opportunity is well suited for someone who values technical precision, thoughtful problem-solving, and the autonomy to improve processes and deliver trusted results. You will have the chance to apply your analytical expertise to work with a clear purpose, while contributing to a supportive team that values accuracy, sound judgment, continuous improvement, and the important role data plays in building relationships and inspiring private support.

Administrator: Director, Reporting & Analytics

Preferred Experience: 2+ years of experience in SQL programming and SQL Server databases; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Education Required: Baccalaureate Degree in computer science, computer engineering, information systems / technology, or related Degree with relevant experience.

Overtime Status: Exempt, not eligible for overtime

FTE and Benefits: 1.0 FTE, eligible for full employment benefits

Location: Remote or flexible hybrid schedule available.

Preferred Start Date: Sept 15, 2026

Major Duties And Responsibilities

The Database Reporting Analyst for the Montana State University Alumni Foundation (“Alumni Foundation”) is primarily responsible for fulfillment of targeted data and report requests from both external Montana State University (“University”) partners, and internal Alumni Foundation team members. The Database Reporting Analyst reports to the Director, Reporting & Analytics, Advancement Services Team.

Anticipated Distribution Of Time And Effort Are Outlined Below

30%

Manage and fulfill data and information requests from University partners and internal Alumni Foundation team members.

30%

Develop ad hoc and self-serve reports.

20%

Design/Maintain/Perform regular data extract, transform, and load operations (“ETL”) using SQL Server Integration Services (“SSIS”).

20%

Other duties including but not limited to: Business process development & SOPs Documentation. Assist in data hygiene and maintenance.

Specific Duties And Responsibilities


Assist with data and information requests (i.e. list requests) to external University partners and manage all request-related communications.
Assist with data and report requests by collaborating with other members of the Advancement Services team.
Provide quality assurance for reporting outputs by validating data accuracy, reviewing query logic, documenting assumptions, and ensuring appropriate handling of confidential constituent, donor, and institutional information.
Collaborate on reporting and integration-related work involving SQL Server, Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services, Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services, and other reporting or data tools used by the Alumni Foundation.
Develop, document, and disseminate targeted best practices and standard operating procedures (“SOP’s”) related to the fulfillment of targeted data and information requests from the Alumni Foundation database.
Support database management and data cleanup procedures by identifying data quality issues and recommending corrective actions.
Implement existing procedures and develop new SQL-based queries and procedures to fulfill targeted data requests, reporting needs, and data ETLs.
Utilize Visual Studio for various development tasks and integrating with SSRS projects.
Identify database-related improvement opportunities and collaborate with members of the Advancement Services team to develop and implement solutions.
Affect and maintain a professional, proactive, positive, highly collaborative, and performance-centric work environment.
Other duties, as assigned by the Director, Reporting & Analytics.


Duties and responsibilities may change at any time.

Special Skills And Qualifications


Understanding of and experience with the SQL Server query development and the Microsoft SQL Server/BI stack, including SSMS, Visual Studio Data Tools, SSRS, SSIS, complex joins, stored procedures, query validation, and performance considerations.
General programming and database administration experience helpful.
Experience developing documentation, SOPs, data definitions, reporting standards, and quality-control practices.
Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment while remaining helpful, pleasant, and courteous.
Complete respect for confidentiality and sound judgment in handling sensitive constituent, donor, institutional, and partner data.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, analytical judgment, and commitment to data accuracy.
Experience developing and maintaining solutions using Microsoft Power Platform components (Power BI Desktop, Power Automate, and Power Apps) is a plus.


Benefits

The MSU Alumni Foundation offers a comprehensive benefit package which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance (all of which are 90-100% employer-paid for employee-only coverage), 403(b) retirement plan with 7% employer contribution after 1-yr anniversary, up to 5 weeks’ paid time-off, 11 paid holidays, tuition assistance and more.

Applications And Recruitment

Qualified candidates should submit a cover letter, a resume, and three professional references online. Recruitment will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. Compensation will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

The MSU Alumni Foundation is an equal employment opportunity employer who believes that diversity, equity and inclusion allow us to better serve our students and communities and are critical to supporting the mission of Montana State University as a land grant institution.

As part of the Mars Petcare family of businesses, Mars Veterinary Health is a global network of veterinary practices made possible by 75,000 Associates who care for millions of pets across nearly 3,000 clinics in more than 20 countries each year. We are committed to leveraging our reach to make a long-term positive impact on people, pets, and the planet and know our Purpose – A BETTER WORLD FOR PETS – starts with the people who care for them. We strive to offer unparalleled veterinary care for pets by first and foremost enabling and empowering our Associates to do what they love, whether in primary, specialty, and emergency care or management and leadership.

This role requires associates to work out of a MVH Hub location in Santa Monica, CA | Tampa, FL | Vancouver, WA.

Why This Role Matters

Build and maintain data pipeline, complex dashboards and create data-driven insights on MVH Commercial strategic initiatives while understanding our fundamental business drivers. Analyze, scope, develop and implement standard reporting/dashboards & analytics, working with various MVH Business Units.

Be one of the primary points of contact on Purchasing/Commercial data for MVH, supporting end users and maintaining data governance.

You Will


Design, manage and maintain global spend cube by bringing in all procurement data from all BUs so our teams can use them to look for opportunities and make strategic decisions and drive value
Support and maintain Procurement system (OrderRight), strategic sourcing management system and inventory solution by ensuring data is current, the systems are working appropriately and assisting end users with questions and/or troubleshooting issues.
Decompose high-level business and user requirements into functional requirements, identifying the data needs, creating dashboards and analytics, and communicating results to management and project teams.
Extract data from different source systems, draw key insights, and produce clear and concise reporting and analytics.
Lead cross-functional and cross BU teams in managing team-based projects by scoping work, clarifying dependencies on others, and completing projects in a timely manner, documenting processes along the way.
Create and maintain metrics dashboards (e.g. P2P, price exception, contract pricing etc.) for all MVH BUs so Procurement and Finance team can help drive purchasing and invoicing efficiencies.
Build tools using approved technologies to manage our savings intake, tracking and reporting
Understand our COGS, identify inventory cost reduction opportunities, making recommendations to automate and streamline inventory forecasting and procedures.
Contribute to strategic planning, analysis activities and documentation of inventory & supply chain management projects.
Provide necessary training to all the sourcing and buying-ops team on various tools and technology to do their job efficiently and effectively
Helps bring in innovative ideas using AI technology unlocking new possibilities for the broader Commercial team and MVH business overall
Other job duties as assigned.

Required 3-4 years’ of experience writing and optimizing queries using Oracle SQL or similar SQL-based databases, with solid working knowledge of the Microsoft technology stack.
Preferred 1+ years’ experience in using DAX Power BI functions, AI driven analytics, PowerApps & Power Automate* or the equivalent combination of education, training and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities

Fertility and family-building assistance.

Practice Paid Basic Life Insurance.
Practice Paid Short- and Long-Term Disability.

A Variety of discounts including Mars, PetSmart, Royal Canin, fitness, cellular and so much more.

Ability to work at a computer for long periods of time.

Title: Big Data Laser Analyst
Description:
Description -

Job Summary


We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. In this role, you will translate consumer and enterprise print telemetry into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable insights, with a primary focus on laser printer data. You will partner closely with data engineers and data scientists to improve data reliability, define KPI and metric semantics, and influence cross-functional decisions through clear data storytelling.


Responsibilities


Own laser print telemetry business insights for the Print Supplies organization, from problem framing and metric definition through analysis, visualization, and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, translate business questions into analytical requirements, define critical KPIs, and deliver insights that drive decisions.
Provide consultative support and ad hoc analyses with clear hypotheses, methods, and assumptions; produce reusable queries, datasets, and shareable outputs with documented limitations.
Collaborate with internal and external partners to align on telemetry instrumentation, data collection methodology, and platform differences to ensure consistent interpretation across printer platforms.
Investigate data quality issues (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), perform root-cause analysis across pipelines and sources, and communicate impacts and remediation paths with appropriate caveats.
Enable self-service analytics by documenting dashboards and KPI definitions, and coach users on correct interpretation and common pitfalls.
Design and maintain measurement frameworks (e.g., adoption, usage, retention, share, funnel/driver analyses); when applicable, support experiment or pre/post evaluation and interpret results for stakeholders.
Create clear narratives through written summaries, presentations, and recurring reporting that highlight trends, drivers, risks, and recommended actions for leadership and partner teams.
Provide guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members.
Solve difficult and complex problems with a fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently.
Lead moderate to high complexity projects, delivering professionally written reports, and supports the realization of operational and strategic plans.


Education & Experience Recommended


Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.


Preferred Certifications


Programming Language/s Certification (SQL, Python, or similar)


Knowledge & Skills


Analytics: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, and KPI design
SQL: complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
Python (and/or PySpark) for analysis, data validation, and automation. Familiar with VSCode and Databricks Ideally
Ability to interpret telemetry and pipeline outputs in business context, including communicating uncertainty and known limitations
Comfort working across multiple data sources/layers and explaining differences in source-of-truth, grain, and transformations
Comfort with modern analytics tooling (including AI-assisted development) while maintaining reproducibility and reviewable outputs
Dashboarding & data visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, advanced excel / PowerPoint or similar; ability to build stakeholder-ready reporting
Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, and documentation
Strong documentation habits for metric definitions, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance; familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) a plus. Familiar with Jira and Confluence.
Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation


Cross-Org Skills


Effective Communication
Results Orientation
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency
Customer Centricity
Collaboration across technical and non-technical teams


Impact & Scope


Impacts function by providing analytics and data quality validation that supports business-critical reporting and stakeholder decision-making for laser telemetry KPIs
Serves as a key point of contact for laser telemetry interpretation and investigation requests, partnering across teams to drive consistent definitions and reliable use of outputs


Complexity


Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.


Salary

The pay range for this role is $83,000 to $127,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:


Health insurance
Dental insurance
Vision insurance
Long term/short term disability insurance
Employee assistance program
Flexible spending account
Life insurance
Generous time off policies, including;
4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
11 paid holidays
Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview)

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Position Summary: Data Engineer 




In this role, you will own data at TerraFirma. Not a slice of it. Not the reporting piece. All of it: where it comes from, what shape it is in, where it lives, and whether it can be trusted. You are the person who makes data actionable for the business. 










You will work closely with our Full Stack Developer on pipeline and integration work, and directly with business stakeholders to understand what they need to make decisions. You will spend a significant portion of your time cleaning, validating, and transforming data so that when a report goes in front of a leader, the numbers are right and the story is clear. If you are the kind of person who gets bothered by a broken data feed, who cannot leave a messy schema alone, and who gets satisfaction from turning chaos into something someone can actually use: this role is for you.










Key Responsibilities




Data Quality and Integrity





Identifying, investigating, and resolving data quality issues across all connected systems


Building and maintaining validation frameworks so bad data gets caught before it reaches reports


Establishing and documenting data standards, naming conventions, and transformation rules


Being the person stakeholders call when the numbers do not match





Data Lake and Pipeline Work





Managing data ingestion into the data lake from multiple source systems


Designing and maintaining transformation pipelines that produce clean, structured, report-ready data


Collaborating with the Full Stack Developer on integration design where pipelines connect to application logic


Monitoring pipeline health, catching failures early, and keeping things running





Reporting and Analytics





Building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards that get used, not shelved


Working directly with stakeholders to translate business questions into data models and visualizations


Owning the reporting layer: if a report is wrong, stale, or confusing, that is your problem to fix


Surfacing insights proactively, not just waiting to be asked





Data Architecture and Documentation





Contributing to the ongoing design of TerraFirma's data lake architecture


Documenting data sources, schemas, transformation logic, and lineage so the team is not dependent on tribal knowledge


Partnering with IT leadership on the long-term data strategy for the organization











Experience and Education Requirements





3+ years working in a data-focused role with real ownership of data quality and reporting


Demonstrated ability to take messy, inconsistent source data and produce something clean and trustworthy


Strong SQL: not just SELECT statements, but complex joins, window functions, and performance tuning


Power BI proficiency: you have built reports that people actually use to make decisions


Python for data work: scripting, transformation, automation


Clear communicator: you can explain a data discrepancy to a finance leader without making it a technical lecture


Microsoft Environment






Power BI: advanced report and dashboard development, DAX, data modeling, and row-level security


Azure: Data Factory, Blob Storage, Synapse, or equivalent pipeline and lake tooling


Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 / Business Central as primary data source systems


SQL: strong query skills, stored procedures, schema design, and optimization


Beyond Microsoft, we expect:





• ETL/ELT design: you understand the difference, know when to use each, and can build both




• Data lake concepts: partitioning, schema-on-read vs schema-on-write, medallion architecture or equivalent




• Git and version control: your pipelines and transformation logic live in source control, not just in a tool UI




• Power Query / M: for lighter transformations and report-layer data shaping




• Experience with REST APIs and JSON: you will be pulling data from systems that expose APIs, not just databases










This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.










CORE VALUES: AT TERRAFIRMA, OUR VALUES ARE IMPORTANT, WE DON’T JUST TALK ABOUT THEM, WE LIVE THEM. WE ARE LOOKING FOR PEOPLE WHO SHARE OUR VALUES OF FAMILY, INTEGRITY, RESILIENCE, AND MASTERY.










What We Offer:




As a family-oriented company, we provide industry-leading perks and benefits, including:





Competitive Pay 


Medical, Dental, Vision Plans


Paid Holidays & PTO


Short and Long-Term Disability 


401(k) Retirement Plan 


Life Insurance


AD&D Insurance


Wellness Programs 











High school graduate or equivalent required. Applicants must be 21 years or older, as this position involves operating a company vehicle. We are a drug-free workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity (regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status). We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Carrington Group of Companies – Edmonton, AB

Reporting to the Director of Financial Systems & Business Intelligence (FSBI), the AI & Data Analyst will focus on building AI-powered tools to enhance our existing platform and solve financial and operational issues.


This is a fully in-office role, with no hybrid or remote work options available.*

Competitive salary
Comprehensive benefits, including extended health & dental, life and disability insurance, and more
Flexible spending account for additional health and wellness coverage
Company matched RRSP program
Paid training and development programs

Design and build internal AI tools and agents) on top of Microsoft Fabric and company data, using LLM APIs and/or platforms like Copilot Studio or Azure AI Foundry
Write and refine prompts and system instructions for LLM-based tools, and structure inputs/outputs (including retrieval-augmented generation patterns)
Integrate AI tools with existing systems and data sources (Fabric, Business Central, Power BI) via APIs, connectors, or scheduled data flows

Maintain and make incremental improvements to existing Power BI dashboards and reports, including DAX calculations and Power Query (M) transformations
Handle ad-hoc reporting and analysis requests from finance and operations stakeholders
Flag data-quality or structural issues that would affect AI tool reliability

Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business, or a related field
2-4 years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or related analytics/technical role
Hands-on experience building with AI/LLM tools — e.g., OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, or similar — including prompt design and connecting a model to real data or workflows
Comfort writing basic scripts or automations (e.g., Python, Power Automate) to connect tools and data

Microsoft Excel skills, including PowerPivot and formulas

Title: Data Engineer- Analytics
Description:
Old Republic Bitco is seeking a Data Engineer - Analytics to join our Home Office located in Davenport, IA. As a respected specialty insurer with 11 branch offices across 10 states, OR Bitco delivers tailored insurance solutions to complex industries such as construction, forest products, and oil and gas.

This position is open to hybrid work arrangement, blending flexibility with meaningful in-person collaboration.

At OR Bitco, our work is guided by core values. We care deeply about our people, partners, and customers. We are committed to excellence and accountability. We deliver on our promises with integrity and precision, and we strive to make a meaningful impact in everything we do. These values drive our mission to protect the people and industries that keep America running.

Join the OR Bitco team and be part of a workplace built on collaboration, open communication, and a positive culture that supports growth and success. If you are passionate about operational excellence and ready to make a measurable impact within a growing, industry-leading organization, OR Bitco offers the platform and challenge you have been seeking.

Position Summary

In this role, you’ll play a key role in building and maturing the Company's Data Services across all aspects of the organization. This includes recommending and implementing tools for enabling internal business units to leverage data securely, effectively, and efficiently.

You’ll develop high-level data analysis, participating in all stages of development from analysis to production releases, delivering data-driven insights to internal business customers. This is a highly collaborative role focusing on Data Services customer needs through data storytelling and insights while modernizing the analytics role for OR Bitco in a cloud-based environment.

You will be involved in all aspects of data science, engineering, and analytics as the Company instills and matures these capabilities and data discipline throughout the organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Collaborate with Project Managers, Business Leaders, Analysts, and other stakeholders to understand the analysis required in order to form data requirements and develop solutions that meet those needs while accommodating scalable volumes of data
Participate in strategic data and analytics projects to enable our business leaders to consume data in a curated self-service model that leads to impactful insights for key business areas
Integrate and deliver data-driven insights and analysis from multiple sources for internal customers to make decisions relevant to their functional area or across product, program, customer, and risk axis
Develop analysis frameworks to enable agile and quick data insights, while maintaining the quality of the insight, and inform strategy
Partner across all operational and support functions to build scalable data-based solutions that provide insights into improving key metrics/OKRs
Work with business leaders to understand market drivers, OKRs, and products to interpret data and make them comprehensible to understand for other teams
Experience with trend analysis and reviews, drafting executive outlines, and recommending strategic changes based on data insights to non-technical leadership teams
Understanding and Experience in Statistical Modeling, Natural Language Processing, GenAI, AIML modeling
Implement automated data quality checks and validation processes to ensure data integrity and accuracy at scale
Design, build, and maintain robust reporting packages from multiple sources through our data warehouse and analytics marts, ensuring scalability and efficiency
Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of our reporting and analysis system performance and optimize as needed to handle increasing data volumes
Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and reliability across multiple environments (warehouse, data marts, reporting)
Utilize Power BI to create insightful reports, dashboards, and visualizations to provide actionable insights to stakeholders
Troubleshoot data-related issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions in a timely manner to minimize business impact
Create and maintain design documents and documentation for reporting pipelines, semantic models, and processes Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in reporting and data analysis, recommending and implementing improvements as necessary to support scalability and growth
Work closely with various business units and leaders to identify and interpret their data needs, suggesting innovative ways to consume and analyze data
Create reusable templates, such as Power BI semantic models, to empower other data services and IT personnel in their reporting efforts
All other functions and duties as assigned


Qualifications


Legally authorized to work in the United States
3+ years of proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar reporting role, with a strong background in data analysis, reporting and statistics
Proven work experience with a focus on data storytelling, report development and in-depth data analysis
Solid understanding of data reporting models and communication
Proficiency in Power BI or similar reporting tools, SQL, and experience working with relational databases
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and tools, such as Snowflake or Microsoft Synapse
Experience with data modeling, semantic model design, and optimization techniques for scalability
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex data issues
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
Self-motivated and proactive, with a passion for continuous learning and professional development


Benefits


Competitive salary paired with a comprehensive benefits package
Generous paid time off, plus 12 paid holidays annually
Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans
Additional protection through accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance
Company-paid life insurance equal to 2× annual salary
Company-paid short-term and long-term disability coverage
401(k) Savings and Profit-Sharing Plan through Old Republic
Ongoing education, training, and professional development opportunities
Support for industry certifications and insurance designations, including financial assistance
Opportunities to give back through corporate philanthropy and community service initiatives
Optional benefits including travel, commuter, and pet insurance
Employee wellness support through a dedicated fitness program

Amentum is a trusted partner to United States government agencies, allied governments, and corporations worldwide supporting critical programs across a broad range of domains. We are seeking a highly skilled Data Analytics Specialist with 2-5 years of experience in data engineering and analytics. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise with toolsets for data mining, statistical modeling, optimization, and data visualization for the purpose of driving engineering insights.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize scalable data processing applications.
  • Write clean, efficient, and reusable Python code for data engineering and analytics tasks.
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable engineering insights.
  • Implement data transformations, aggregations, and workflows to support analytics and reporting.
  • Ensure high data quality, integrity, and reliability across large-scale datasets.
  • Collaborate with scientists, engineers, analysts, and cross-functional teams to optimize data workflows and integrate solutions into existing systems.
  • Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into effective data solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and uphold high coding standards and best practices.
  • Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in data automation, statistical simulation, and data visualization.

Requirements

  • 2-5 years of hands-on experience in data engineering or analytics roles.
  • Bachelor of Science or advanced degree from an ABET accredited school.
  • Strong proficiency in Python.
