Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: London, ON | Hybrid/Remote | StarTech.com

StarTech.com is continuing to grow our Data Analytics team and we are looking for a Data Analyst who is passionate about turning data into actionable insights.

In this role, you will partner closely with cross functional teams to analyze data across key areas of the business, including product performance, inventory, revenue, customer insights, and marketing. Your work will help shape business decisions, optimize performance, and support continued growth.

You will be responsible for transforming data from multiple sources into clear, meaningful insights, building models, and delivering reporting that informs strategy. Success in this role comes from strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate insights in a way that drives action.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with data tools such as Power BI, Python, R, or Excel, and collaborating with stakeholders to influence outcomes, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Posting this opportunity to support a backfill requirement on the team

What You’ll Do

Analyze key business metrics to evaluate and improve strategic initiatives
Translate data into actionable insights and recommendations
Build data models and generate summary statistics using analytics tools
Develop reports and dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Power BI)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business needs
Communicate insights clearly to stakeholders at all levels
Leverage AI and automation tools to improve efficiency
Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and process optimization

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Technology, or related field (Master’s in Analytics is an asset)
2+ years of experience in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role working with large datasets
Strong experience with Power BI and Power Query
Advanced Excel skills
Intermediate proficiency in Python or R
Experience or interest in AI tools and applications

What Sets You Apart

Strong data cleaning, transformation, and analysis skills
Ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights
Experience building queries, reports, and visualizations
High attention to detail and accuracy
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
A proactive learner who is curious, adaptable, and driven to improve processes

Why Join StarTech.com?

Competitive salary and bonus potential
Comprehensive benefits package
Collaborative and innovative work environment
Opportunities to grow your skills in analytics, BI, and AI

What to expect from the Hiring Process:

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

Intro call with our Talent Acquisition Team (30 minutes)
Assessment (60 minutes)
Interview with the Hiring Manager (45-60 minutes)
Final Interview - Director, Market Research & Analytics (45 minutes)
Offer & onboarding

This role offers a competitive salary range of CAD $68,000 to $78,000 and eligibility to participate in our bonus program. At StarTech.com, we value fairness and regularly benchmark pay to stay competitive, recognizing each person’s unique contributions.

As part of the StarTech.com “One Team,” you’ll also enjoy:

Comprehensive health benefits
Tuition reimbursement program
Retirement savings plans
Wellness Program
Additional perks and rewards

About us

We are in the business of human-centered experiences starting with yours. We believe delivering on our promise of "hard-to-find, made easy" begins with an employee experience founded in opportunity, teamwork, empowerment, and curious minds always asking what if. Not only does our commitment to the exceptional deepen relationships with our partners and customers, it also ignites connection within our team.

StarTech.com is a global leader in tech connectivity solutions, manufacturing a wide range of accessories designed to meet the demanding performance standards of IT professionals and businesses. Since 1985, the company has expanded into 28 markets across five continents, with products trusted by more than 90% of Fortune 500 companies. StarTech.com has been recognized as one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies by Deloitte for 15 consecutive years and is ranked in the top 5% of companies worldwide for sustainability by EcoVadis.

StarTech.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 and the Ontario Human Rights Code, StarTech.com will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment, selection and/or assessment process to applicants with disabilities. If selected to participate in the recruitment, selection and/or assessment process, please inform Human Resources of the nature of any accommodation(s) that you may require in respect of any materials or processes used to ensure your equal participation.

StarTech.com uses AI tools only for administrative support, such as transcribing interview notes and organizing candidate details into standardized prescreening and interview templates. These tools do not screen, rank, or assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by our Talent Acquisition team and Hiring Managers. Candidate information is collected and used solely for recruitment purposes in compliance with applicable privacy laws.

Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward
Manage scope changes and requirements during implementation
Partner with the Product Owner to refine and size the backlog
Maintain oversight of delivery, including scope, timelines, dependencies and expected outcomes
Proactively identify risks, blockers and potential delays, driving mitigation and escalation where required
Define acceptance criteria (Definition of Ready / Definition of Done) and support test planning and UAT


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years' experience as a Business Analyst, ideally on data or reporting products.
Demonstrated experience across the full reporting lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
Experience writing technical user stories and documentation
Ability to understand database schemas, including the relationships between objects and key terminology
Experience gathering requirements from diverse, sometimes non-technical stakeholders, including in situations with unclear requirements or changing priorities
Data profiling experience, including querying and profiling data using SQL
Exposure to a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working within an Agile delivery methodology
Excellent communication skills — confident liaising with stakeholders at all levels, able to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and negotiation skills
Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously, while collaborating closely with the other Data Business Analysts

Nice-to-have


Experience in a retail environment.
Technical data skills: Power BI or other visualization tools
Experience in data visualisation techniques and principles
Awareness of the use of AI to support in the Data BA space


Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Data Services Analyst
Description:
The Data Services Analyst delivers custom data solutions that help DMSi customers maximize the value from their ERP solution. This role works across a broad and growing set of technologies, including custom reporting, business intelligence dashboards, data transformations, and system integrations. The right candidate is execution-focused, intellectually curious, and eager to grow alongside an expanding technology stack. They will bring a strong aptitude for problem-solving, a collaborative mindset, and a genuine interest in using AI tools to work smarter and help the team build more efficient workflows.




RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

Evaluate and manage customer requests using internal systems, including the ability to scope, quote, design a solution, and execute on the project plan.
Develop and deliver custom data solutions, including report writing, data extractions, forms customization, business intelligence dashboards, and system integrations.
Use AI tools and assistants as a standard part of daily work to increase efficiency and contribute to the team’s development of AI-assisted workflows and internal tooling
Build proficiency in DMSi’s evolving product and integration ecosystem, including current and emerging platforms.
Develop and maintain an advanced working knowledge of DMSi’s internal support tools and delivery processes.
Assist other DMSi personnel through escalation support, coaching, and training on data-related topics.
Complete documentation related to job responsibilities and contribute to the DMSi Knowledge Base.
Lead, attend, or assist with training for internal personnel, customers, and prospects.
Assist with internal projects to support departmental and organizational objectives.




KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Technical: SQL/query proficiency (Cyberquery a plus), BI tools (Power BI, Phocas, Tableau, etc.), ETL/data lineage and database fundamentals (schemas, indexes, keys).

Analytical: Genuine curiosity paired with strong problem-solving, research, and the ability to work independently through ambiguous business challenges.

AI-forward: Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Copilot) to speed up and improve work quality.

Quality-focused: High attention to detail, diagnoses issues correctly and validates solutions before customers see them.

Technical collaboration: Familiar with integration/automation (Workato or similar), comfortable with code reviews and tools like GitHub.

Execution: Prioritizes well, works under pressure, hits deadlines.

People skills: Communicates clearly, builds relationships across all levels (including customers/vendors), exercises tact and keeps confidentiality.




EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

College degree in Data Science, Computer Information Systems (CIS), Management Information Systems (MIS), Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related discipline preferred; 3-5 years of equivalent work experience in a relevant field will be considered.




WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Normal office environment with use of computers and telephone systems; no unusual physical demands.

Travel as needed, including business air travel and car rental.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Title: Finance Data Analyst – Financial Planning & Analysis
Description:
Alberta Blue Cross® is an Alberta based organization dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experience and community leadership. We’re committed to providing the best health coverage to over 1.8 million members and take an active role in promoting wellness. We believe in what we do—and place trust in our employees to deliver our vision.

Working at Alberta Blue Cross® means having a career where you’ll be recognized for your contributions. We value diversity, encourage our team members to maintain a healthy work-life balance and provide opportunities for career growth.

OVERVIEW:

Alberta Blue Cross is looking for a Finance Data Analyst to join our Financial Planning & Analysis team. Reporting to the Manager, Finance Intelligence and Analytics, the Data Analyst will be quality focused, passionate, a quick learner, self-motivated, analytical and detail oriented. They will ensure a high caliber of data quality and will support and collaborate with the other data teams in the organization. In this flexible work style arrangement, you will be able to work from home and go into office when required.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:


Collect and extract financial and operational data from internal systems and external sources.
Clean, validate, and prepare datasets to ensure accuracy and reliability for analysis.
Develop financial reports and analytics to support business and finance decision-making.
Interpret data trends and explain insights, variances, and findings to the finance team.
Participate in finance data projects, automation, and system enhancements.
Collaborate with Enterprise IT and analytics teams to create and maintain data pipelines and data governance for finance.
Support the maintenance of financial data models, metrics, and reporting tools.
Ensure adherence to data quality standards and contribute to continuous improvement.



WHAT YOU WILL HAVE:


Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
3 years’ experience in a similar role in a finance department.
Strong foundation in quantitative analysis, data management, and financial concepts.
Analytically minded with hands on skills in Advanced Excel, VBA, SQL, Python, Power BI and the ability to work with large and diverse sets of data. Experience with other power platform tools is an asset.
Experience in data extraction.
Demonstrated ability to deal with change and excel in high-stress situations.
Ability to manage multiple responsibilities with varying priority to deliver timely results.
Commitment to a highly collaborative team environment including cross-training.
Knowledge of Workday Adaptive planning is an asset.



This position will remain open until a suitable candidate is selected.

Alberta Blue Cross® is an inclusive employer committed to a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We empower and are advocates for our team members by welcoming, respecting and valuing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

We offer the opportunity to work in an innovative, high-energy team-focused environment. If you have the qualifications we are looking for, apply online at careers.ab.bluecross.ca

A criminal record check satisfactory to Alberta Blue Cross will be required as a condition of employment, following a conditional offer.

Title: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist
Description:
POSITION TITLE: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist

DEPARTMENT: Finance, Administration & Information Technology

CLASSIFICATION: MGO-07

SALARY RANGE: Starting at $79,591.00 Per Annum

POSITION TYPE: Full-time, Permanent

LOCATION: Saskatoon

ACCOUNTABLE TO : Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT

Brief Overview

The Financial Database & Analytics Specialist is responsible for the profiling, development, integration, and optimization of enterprise databases and reporting solutions that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, performance measurement, and operational analysis. This position serves as the government's technical specialist in database profiling, data availability, systems integration, business intelligence, and analytical reporting, helping transform data from multiple systems into reliable information for decision-making across government.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Compliance, Governance & Risk Management


Profiles, develop, maintains, and optimizes enterprise databases, data models, and reporting structures that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, operational analysis, and performance measurement.
Supports the integration of data across finance, payroll, human resource, procurement, project management, funding agreement, and other government systems.


Financial Analysis & Decision Support


Provides technical and analytical support for budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, funding agreement reporting, trend analysis, key performance indicators, and executive reporting.
Works closely with Finance to ensure reliable information is available to support financial planning, resource allocation, reporting obligations, and decision-making.


Enterprise Reporting & Business Intelligence


Develops and maintains reports, dashboards, data extracts, automated reporting solutions, and analytical models that support government-wide reporting requirements.
Translate business requirements into practical database structures, queries, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions that improve accessibility and use of information while maintaining data security, privacy protection standards.


Data Quality, Automation & Continuous Improvement


Improves the accuracy, consistency, reliability, and accessibility of enterprise data used for financial and operational reporting.
Identifies opportunities to streamline reporting processes, automate recurring reporting requirements, reduce manual effort, and improve the efficiency of data collection and analysis activities across government.


Technical Documentation, Collaboration & Advisory Support


Develops and maintains technical documentation related to databases, data models, data flows, and system integrations.
Works collaboratively with ministries, departments, program areas, internal consulting teams, external consulting teams, Information Technology, and system vendors to assess data availability, recommend appropriate data structures and classifications, and support reporting and analytical requirements.
Other duties as assigned by the Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong proficiency in SQL, data extraction, transformation, and reporting development.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the ability to translate reporting requirements into technical solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power Query, and financial data analysis tools.
Ability to assess data availability, relationships, and appropriate categorization across multiple systems.
Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
Understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, performance measurement, and government reporting environments.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Economics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3-5 years progressive financial analysis, database development or relevant experience.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SSRS, or equivalent.
An equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and progressively responsible experience may be considered


Additional Requirements


Must undergo a Criminal Record Check
Valid Saskatchewan driver’s license and access reliable transportation
Please submit your application by 9:59 PM on August 27, 2026.


Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Place: Open Hall, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
Description:
Job Category: Developer

Job Type: Full Time

Job Location: Remote

Job status: Open

Job Description

About xCroTek

xCroTek is a product- and service-based AI software company that builds innovative, AI-powered solutions to drive intelligent automation and digital transformation. We specialize in creating scalable, impactful technologies for modern businesses.

Job Overview

We are seeking a skilled DOMO Developer to support our enterprise analytics initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing existing DOMO data marts, integrations, and reports, and will play a key role in optimising our data ecosystem. This role will involve creating detailed data mapping documents, defining business rules, and ensuring data consistency and accuracy across multiple systems.

Key Responsibilities


Analyse existing DOMO data marts, data pipelines, and source system integrations.
Review and optimize DOMO reports, dashboards, and overall implementation.
Work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into data mapping documents and apply business rules.
Develop, maintain, and optimise complex SQL queries for data validation, transformation, and reporting purposes.
Perform in-depth data analysis and data modeling to support reporting and decision-making.
Collaborate with data engineers and architects on data integration and modeling best practices.
Provide insights and recommendations to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and scalability.
Leverage Snowflake (or other cloud data warehouses) for data exploration and integration support.


Required Skills


1–5 years of hands-on experience in business intelligence and analytics development.
Strong expertise in DOMO platform (data flows, data sets, cards, dashboards, and Magic ETL).
Excellent proficiency in SQL (writing, optimizing, and debugging queries across large data sets).
Solid understanding of data analysis, data modeling, and ETL processes.
Experience in documenting data mapping and business rules.
Exposure to Snowflake or similar modern cloud data platforms (BigQuery, Redshift, Azure Synapse).
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Effective communication skills to bridge technical details with business needs.


Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience in data governance, data quality, or metadata management.
Familiarity with integration tools (e.g., DOMO Workbench, APIs, or cloud connectors).
Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.


How To Apply

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a brief cover letter explaining their interest in the role to hr@xcrotek.com. Please include “DOMO Developer/Data Analyst” in the subject line.

Apply with a one-page cover letter and CV to hr@xcrotek.com

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA Sports FC Live
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst - FC Live Service Forecasting

Our FC Data & Analytics team is looking for an Advanced Analyst to join our group, leading forecasting and performance modelling for FC’s live service business. Reporting to a Senior Analytics Manager, you will be part of a growing team providing data and insights around player behaviour and live content performance within the FC franchise. We’re looking for someone who combines strong quantitative forecasting expertise with business intuition, bringing the ability to translate historical trends, player behaviour, and live content strategies into actionable projections that inform decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and live service operations - helping shape how FC plans and measures performance at scale.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Own the forecasting framework that underpins performance measurement, planning, and strategic decision-making across FC’s live service business.
Employ an extensive toolkit of financial modelling techniques, time series analysis, and a deep knowledge of their use cases.
Develop a robust model that projects our live service funnel metrics to a high degree of fidelity, incorporating player behaviour, in-game content, and macroeconomic trends.
Collaborate with partners across Product Management, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on projections, and keep the business updated on how our latest live service performance impacts our model’s assumptions.
Establish scalable forecasting processes that enable us to work with our cross-functional partners to efficiently & effectively refine our projections over time.
Lead presentations to diverse audiences including senior and executive level management, distilling complex model results into clear insights & recommendations.
Run risk and opportunity scenarios based on live content plans, new feature additions, and other potential changes in the FC product.
Mentor and collaborate with other analysts in order to collaboratively develop our forecasts, working together to drive evolutions in our modelling in this space.


What We're Looking For


A degree in a quantitative discipline (Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or similar)
7+ years of experience in a data-driven role performing quantitative analysis with big data to help guide decisions
4+ years of experience developing financial/product performance projections and forecasts using various modelling techniques
Strong experience in statistical and/or time series modelling for predictive purposes
Expertise in SQL and working with large-scale, complex datasets
Proficient in analyzing large datasets using programmatic tools (e.g. Python, R)
Experience with data visualization software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI)
Strong capabilities in project management processes
Very comfortable presenting analysis in an executive facing environment

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Title: Jr. Data Analyst - ACX Corporate Support Edmonton
Description:
Join the ride!

Position : Jr. Data Analyst

Collision Centre: ACX Corporate Support Edmonton

Location: Edmonton, Alberta

Classification: Full-time, Immediate hire

Part of a bigger team!

ACX Corporate Support Edmonton is proud to be part of the AutoCanada Collision Centres’ network and a division of AutoCanada. AutoCanada is the largest Canadian owned and publicly traded automotive dealer group operating in Canada and the US. We are innovative, data-driven and our commitment to our Team Members, customers and operational excellence fuels our success. 

Our Team Members are at the heart of our success, building long-lasting, trust-based relationships with customers across Canada. Our national network provides opportunities and support to build the career that’s right for you. Working here is fast-paced, non-stop, and a little unpredictable—and we love it. 

Your area of focus.

You'll join the ACX (Collision Centre & Hail) Analytics & Innovation team at AutoCanada in an entry-level role focused on keeping our reporting suite running and helping migrate it from Tableau to Power BI. You'll grow into designing new dashboards, running data validation, and supporting stakeholders across our national collision repair network. Reporting into the Analytics & Innovation Lead, you'll get hands-on mentorship, direct exposure to shop managers, regional directors and senior leadership, and visibility into our AI and innovation work as your skills develop.

What drives your day-to-day?


Maintain and monitor the existing Tableau dashboard suite, ensuring reports run accurately and on schedule during the migration period.
Perform routine data validation across dashboards and reports, investigating discrepancies and partnering with Data Engineering when source data needs to be corrected.
Produce recurring monthly reports and one-off ad hoc reports for shop managers, regional directors and corporate stakeholders.
Manage the ACX user list across Tableau and Power BI, provisioning access and keeping permissions aligned with role.
Help rebuild ACX dashboards in Power BI — recreating calculations in DAX and validating that new versions match the originals.
As your Power BI skills develop, grow into designing new dashboards from scratch, contributing to dashboard digests, and helping train managers on how to use them.
Document your work so the rest of the team can pick it up.


What Are The Must-haves…


Post-secondary education in Operations Management, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, ora related field — recent graduate's welcome.
Some hands-on experience with SQL or another programming language (coursework, co-op, internship or personal projects all count).
Working proficiency in Excel — formulas, pivot tables, and comfort cleaning up messy data.
An eye for visual design and a genuine interest in making data clear and engaging.
Self-starter mindset with the willingness to try something before asking for help, balanced with the self-awareness to ask good questions when you are genuinely stuck.
Strong written and verbal communication skills — comfortable talking with shop managers and regional leaders, not just other analysts.
Any prior exposure to Power BI (including DAX), Tableau, or another BI/dashboarding tool is a major plus. Power BI coursework, certifications (PL-300), or personal projects stand out given our current migration. 


The Perks.


Competitive Compensation and Benefits Package
Employee Vehicle Purchase & Service Plans
Employee and Family Assistance Programs
Company-wide appreciation events and contests throughout the calendar year 
Professional development and the opportunity to grow your career 


And those are just the basics. We strive every day to create a workplace culture that embraces diversity and inclusivity, ensures fairness and equal opportunities, and fosters a sense of belonging for all Team Members. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively support everyone in expressing themselves and reaching their full potential. 

Can you picture yourself here already?

We hope so. It’s equally as important that you choose us as we choose you. Take a sneak peek at what we think makes this one of the best workplaces around. 

 If you think you’re a good fit to come along on our ride, apply now through our website at www.autocan.ca/careers. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 Our commitment extends to reaching out to individuals from various backgrounds and identities. We do not discriminate based on gender identity, race, national origin, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, marital or family status, or mental/physical disabilities. AutoCanada is committed to collaborating with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need accommodation during the recruitment process, please inform your recruiter.

The goal of the dashboards is to deliver pertinent data to all levels of management to help teams make smarter, data-driven decisions and deliver better products. The Business Analyst partners with cross-functional teams across J.Jill, including Real Estate, Marketing, Retail Operations, and Merchandising, to provide data-driven insights that support strategic business decisions. This role performs end-to-end business analysis by translating business questions into actionable recommendations through SQL queries, Excel spreadsheets, and data visualization. The Business Analyst evaluates business performance, analyzes A/B testing results, develops automated reporting solutions using BI tools such as Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI, and presents findings through clear, impactful presentations and reports. Additionally, the role supports real estate strategy by developing sales forecasts for new store locations, closures, and transfers to help drive profitable growth.

Takes an active role in conception, design, execution, and analysis of corporate-wide testing activities.

Takes initiative acting as a subject matter expert on analytics, quantification, and process automation and provides advanced analytics to support longer-range plans and initiatives.
Provides recommendations for improvements to tools, scorecards, KPIs & benchmarks.
Performs end-to-end business analytics: 1) Understands business question 2) Structures Excel spreadsheet 3) Builds accurate SQL queries (validating results) 4) Summarizes analytical insights and business recommendations into a PowerPoint deck and/or email.
Performs data analysis tasks, evalution of A/B Tests, etc. to develop recommendations that will improve decision making across the organization.
Develops automated self-service business reporting through BI tools including Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI.
Calculates sales estimates for potential new store locations as well as store closure and store transfer estimates for existing stores.

Title: Supply Chain Analyst
Description:
Who We AreButcherBox is a certified B Corp headquartered in Boston, and honored to be celebrating our fourth year in a row on Inc.'s list of Best Workplaces. At ButcherBox, we believe in better. That’s why we deliver 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef, free-range organic chicken, pork raised crate-free, and wild-caught seafood directly to our members’ doors. All of our products are humanely raised or wild-caught and never given antibiotics or added hormones ever. We’re working to build a world that’s better for all, and we’re inviting everyone to come along. For us, better means treating our planet with respect. It means improving the lives of animals and the livelihoods of farmers. It means never cutting corners when it comes to doing business. Ultimately, it means better meals, enjoyed together. Our team is made up of people who collaborate and support one another. We’re always looking for outstanding people to join our mission! 

ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are seeking a Supply Chain Analyst to help us deliver the best quality meat and seafood to our customers and to create data assets and insights that make that possible at scale. This role requires someone with strong analytical skills who can work closely with stakeholders and vendors to build action-oriented reporting, deliver rigorous ad-hoc analyses, and meaningfully improve visibility into our protein supply chains.  

An ideal candidate is deeply curious, a systems thinker, and takes ownership over the analytical needs of the teams they support. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for someone who wants to see their work drive critical business decisions.  

RESPONSIBILITIES  

Build and maintain actuals vs. forecast reporting across key protein categories, highlighting variances, root causes, and emerging trends to support proactive decision-making. 
Develop data models and reporting to monitor the cost and quality of proteins throughout the supply chain. 
Partner with finance and commercial teams to reconcile assumptions across forecasts, budgets, and actual performance. 
Support yield and conversion reporting (e.g., raw to sellable yield, trim loss, waste) to improve transparency into cutter performance and efficiency.  
Track key product performance metrics—such as repurchase rate, cannibalization, and seasonality—and deliver in‑depth analysis that enables teams to understand SKU‑level performance. 
Support scenario analysis and “what‑if” modeling (e.g., demand changes, yield adjustments, cost inflation) to help the team assess risk and opportunity before issues materialize. 
Build and continuously improve dashboards that track core procurement metrics (including inventory weeks on hand, product weights, and unit cost) to enable fast, confident decision-making. 

QUALIFICATIONS 

3+ years of experience in an analytical role. Experience in procurement/supply chain/demand planning preferred. 
Strong technical skills across analytics and data tooling (Preferred: familiarity with Databricks SQL, Developing Power BI, or similar cloud-native analytics environments). 
Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights and influence key decision makers. 
Deep curiosity and desire to learn. 
Bias toward action – strong visualizations are important, but analysis needs to drive change. 


Ability and willingness to commute to our Watertown, MA office 2-3 times per week. 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 

In your first year, you’ll own our core procurement dashboards, have helped build at least one net-new data model that improves supply chain visibility and purchasing decisions, and be the go-to analytical partner for the procurement team.  

Salary - $103,000-127,000

ButcherBox is driven by relentless improvement, accountability, humility, and customer obsession. We want our workplace to be one of growth and learning where everyone can be safe/comfortable to show up as their authentic self to work. Anyone who loves our products and goals is welcome here! We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer aspiring to incite positive change in the pastures, the fulfillment centers, the office, and the world. Benefits•Health: medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, an employer-funded HSA, and short & long-term disability benefits•Financial: 401(k) with generous employer match•Annual bonus based on company performance•Time off: unlimited paid time off policy, 20 weeks parental leave, an executive team that encourages a good work/life balance•Personal growth: Annual Learning & Development stipend, and access to a range of personal and professional coaching solutions through BetterUp•Food: a free Custom Classic ButcherBox each month and weekly lunch reimbursement•Others: reimbursement for wellness activities, an exceptional EAP, fertility benefits, life insurance and more ButcherBox is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive environment at all steps in the hiring process. Title: Compliance Data and Reporting Analyst
Description:
Summary

The Compliance Data and Reporting Analyst (“CDRA”) is part of the Brown University Health Corporate Compliance team and reports to the Manager of Compliance and Program Effectiveness. This position serves as a key member of the compliance team and data analyst for compliance and privacy reporting matters. The CDRA is responsible for assisting the compliance team with facilitating, executing, monitoring the overall management of the compliance, policy & privacy, and revenue compliance data and reporting functions. Will assist with general audit projects.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization’s values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

Data Analyst


Design business analysis and data recording systems for use throughout the department.
Maintain databases and perform updates as necessary to ensure accuracy.
Track and identify trends in reported compliance issues and inquiries.
Regularly examine data reports to locate and resolve mistakes throughout.
Accurately analyze and collect data for various types of business reports.
Create business reports and dashboards that provide insight into key data points.
Communicate the results of data analysis in written and verbal form to managers.
Assists the Team with the maintenance of electronic data management systems in use in the Department. Including but not limited to – NAVEX; Imprivata; MDaudit; COI -Smart; Intelligent Contracts


Privacy


Assists the Privacy team with the coordination, development, facilitation, and enhancement of the Privacy Program through reporting trends, metrics and dashboards.
Assists the VP and Manager with coordinating system wide privacy and compliance projects which may include working closely with Information Security, Information Services, Human Resources, or operations teams to identify and implement process or system changes.
Responsible for the collection and analysis of privacy program data and analytics and development of standard and ad hoc reports.
Provides support to privacy-related initiatives including the planning and performance of privacy-based risk assessments and data-inventory processes. 
Provides support to the VP and Department Manager(s) and members of the compliance team in meeting federal and state reporting requirements, including the Office for Civil Rights, regarding breach notification and follow-up investigations.
Maintains a working knowledge of relevant privacy laws, regulations, rules, and standards and keeps abreast of privacy trends.
Assists the Manager and VP with requests for data sharing with external entities.


Compliance and Revenue Compliance


Assisting the Compliance Team with the management of general audits identified on the Annual Workplan and other audits as needed.
Develop and facilitate designated monitoring activities to assess compliance with policies. Responsible for ensuring monitoring is occurring on a consistent basis.
Assists with implementation of compliance training and education.
Supports the activities of the System Compliance Committee and Audit & Risk Committee, and implementation of the Compliance work plan.
Develop a strong understanding of the Compliance Services software tools to help optimize each tool to full potential.
Participates in committees and work groups representing Compliance as requested.
Handles all compliance and privacy matters with sensitivity and maintains strict confidentiality of all work material and activities.
At the direction of the Manager performs special projects related to Compliance.
Supports the development and implementation of a sustainable Privacy and Compliance management program.
Performs other duties as assigned.


Education


Bachelor’s degree and at least a minimum of 2 years’ experience working as a data analyst, preferably in healthcare. Master’s degree preferred.


Experience

The ideal candidate will have strong data analytics skills. While we understand that no candidate will possess every skill listed, a minimum requirement for this position is proficiency in data analytics, including development of data driven reports, dashboards, and use of data analytics tools.


Demonstrated ability to manage time and prioritize projects to meet deadlines
Ability to use SQL and Microsoft Excel to create pivot tables, graphs and charts. Experience with Tableau and/or Microsoft PowerBI
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively relate data to coworkers
Tendency to pay close attention to small details that could impact results
Certification/Licensure: Certification in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) required within 12 months of hire.
Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Skills Required.


Experience with Artificial Intelligence; Imprivata/or Privacy Surveillance software, NAVEX/Compliance Tracking Software; Revenue Cycle Audit solutions, and electronic health records preferred

None

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
Role Purpose

Your job is to turn data into decisions. Hollingsworth & Vose is a global specialty manufacturer with mill operations across the Americas, Europe, and Asia — and the people running those operations, from the mill floor to senior management, need numbers they can trust and analytics they can act on. You build those.




A dashboard is not the outcome. The outcome is a plant manager who catches a margin problem a month earlier, or a finance team that stops arguing about whose number is right. We measure this role by results that matter to the business, not by reports shipped. Trust is the product — you treat it that way.




This is also a role for someone who wants to build with AI, not just read about it. We are embedding AI into how IT delivers — natural-language access to data, automated insights, AI-assisted development — and this role sits at the center of that work.




What You Own

Analytics people rely on. Power BI dashboards and reports covering trend, variance, cost, and margin analysis — with drill-through, drill-down, parameters, and dynamic filtering that let people answer their own next question.
Semantic models that hold up. Accurate models, measures, and KPIs. Multi-site, multi-currency, imperial/metric — handled correctly, to our site and item naming conventions, every time. If two reports disagree, that’s your problem to run down.
The data behind the numbers. Strong SQL against Oracle EBS and our MES database to source, validate, and shape data. You verify before you publish — and when a number is wrong, “the source data was bad” is where your job starts, not where it ends.
The sales cube. Develop against our central SSAS multidimensional cube (live connection / MDX) for cross-ERP, multi-currency sales and margin analysis.
The existing SSRS estate. Maintain and rationalize current SSRS reports while the future state takes shape.
AI in production. Build AI features into Power BI and our internal applications — natural-language Q&A, automated insights, anomaly detection, AI-assisted workflows — and use AI tools daily in your own development.
The relationship. You listen first. You partner with stakeholders to understand the goal behind the question, and you deliver recommendations, not just charts. Nobody who depends on your work waits in the dark for a status update.
Trust in the numbers. Data accuracy, documentation, and version control. Done means running in production, validated against source, documented, and handed off.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring Product Analysts to embed across the product organization and serve as strategic analytics partners to teams across Healthcare, Algorithms, AI, Hardware, and other product areas. In this role, you will help define how WHOOP measures product success, uncover insights that shape roadmap decisions, and translate complex data into clear recommendations that improve the member experience. You will bring strong analytical rigor, product intuition, and intellectual curiosity to help teams make faster, smarter, and more impactful decisions with data.

Responsibilities


Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Design, and cross-functional leadership to inform strategy and roadmap decisions with data.
Own the analytical narrative for your product area, illustrated by defining KPIs, refining measurement frameworks, and surfacing insights that drive action.
Support experimentation and feature launches end-to-end: from defining success metrics to post-launch analysis and iteration.
Build scalable, self-serve reporting & tooling that lets your stakeholders make decisions without waiting on you.
Develop deep context on your product domain and use it to ask sharper questions, challenge assumptions, and push the product forward.
Proactively surface insights and recommendations that go beyond the ask; identify opportunities others haven't seen yet.
Collaborate with a high-performance analytics team in a fast-paced environment where intellectual curiosity is the baseline expectation.


Qualifications


You've done this before: 2-6+ years in an analytical role where you owned business-critical metrics or initiatives. (We're hiring across levels; we'll figure out the right fit together.)
You use AI tools proactively and hold AI-assisted work to the same bar as your own.
You can take a vague question, wrangle the right data, isolate insights, and communicate actionable recommendations to stakeholders who aren't data people.
You're a strong storyteller: you know how to make a compelling, concise case for action.
You're technically sharp: advanced SQL is table stakes. Familiarity with modern data stacks (Snowflake, dbt, ELT workflows) and visualization tools (Hex, Sigma, Amplitude, Looker) is a plus.
You have product sense: you think about the member experience, not just the numbers.
You're curious about how things work. Algorithms, hardware, health science: you don't need to be an expert, but you should want to understand.
You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and doesn't wait to be told what to work on.
TEAMS WE'RE HIRING FOR


We’re Looking For Multiple Analysts To Work Across Our Product Teams. During The Interview Process, We'll Work With You To Find The Right Team Fit Based On Your Interests And Strengths


AI Product: The future of intelligent coaching and personalized insights powered by AI/ML.
Algorithms: Where the science meets the product; sleep, recovery, strain, and how algorithmic outputs translate into member value.
Hardware Product: The physical device experience; sensors, wearability, and next-gen hardware.
Healthcare Product: Building WHOOP's Health Operating System; health outcomes, clinical features, personalized wellness.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 - $155,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Title: EQuIS Analyst
Description:
Position Overview

Roux is seeking a Database Analyst with hands-on experience using EarthSoft’s EQuIS to support the management of environmental and chemical data for analysis and reporting. The ideal candidate is an experienced analyst with a desire to grow who can execute day-to-day EDD processing and project support while also supporting EQuIS database administration, configuration, and client-facing dashboard/reporting capabilities. This role will work closely with Roux’s existing environmental data management team as we expand Roux’s EQuIS-based service offerings. Candidate is expected to work from the Burlington, Massachusetts office three days per week at minimum.

Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree or higher in relevant technical field.
Minimum of 4 years of environmental data management experience, including practical use of EarthSoft’s EQuIS in a consulting or regulated environment.
Demonstrated experience processing and QA/QC’ing laboratory EDDs efficiently using EQuIS (EDP) (or comparable EDD workflow).
Working knowledge of EQuIS configuration/administration concepts.
Strong skills and proficiency with Microsoft-based software, including MS Access and MS Excel.
Interest and aptitude for building client-facing outputs (dashboards/reporting) using EQuIS dashboards.
Basic to intermediate SQL skills for querying, troubleshooting, and supporting reports/dashboards.
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple project priorities and tight schedules.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for coordination with project managers, laboratories, and technical staff.
Ability to help build and scale Roux’s EQuIS capabilities by training and supporting other staff, including analysts with prior database experience.


Essential Duties


Support environmental project teams by managing, processing, and quality‑checking environmental data in EQuIS to ensure datasets are accurate, complete, and suitable for reporting, compliance, and analysis.
Collaborate closely with project managers, scientists, engineers, and GIS staff to understand project requirements, prioritize data tasks, and deliver high‑quality data support under tight timelines.
Process laboratory and field EDDs in EQuIS (EDP), perform QA/QC and completeness checks, resolve common errors efficiently, and coordinate corrections with labs and project staff.
Support routine data tracking, data loading, and data delivery workflows.
Develop, run, and refine standard queries (SQL-based or within EQuIS) and reports to support project reporting needs.
Assist with EQuIS database administration and configuration activities, including management of reference values, formats, templates, and standard reports.
Develop client‑facing dashboards and reporting solutions (e.g., EQuIS-based and/or Power BI), working with project teams to translate technical data into clear, usable outputs for clients.
Help document workflows, QA/QC procedures, and guidance materials that improve efficiency, consistency, and quality across Roux’s EQuIS‑based data management services.
Provide hands‑on training and ongoing support to other staff in the use of EQuIS and related data management workflows, enabling consistent and effective use of the system across projects.


Base Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000. This salary range is based on what Roux in good faith believes it might pay at the time of posting for this position and for this geographic location. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as relevant work experience, market conditions, education/training, certifications, skill sets, and internal equity. In addition, this position is eligible for performance bonuses based on individual job performance and the profitability of the firm.

Roux offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position including:


Medical, dental, and vision care coverage for employees and eligible dependents
401(k) profit sharing plan with employer match
Flexible Spending Accounts
Company paid life insurance and disability insurance
Supplemental life, long-term care, accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Paid Time Off including holidays, vacation, and sick leave
Paid Parental Leave


Roux is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital status, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or protected veteran status; and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Roux will take steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the position, please contact HR@rouxinc.com .

We are currently hiring a BI Developer II in Boston, MA.

The BI Developer II role drives business insights at BBC by delivering dashboards, reports, and semantic models on the Power BI platform. 2+ years of professional experience within the Data & Analytics space

1+ year of experience with SQL and data transformation workflows
Experience in a customer-facing role working with end users on requirements, coaching, and training

Experience support enterprise solutions for Corporate & Sales functional areas
Experience with programming languages such as Python
