Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Purple Carrot

Founded in 2014, Purple Carrot delivers clean, long-lasting energy through the power of plants. As the only company in America devoted entirely to plant-based eating, we have spent over a decade perfecting the balance of protein and fiber that only plants can provide. Offering chef-crafted, dietitian-designed meals delivered right to your door, we make plant-forward eating effortless, flexible, and endlessly exciting. Our menu spans quick weeknight dishes, occasion-worthy dinners, breakfast, lunch, snacks, and ready-to-eat meals.

Purple Carrot prioritizes taste and flexibility, offering no membership fees, the freedom to skip or unskip weekly deliveries whenever you want, and a no-pressure, cancel-anytime policy. We pride ourselves on doing plants better than anyone else - and we have the receipts to prove it.

Description

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our mission-driven team. As an integral part of the Data department, you will join forces with the Sr. Manager, Data and Analytics (to whom you will also report) in our continued effort to inspire people to eat more plants!

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about transforming and analyzing complex datasets into clear, actionable, and timely insights that drive strategic decision-making and improve business results.

As the Senior Data Analyst, you will be focused on leveraging SQL, Python, and BI tools to identify opportunities, optimize key metrics, and measure performance across the organization. This is a high-visibility role that partners directly and frequently with senior leadership, translating data into high-quality analysis to support the decisions the business acts on. You'll also work closely with marketing and other teams across the organization to help them become proficient in the data assets you produce. You'll be part of a small data analytics team, so your work is visible, and your voice matters.

If you are a detail-oriented problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of data, analysis, and strategy, we'd like to meet you.

We greatly thank all applicants; however, only those under serious consideration will be contacted.


Location


This role is based in Dedham, MA, 3 days per week in the office
Our hybrid approach includes 3 in-office days each week, giving teams the best of both flexibility and collaboration. Many team members choose to come in more often - it's a great way to stay inspired and engaged with the team



On the Plate


Query and analyze large datasets to extract and communicate meaningful insights
Build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using SQL, Python, and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Omni, Sigma)
Build and apply machine learning models in Python — from predictive modeling (e.g., cancel/churn prediction, demand forecasting) to applied techniques (e.g., clustering, regression) that generate deeper analytical insight
Train and support teams on the data assets you build, so they have what they need to self-serve
Own forecasting and experimentation initiatives end-to-end, from framework design through measurement and recommendation
Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand what they actually need and provide data-driven solutions
Produce clear reports, visualizations, and presentations for leadership, with the ability to influence decisions without formal authority
Monitor and report on key performance indicators and emerging trends
Assist with ad hoc projects and tasks as necessary



Main Ingredients for the Role


3+ years' experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar analytical role
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science/Analytics) or equivalent experience
Able to commute to the Dedham, MA office 3 days/week
Proficient in SQL for data querying and transformation
Skilled in Python - for advanced analysis and automation, including building and running machine learning models
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Omni, Sigma)
Strong Excel skills for analysis and reporting



Extra Special Sauce


A collaborative team player who thrives on a small analytics team
You love teaching almost as much as you love a clean dataset - nothing makes you happier than watching a teammate go from confused to confident
You've got opinions, and you're not afraid to share them - pushing back when it's the right call, not just going along to get along
You are adaptable to a fast-paced working environment with changing priorities based on the business needs
Genuine curiosity about the "why" behind the numbers, not just the "what."
Experience with dbt or modern data stack tools is a plus



Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $95,000 - $115,000. Compensation is based on experience and qualifications, and the posted range is not a guarantee of any specific offer.

Garnish

We love our staff, and show it with benefits (including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, FSA, and life insurance), matching retirement plan, generous and flexible paid time off, Purple Carrot box delivery credits, professional development, and the opportunity to work in collaboration with teammates who are passionate about food!

Final Touches

We are committed to a safe and inclusive work environment, free of discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetics, national origin, ancestry, age, medical condition, mental or physical disability, handicap, veteran status, or marital status.

Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) is one of the world’s largest travel retailers and corporate travel managers. Are you passionate about turning complex data into meaningful business insights? This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of business intelligence, data analytics, and AI-driven productivity.

Design, develop, maintain, and optimize advanced dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.

Description:
Job Description:

About Brown:

Brown University is a leading research university distinct for its student-centered learning and deep sense of purpose. Our students, faculty and staff are driven by the idea that their work will have an impact in the world.

Brown University offers a flexible work/life balance; summer hours, winter break and a comprehensive Benefits package including time off, annual paid holidays; benefits offerings including health, dental, vision, tuition assistance, retirement, wellness, employee discounts and more. To learn about Brown University’s benefits, visit the University Human Resources web page here for further information.

About the Opportunity:

Brown University’s School of Professional Studies (SPS) brings a Brown education to new audiences of learners: those focused on the development of skills and a breadth of knowledge necessary for professional success and leadership. We leverage Brown’s intellectual centers of excellence, rigorous teaching, and developmental approach to learning in a range of programs, including serving students outside of traditional degree programs. We partner with Brown departments, centers, institutes, and schools to develop degree and non-degree programs, and to support the recruitment, retention, and placement success of master’s students, including traditional, non-traditional, and professional students.

Responsibilities:

The Assistant Director of Systems and Data Reporting analyzes and reports on data for 35+ master’s degree programs, as well as for a portfolio of non-degree courses and certificates managed by the School of Professional Studies (SPS). This individual designs, produces, validates, distributes, and updates both quantitative and qualitative reports, queries, and data visualizations to support data-informed decision making in all facets of SPS’s processes, including the recruitment funnel (program prospects, inquiries, applicants, admission decisions, matriculants, and defers). The Assistant Director provides timely and interpretive reports for the Director of Admissions and Data Analytics, Director of Executive Education, SPS’s Senior Leadership Team, and others to inform recruitment, communication, selection, and enrollment strategies and policies. The incumbent will be expected to make recommendations on how to improve SPS enrollments based on data analysis from multiple sources.

The Assistant Director will work with the Associate Director of Master's Admissions Systems and others to identify data needs and develop tools in relevant systems (Technolutions Slate, Tableau, IBM Cognos Analytics) to address those needs.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree Or Equivalent Education And Experience


Four or more years of experience administering daily systems operations, preferably in a college admissions environment
Experience building CJ-based queries and validating data in Technolutions Slate
Experience building workspaces and workflows in a CRM or relational database
Experience working with integrated student database systems
Demonstrated understanding of complex table joins and database query language
Experience creating data connections between Tableau Server and various data sources
Demonstrated proficiency developing dashboards that are intuitive, impactful, user friendly, multi-faceted, and visually appealing
Experience with manipulating data from a relational database
Ability to craft logic formulas and calculations to display data in a clear way



Preferred


Previous experience in higher education
Degree in business/data analytics, computer science, management information systems or technically related field
Experience with Ellucian Banner or other student information and customer relationship management systems
Experience developing and providing training to a professional and potentially non-technical audience



Salary Grade:

10

Additional Information:

Applicants are asked to include a resume. In a separate document, please also respond to the following questions in lieu of a cover letter (no more than 1-2 pages, please):


Data Integrity & Validation

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Robotics
Description:
Description

We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Business Intelligence Engineer to join the BI Engineering, Analytics, & Data Science (BAND) team supporting Robotic Storage Tech (RST) programs within Amazon Robotics. In this role, you will bring a strong foundation in statistics to support the introduction of new containerized and workcell robotic products — from early concept through deployment. You will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous questions about new product performance into structured analyses, and author recommendation-focused deliverables that inform program decisions and shape how new robotic systems progress through RST's development lifecycle. You will design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and other analytics artifacts purpose-built for new product introduction — tracking system maturity, surfacing readiness gaps, and enabling data-driven milestone decisions. You are a collaborative problem-solver who thinks holistically about how new systems evolve from prototype to production and uses data to accelerate that journey.

Key job responsibilities


Statistical Analysis for New Products: Execute foundational statistical methods including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, design of experiments, and regression analysis to evaluate new containerized and workcell system performance against readiness criteria at each development phase.
Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Program Managers, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous new product questions into structured analyses that support milestone decisions.
Data Source Development: Identify and onboard data sources from new containerized and workcell systems as they come online, define NPI-relevant metrics, and build data pipelines that enable performance tracking.
Whitepaper & Insights Delivery: Author recommendation-focused whitepapers and deep-dive analyses that inform new product development decisions — including system configuration trade-offs, readiness assessments, and deployment strategy recommendations.
BI Ownership: Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that track new containerized and workcell products through their Alpha, Beta, and General Availability phases, providing visibility into system maturation and operational readiness.


A day in the life

On any given day, you might be helping run a designed experiment to evaluate a configuration change on a new workcell system, building a readiness dashboard for a containerized product approaching its Beta milestone, or authoring a whitepaper that supports a recommendation whether a new system is ready to advance to the next development phase. You will own major components of the BAND team's NPI analytics infrastructure for RST, including contributing to data architecture decisions and delivering reports that track new products from through General Availability.

You will maintain a deep understanding of data lineage across your BI solutions — from the telemetry and event streams generated by new containerized and workcell systems, through metric aggregation processes, to how insights are consumed at milestone reviews and program readiness gates. You will create and optimize scripts (SQL, Python, R, Shell) to streamline BI processes and select appropriate analytics and visualization tools to meet diverse new product evaluation needs.

Your work will directly influence how new containerized and workcell products move through RST's development pipeline and shape the future of Amazon's robotic storage technology landscape.

About The Team

Robotic Storage Tech (RST) invents, designs, and develops transformational storage solutions used in the Amazon Logistic Network. We will realize the next generation of automated containerized systems, and optimize our existing install base. We are a team of talented engineers, product evangelists, and creators focused on technologies that make inventory pick, stow, and count safer and more efficient for Amazon. We deliver value with our elite robotic technologies because we listen and respond to our many customers, develop robust and reliable solutions, and invest in both our people and our products.

Basic Qualifications


3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience writing complex SQL queries
Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Title: Data Analyst, Enrollment Management
Description:
Join our community and experience Emerson College!

The Enrollment Management Data Analyst will support the Enrollment Division’s data and reporting needs by providing advanced data analysis, reporting, and visualization to inform strategic enrollment decisions. Reporting to the Associate Director, Enrollment Systems & Technology, the Data Analyst position will work collaboratively across departments, including Undergraduate and Graduate Admissions and Student Financial Services, to provide insights and actionable recommendations on process effectiveness. The analyst will leverage data from the Student Information System, and additional internal and external sources to support the achievement of the enrollment goals.

Essential Job Duties


Analyze and report on key enrollment metrics, including applications, yield, retention, and financial aid data, to inform strategy and decision-making.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to provide stakeholders with accessible and actionable insights.
Extract, clean, and integrate data from various systems, including Slate, Banner/Workday, and other institutional platforms, to support comprehensive reporting.
Collaborate with Enrollment Division teams to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improving recruitment, retention, and student success.
Ensure data quality and consistency by developing and implementing data validation processes, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining accurate records related to student data across all enrollment systems.
Conduct predictive modeling for yield rates and statistical analysis to forecast enrollment trends and assess the impact of recruitment and financial aid strategies.
Support ad hoc data requests and analyses to address emerging needs and priorities across the Enrollment Division.
Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and security of enrollment data in compliance with institutional policies and FERPA regulations.
Partner with Institutional Research and IT to improve data workflows and systems integrations.
Provide training and support to Enrollment Division staff on data tools and analytics best practices.


QUALIFICATIONS – Qualifications are deemed required or preferred and represent what is needed to effectively perform the job.


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field required.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or related functions, preferably in higher education or enrollment management required.
Proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational databases required. Knowledge of Python or R preferred.
Familiarity with CRM systems such as Slate or other higher education platforms required.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES – May be representative, but not all-inclusive, of those knowledge, skills, and abilities commonly associated with the job.


Strong skills in data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Strong verbal and written communication skills to convey complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
High level of initiative and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and technical skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. It is a strong opportunity for an analytically minded individual contributor to make a visible impact on Inventory Operations through both execution and innovation.

Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reporting, dashboards, and underlying data sources

Support pilots, business cases, reporting transitions, and initiative execution through data-driven analysis and recommendations
Build business understanding through stakeholder engagement, field perspective, and ongoing learning about store and operational workflows

Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence

Title: Alpha Account Services Data Analyst, Officer
Description:
Who We Are Looking For

The Alpha Strategy and Implementation Services Team at State Street is seeking a qualified Account Services Data Analyst to support client account onboarding, maintenance, and configuration activities across the Alpha Platform. This role is focused on collecting and validating client account reference data, supporting system configuration, and applying data controls that help enable accurate, timely, and consistent account setup across front-, middle-, and back-office services.

Key Responsibilities


Support the collection, review, and organization of client account data required for new account launches, lifecycle events, and static data maintenance.
Assist with account data validation, enrichment, and control activities to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and required client or internal follow-up om the Account Matrix/Conversion Data.
Support system configuration activities across Account Services workflow tools and downstream Alpha applications based on approved client account data.
Partner with clients, implementation leads, data leads, product, technology, and downstream operations teams to resolve data issues and support readiness for testing, conversion, and production use.



Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen, implementation teams are needed to help clients navigate employees and the organization as a whole during their initial onboarding. In your role you will strive for cutting-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best.

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As an Alpha Account Services Data Analyst, Officer you will


Collect, organize, and analyze client account data required to support client conversions.
Review client-provided data for completeness, consistency, and alignment to Account Services data requirements, templates, and agreed operating models.
Maintain and update client account data artifacts account setup data dictionaries, configuration trackers, validation logs, and related implementation documentation.
Support configuration of account attributes, dropdown values, lookups, business rules, checklist items, and other client-specific settings within Account Services workflow and administration tools.
Perform data profiling, reconciliation, and validation exercises to confirm that account data is accurately reflected across Account Services tools and downstream Alpha systems.
Investigate data exceptions, configuration breaks, and validation failures; document root cause, proposed resolution, ownership, and status through closure.
Partner with implementation leads, project managers, product owners, technology teams, and downstream service teams to clarify data requirements and resolve configuration dependencies.
Support testing cycles by preparing test data, reviewing expected results, validating configuration outcomes, and documenting defects or required remediation.
Apply data controls to ensure accurate, complete, and timely account setup, maintenance, and conversion activity.
Document field-level definitions, population rules, required values, impacted workstreams, and downstream usage to support consistent data interpretation.
Monitor configuration readiness, data quality issues, and open action items; escalate blockers that may impact testing, conversion, or production timelines.
Support post-go-live remediation and change activity by analyzing data impacts, validating updates, and coordinating with relevant stakeholders.
Contribute to reusable standards, templates, control checks, and best practices that improve the consistency and scalability of Account Services implementations.



What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role


Strong analytical skills with the ability to review large sets of data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
Experience supporting data collection, data validation, system configuration, testing, and operational readiness within financial services or investment operations.
Working knowledge of Python, SQL, Excel, data profiling, reconciliation techniques, and reporting tools used to support data analysis and control activities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate data issues into clear actions for clients, implementation teams, technology partners, and operations stakeholders.



Education & Preferred Qualifications

Title: Founding Data Analyst
Description:
About Counsel

Counsel’s mission is to multiply the world's healthcare capacity. We believe in a future in which every person has a personalized, AI-enabled doctor always in their pocket. To accomplish this, we’re building the first fully-vertical, AI-native medical group from the ground up. We’ve redesigned the entire clinical stack with custom AI tools that make our in-house physicians 10x faster and smarter. [learn more on our blog]

Since our founding in 2023, we have formed partnerships with leading healthcare organizations and are on track to serve hundreds of thousands of patients on our platform within the next year. We have raised over $35M from a16z, Google Ventures, Pear VC and other top-tier VC firms.

Our team combines deep expertise in medicine (Harvard, Mt. Sinai, Mass General, UCSF) and technology (MIT, Google, DeepMind, NVIDIA, Stripe, Meta) — and we’re looking for exceptional people to join us as we scale.

Join us as we build the future of AI in healthcare!

About The Role

We're hiring a Founding Data Analyst to join our FinOps team and build the data foundation that powers Counsel's growth. This is an early-stage, high-impact founding role spanning data wrangling and pipeline development, defining and tracking core operating metrics, and improving reporting and operational workflows across the business.

You'll work directly with our SVP, Finance & Operations and collaborate across Commercial/GTM, Finance, Clinical Ops, and Operations. Instead of owning a small slice of the business, you'll gain broad exposure and take on increasing responsibility as you help build and improve the systems that keep the company running and scaling. This role will have executive level cross functional partnership and requires the ability to connect dots across stakeholders in various organizations.

What You'll Do


Build and maintain the data foundation that will power the entire company.
Support the data needs of stakeholders across every function at the company. This will range from product metrics, commercial / client reporting, internal financial and operating metrics.
Build the Operating Scorecard and management dashboards so the entire team can have visibility on business performance and one source of truth.
Partner with Analytics Engineer to validate pipelines and metric definitions.
Turn messy datasets into answers people can act on.
Build and adopt AI-powered tools and workflows that make FinOps faster and efficient.


What You'll Bring


Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (CS, statistics, applied math, or similar), with meaningful programming experience
3-5 years in a data, analytics, or finance/ops role
Strong SQL, and Python or a similar language to be dangerous
Comfort with data that's messy and real, the kind you dig into instead of flagging as someone else's problem. An inherent desire to be a truth seeker
Executive presence to represent senior leaders in cross functional discussions
Genuinely curious about AI tools, and quick to find ways they can cut manual work out of your own workflow


Bonus points for


Experience with dbt, Airflow, Snowflake, or BigQuery
Experience in healthcare or healthtech
A track record of ramping quickly into new tools, since many of ours are still being built


What We Offer


Impact: Be at the forefront and contribute to groundbreaking, AI-driven healthcare experiences, directly interface with execs at the world's leading tech & healthcare orgs
Growth: Significant opportunities for broad ownership and professional development within our rapidly scaling startup
Compensation: Competitive salary + equity
Benefits: Comprehensive healthcare, vision + dental, 401K, Unlimited PTO, Parental Leave


Our Values


Patients come first. We are clinicians 1st, technologists 2nd. We act with patient trust/safety at the center of every decision.
Innovate with optimism. We are optimistic as we build the future of care delivery from first principles. Challenge the status quo when needed, no sacred cows.
Right answer wins. Debate openly and pick the strongest path. We optimize for the company, not functions. We win and lose as a team.
Simplicity over complexity. We choose clear, elegant solutions and avoid adding complexity that does not serve patients or the team.
Do fewer things, well. We focus, and hold ourselves to the highest bar and pursue excellence in those areas.

We will never ask for payment or financial information during the interview process. If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from Counsel Health, please contact us at careers@counselhealth.com.

Counsel Health participates in E-Verify. All newly hired employees are processed through the E-Verify system to confirm employment eligibility.

Compensation Range: $150K - $175K

Opportunity Overview

Teradyne is seeking a Data Governance Analyst to design, implement, and scale data governance capabilities across enterprise data domains including Customer, Supplier, and Product data. Lead the implementation and operationalization of enterprise data governance standards, policies, and controls across core data domains.
Develop data quality checks, validation rules, monitoring frameworks, technical metadata, business glossaries, and lineage documentation.
Collaborate with Data Owners, Stewards, architects, engineers, and application teams to define business rules, critical data elements, and ownership models.
Build and configure data governance, data quality, and catalog tools while integrating governance capabilities into data pipelines, ERP systems, and analytics platforms.
Support root cause analysis, remediation of data quality issues, governance onboarding, training, and adoption for stewards and technical teams.
Partner with cross-functional teams to continuously improve Teradyne’s data governance operating model and proactively identify governance and data quality risks.


All About You

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.


5+ years of professional experience in data governance, data quality, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related data role.
Working knowledge of data governance concepts such as data ownership and stewardship, business glossaries and metadata management, and data quality dimensions and controls.
Hands-on experience with SQL, relational databases, data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical governance solutions.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to identify and resolve data quality issues across source systems and downstream platforms.
Experience with data governance, data quality, or catalog tools such as Informatica, Collibra, Alation, Atlan, or similar platforms.
Exposure to ERP systems such as Oracle and master data domains.
Experience supporting analytics, reporting, or AI/ML use cases.
Familiarity with data privacy and compliance concepts such as GDPR and SOX.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work closely with data owners, stewards, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders.
Ability to support training, onboarding, mentorship, and adoption for stewards and technical teams.

Description:
Description

From weddings and celebrations to corporate gatherings and major sporting productions, our team works behind the scenes to bring events to life. We take pride in delivering exceptional experiences, embracing creativity, and making every event run seamlessly. We believe extraordinary events start with extraordinary people. If you take pride in your work, enjoy collaborating with a supportive team, and want to be part of something bigger, you’ll feel at home here.

About The Job

We are seeking a detail-oriented and commercially minded Rental Asset Analyst to support the performance, utilization, profitability, and reporting of our rental asset portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who is highly skilled in Microsoft Excel, comfortable working with large and complex datasets, and experienced using AI-enabled tools to accelerate analysis, identify trends, and generate actionable insights.

The Rental Asset Analyst will partner with operations, finance, sales, and asset management teams to improve portfolio visibility, optimize asset deployment, monitor rental performance, and support data-driven decision-making across the business.

What You’ll Do


Analyze rental asset utilization, availability, downtime, revenue, margin, repair costs, and lifecycle performance across the portfolio.
Build, maintain, and improve Excel-based reporting models, dashboards, trackers, and performance summaries.
Work with large datasets from ERP, rental management, finance, CRM, telematics, or other operational systems to identify trends, exceptions, and improvement opportunities.
Use AI tools and data-analysis platforms to clean, classify, summarize, and interpret large volumes of rental asset data efficiently and accurately.
Support monthly and quarterly reporting on portfolio performance, asset returns, underutilized equipment, revenue leakage, and capital allocation.
Develop insights that help improve rental pricing, portfolio mix, asset redeployment, maintenance planning, and investment decisions.
Partner with operations and finance teams to investigate variances, reconcile data, validate assumptions, and ensure reporting accuracy.
Create ad hoc analyses for leadership, including asset profitability, customer rental behavior, geographic demand, replacement timing, and disposal recommendations.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports, streamline manual processes, and improve data quality.
Present findings clearly to stakeholders, translating complex analysis into practical business recommendations.


Success in This Role Looks Like

The successful Rental Asset Analyst will help the business make faster, better-informed decisions about asset deployment, utilization, pricing, maintenance, replacement, and investment. They will improve reporting reliability, reduce manual effort through automation and AI-assisted analysis, and provide clear recommendations that support stronger portfolio performance and profitability.

What Makes Us Special

Compensation and Benefits


Competitive pay + monthly bonus opportunity
Paid time off and company holidays
Comprehensive benefits package including:
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
Company-Paid Basic Life and AD&D Insurance
Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
Telehealth and Wellness programs
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
Employee Assistance Program
401(k) with employer matching

Our Culture & Work


A team that has your back: We work across sales, warehouse, logistics, and operations to make every event successful. When challenges come up, our teams step in and support each other.
Work that creates real moments: Every event represents something meaningful—a wedding, a celebration, a milestone, or a major gathering. Our work helps create experiences people remember for years.
Pride in craft and reliability: We deliver consistently and professionally. Our team cares about the details, the quality of our products, and the experience we provide.
Opportunities to grow: As we continue to expand, we invest in development, training, and career growth across roles, departments, and locations.
Innovation and creativity: We encourage fresh ideas and empower our teams to find new ways to deliver exceptional events.
Fun with impact: We work hard, support each other, and take pride in being part of something meaningful.


Requirements

What You Bring


Advanced Microsoft Excel capability, including pivot tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, complex formulas, data validation, scenario analysis, and dashboard creation.
Strong ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, validate data integrity, and draw commercially useful conclusions.
Hands-on experience using AI tools to assist with data cleaning, summarization, anomaly detection, forecasting, reporting, or productivity improvement.
Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working with operational, financial, rental, equipment, inventory, or asset management data.
Comfortable managing multiple priorities, meeting deadlines, and working independently in a fast-paced environment.
High level of curiosity, accountability, and willingness to improve processes and challenge existing reporting methods.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business analytics, economics, operations, supply chain, data analytics, or a related field preferred.
Two or more years of experience in an analyst role, preferably within rental equipment, asset management, portfolio operations, logistics, finance, construction equipment, industrial services, or a similar asset-intensive business.
Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, ERP systems, rental management software, CRM systems, or other business intelligence tools.
Understanding of rental asset economics, including utilization, yield, maintenance cost, depreciation, return on capital, and lifecycle value, is preferred but not required.
Highly analytical and comfortable working with imperfect or incomplete data.
Commercially aware, with the ability to connect data insights to business outcomes.
Proactive, organized, and able to take ownership of recurring reporting and improvement initiatives.
Collaborative and confident working with stakeholders across operations, finance, sales, and leadership.
Innovative mindset with a practical understanding of how AI tools can improve speed, accuracy, and insight generation.

Title: Product Data Scientist
Description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.

Ever wonder how much of a lift a new flavor gives us, or which flavor a specific machine should be pouring in a specific office at a specific moment? That's this role. We're looking for a Product Data Scientist to support both our Beverage and Software product teams — measuring the incremental impact of every new flavor we launch, and building the recommendation engine that decides what each machine should offer next. You'll also own analytics across our Bevi-proprietary digital experiences, including the UI and the Well, plus our other websites (get a quote, order more, technical support). You'll partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering on both teams, turning data into a clear point of view on what we build next. We're looking for someone who spots what needs to get built before being asked, and drives it to done rather than waiting for direction.

Your Day To Day


Own analytics for our Bevi-proprietary digital experiences, including the UI and the Well — consult with Software on tracking structure, and own the analysis that shows what's working and what's not to inform the product roadmap.
Own tracking and analytics for Bevi.co and Partner.co, including GA4 and tag management, to inform the product roadmap.
Recommend the right analytics tools for our web properties alongside GA4/GTM — session replay, self-serve data, testing, heatmaps — in partnership with Product.
Measure the incremental impact of new flavors, blending A/B testing with non-traditional methods where clean experiments aren't possible.
Build the flavor recommendation engine — models that identify the optimal flavor profile per machine (or cluster), within real constraints like weekly-max updates and required static options.
Translate data and analytics into clear insights and recommendations.
Build clear, informative dashboards and drive adoption to democratize product data.
Partner with data engineering and software teams on data quality, tagging, and instrumentation.


Who You Are


2-4 years of professional experience in product analytics, digital analytics, or data science.
Strong hands-on experience with GA4 and tag management (e.g., GTM) — comfortable owning both the tracking implementation and the analysis built on top of it.
Hands-on experience designing and analyzing experiments — A/B testing and non-traditional/quasi-experimental methods (e.g., pre/post, difference-in-differences, propensity score matching) for situations where clean randomization isn't possible.
Strong SQL and Python/R for querying, modeling, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, PowerBI, Hex).
You use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster (eg exploratory analysis, code, documentation), and think about how to make product data accessible to AI tools as well as people.
A proactive, go-getter mindset — you notice what needs to get built before you're asked, and drive your own work to completion without needing to be chased.
Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

Title: Lead GTM Data Operations Analyst
Description:
Why This Role, Why Now




GTM Data Strategy & Operations stood up from scratch with no predecessor. Today the function runs on three offshore contractors and zero FTEs, managed by a single leader who is simultaneously building the agentic infrastructure, operating it in production, and driving major initiatives (hierarchy redesign, data quality assessment, vendor optimization).




The operating model is deliberately agentic AI–first: a multi-agent pipeline (Cartographer, Sentinel, Resolver, Reporting) handles detection, enrichment, hierarchy mapping, and conflict resolution at scale. This is not a future-state vision, these agents are live and processing enterprise account families in production today.




The problem: one person cannot build, operate, and extend this system while also managing strategic workstreams. The function currently covers only core Tier‑1 fields. Dozens of account, contact, and lead signals remain unaddressed. Every pipeline run, every failure diagnosis, and every offshore handoff flows through a single point of failure.

This role is the first onshore execution hire for an agent operator who can keep the system running, improve it, and extend detection and resolution coverage as GTM leadership prioritizes new data elements.




Role Summary




Sit between AI systems and GTM data. Operate, tune, and extend our agentic data quality pipeline (detection, enrichment, hierarchy mapping, conflict resolution) so it runs reliably, improves continuously, and expands to cover more of the data landscape. Own the handoff between automated output and human review, managing quality and throughput with our offshore team. You don’t build agents from scratch, but you run them, evaluate their output with GTM data judgment, and make them better.




Core Responsibilities




Agent Pipeline Operations




Run and monitor production pipeline sessions (Cartographer, Sentinel, Resolver) across scheduled cadences; diagnose and resolve failures (API errors, session timeouts, data anomalies) without escalating to the function lead.
Execute pipeline runs in Claude Claude and tmux; manage long-running batch processes; interpret logs and output to confirm data integrity before downstream handoff.
Maintain pipeline orchestration scripts and configuration; extend agent coverage as new data elements are prioritized by GTM leadership.




Agent Tuning & Improvement




Refine detection rules, prompt logic, and confidence thresholds based on output analysis and false-positive/negative patterns.
Evaluate agent accuracy by segment (Enterprise vs. MM/SMB) and recommend rule or workflow changes backed by evidence.
Run bake-offs (vendor vs. AI enrichment) to optimize cost, coverage, and accuracy; document results for decision-making.




Sentinel → Offshore Resolution Loop




Own the handoff between Sentinel detection output and Concentrix triage queues; define queue structure, priority tiers, and resolution instructions.
Monitor offshore resolution quality and throughput; refine detection rules based on patterns surfaced through triage.
Close the feedback loop: track resolution outcomes back to agent configuration to reduce recurring false positives and improve detection precision.




Data Quality & Enrichment Operations




Maintain ops-only staging fields; manage the promote-to-production flow with audit controls.
Design and run AI-assisted enrichment workflows (Clay + LLM prompts) with evidence links and confidence thresholds.
Monitor fill-rate, sampled accuracy, freshness, and cost-per-record by source and segment; surface vendor performance issues and recommend changes.
Keep data dictionaries, SOPs, and runbooks current as agents and processes evolve.




Cross-Functional Partnership




GTM Systems (SFDC): field configuration, permission sets, automation, flows.
Data Engineering: source availability, ID mapping, lineage (no pipeline coding).
Reporting: define metrics and acceptance criteria; partner on dashboard requirements.




Qualifications




3–6 years in Data Ops, Sales Ops, or GTM Ops with hands-on data quality ownership for account and contact data.
Proficiency with Snowflake (SQL for querying, analysis, validation) and SFDC (object model, field configuration, data flows).
Working experience with Claude Code or comparable LLM-based tooling in an operational (not just experimental) context.
Experience designing and running AI-assisted enrichment workflows (e.g., Clay + LLM prompts) and evaluating accuracy/coverage.
Comfort operating in a command-line environment: tmux, shell scripts, log analysis, batch process monitoring.
Process design mindset with a bias toward measurable outcomes; strong written communication.




Strong Plus




Experience with account/contact data vendors (D&B, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, StoreLeads) and waterfall enrichment logic.
Python for QA scripting, sampling, or light automation.
Familiarity with prompt engineering, confidence scoring, and AI guardrails (evidence capture, versioned prompts, QA sampling gates).




Tool Stack




Core: Snowflake (SQL), SFDC, Claude Code, Clay
Pipeline: Shell orchestration, Cartographer / Sentinel / Resolver agents
Enrichment: D&B, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, StoreLeads, LLM prompts
Nice to Have: Python, SOQL, prompt engineering frameworks
AI Guardrails (Expected Practice): Confidence floors, evidence capture, versioned prompts, 10% QA sampling gates, audit-on-promote, drift alerts, and privacy/compliance checks. This role is expected to uphold and improve these practices, not just follow them.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements. The Firm will provide reasonable accommodations as necessary to allow an individual with a disability to apply for and/or perform the essential functions of a position. State Street Global Delivery Data Operations team is seeking a versatile individual in an Officer role with strong data analysis and deep technical skills to lead the support of services and offerings across Global Delivery. This leader will be expected to build relationships and collaborate with both business stakeholders and technology partnership order to contribute to the timely execution of long term strategic plans for building out sophisticated data solutions.

Why this job is important to us?

State Street Data Operations brings together data capabilities across the investment lifecycle to help our clients make better decisions, grow at scale, and deliver returns for their clients. The successful candidate must be skilled in analyzing our complex business service flows across front, middle, and back office operating models, with a focus on data management and delivery. They will also be driving the strategic solution design, business architecture, and business solutions/services while driving program/project execution and reporting.

Establish strong partnerships with internal stakeholders in Operations, Technology, Product and E2E architecture teams to influence and coordinate cross-functional business data solutions and products, in support of client and business goals.

Possess strong knowledge of front-to-back Investment management/Investment services with focus on user data requirements.

Assist with pricing strategies and product policies

Strong technical skills with a background in Accounting, Custody, and/or Performance

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.

Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity

Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale

Title: Technical Business Analyst (Reaching Home portfolio)
Description:
UNITED WAY BC IS PROUD TO BE RECOGNIZED AS ONE OF CANADA'S TOP 100 EMPLOYERS FOR 2026!












ABOUT US – WHY WE’RE HERE:




Across British Columbia, communities are facing urgent and complex social challenges. United Way BC is committed to delivering lasting, community-driven impact in partnership with diverse populations across the province including Indigenous communities whose territories we live and work on. From Vancouver Island to the Lower Mainland, and across the Thompson Nicola Cariboo, Southern Interior, Trail and District, and East Kootenay regions, we walk alongside communities to create meaningful and equitable change. 




Our mission is to strengthen vital connections that support people in need in our communities. 




Our vision is to create a healthy, caring and inclusive community. 




How do we deliver on our mission and vision – by delivering resources and support for those who need it most, and by living our values of being collaborative, compassionate, strategic, responsive, accountable, and inspiring. 




For a more in-depth to look into our work and programs, please visit: www.uwbc.ca.












ABOUT YOU:




As the Technical Business Analyst, you will have experience in business analysis, data analytics, and technical solution development, with a strong understanding of how data can be leveraged to inform decision-making and drive organizational impact. You have education and/or experience in areas such as business analysis, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, and are comfortable working across both technical and business domains.




You bring at least 3 years demonstrated experience in researching, organizing, analyzing, and presenting data to support strategic initiatives. You have strong skills in data analysis, reporting, and business process improvement, along with experience working with databases, BI tools, and data models. You are proficient in using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, and visualization platforms, and bring strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills. You have the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for a variety of audiences, and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities.












ABOUT THIS ROLE:




Reporting to the Manager, Business Intelligence and Data Governance, the Technical Business Analyst plays a key role in supporting United Way BC’s ability to leverage data to inform decision-making, strengthen community impact, and enhance organizational performance. This role will work primarily to support the Community Impact & Investment (CII) department, taking the lead on data-related priorities for multiple portfolios. This requires a deep understanding of United Way BC’s impact work and how data can be used to inform that work in a meaningful, community-centred way.




Working collaboratively with CII and other internal teams, the position develops and maintains reporting solutions, conducts analysis to identify trends and opportunities, and supports the development of data models and performance indicators. This position will require working closely with the direct supervisor, portfolio leads, and CII leadership to understand priorities, translate data and reporting requirements into practical solutions, and ensure reporting and analysis are aligned with impact objectives. The Technical Business Analyst also contributes to advancing data governance practices, improving workflows, and ensuring that staff are equipped with the tools and knowledge needed to effectively use data in their work.




* This is a regular full-time role with an end date of March 31, 2028, and may be subject to extension or early conclusion. The primary portfolio focus of this role is Reaching Home, and this position will report to the Manager, Business Intelligence and Data Governance.












Duties & RESPONSIBILITIES:




Key Responsibilities: Data and Reporting Solutions  





Develops, supports and manages reports and dashboards for monitoring key metrics including community impact and financial performance


Develops and implements organizational data models


Lead and/or participate in organizational initiatives related to research, reporting and analytics 





Key Responsibilities: Strategic Support and Analytics 





Conducts comprehensive analysis; highlighting key insights and recommendations on donor strategies, fundraising initiatives and impact strategy


Contributes to the development of operation strategies Including measurement, tracking, trends analysis, benchmarking and goal setting where applicable 


Educate and support staff to strengthen their data knowledge and facilitate effective communication and data usage





Key Responsibilities: Business Process Improvement





Support data governance practices and activities, contribute to development and maintenance of business glossary and data quality standards


Review methodologies, procedures and workflows to identify areas to improve operational efficiency 


Develops and manages process documentation 





General 





May participate in community engagement or fundraising activities 


Performs other duties related to the qualifications and requirements of the job 













QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:




Education:





Undergraduate degree focusing on Computer Science, Business, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent education/experience 





Experience:





Three (3) years' experience as a business, technical, data analyst or related role with experience in researching, organizing, analyzing and presenting data for management use 





Skills:





Proficiency in the use of databases, spreadsheets, project management tools at a moderately to highly complex level 


Advanced skills in data querying (SQL) and experience with associated BI Tools (PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) 


Experience with digital product development life cycles 


Knowledge of scripting or statistical languages (Python, R, etc.) is an asset 


Experience with any of the following is an asset, but not required; Advanced data analytics, Machine Learning, Predictive and/or statistical modelling 


Ability to use and interpret contact management databases 


Skilled in evaluating, developing and implementing processes and procedures to achieve objectives and use data effectively 


Ability to manage and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment by adapting and modifying sequence of work, methods, and standards to meet changing conditions 


Strong interpersonal skills to contribute to developing a successful team environment 


Strategic thinking with well-developed problem-solving skills 


Strong written and oral communication to communicate complex data to a variety of audiences 


Ability to exercise a high level of tact and discretion in both internal and external interactions is critical 













WORKING CONDITIONS:





Adaptable to schedule changes and outside of business hours to attend meetings and events 


Hybrid role with a minimum of three (3) days in the office





 




CHARACTERISTICS:




For success at UWBC and in this role, certain demonstrable characteristics will be required:





A commitment to building healthy, caring and inclusive communities, internally and externally 


Embodying the organization’s core values to be collaborative, compassionate, strategic, responsive, accountable and inspiring


Ability to navigate ambiguity and comfortably operate in it


Drive to succeed as an individual and as a team member













At UWBC, we don’t just accept difference - we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, programs, donors, and the communities we live and work in. At UWBC, we encourage all applicants regardless of age, sex, gender identity, colour, religion, sexual orientation, or any other basis to apply.




Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women, people of colour and indigenous people are less likely to apply to roles unless they meet every qualification. At UWBC, we are dedicated to Justice, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion, so if you are excited about this role, but your experience and qualifications are not perfectly aligned, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this, or other roles.




This is a bargaining unit role with CUPE Local 1760. This position is at Pay Grade 39, which is $92,310.40 annually, if you are within Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region and $88,615.80 annually, if you are outside Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region.




Candidates must live within 80 KMs (commuting distance) from any of our offices as this position is currently a hybrid role and office attendance is required.




Interested candidates are invited to apply by submitting a cover letter and resume to job competition C-2026-26.




We kindly ask for no phone calls, please. Due to the high number of applications UWBC receive, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. We thank all applicants for their interest in UWBC.

Title: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist
Description:
POSITION TITLE: Financial Database & Analytics Specialist

DEPARTMENT: Finance, Administration & Information Technology

CLASSIFICATION: MGO-07

SALARY RANGE: Starting at $79,591.00 Per Annum

POSITION TYPE: Full-time, Permanent

LOCATION: Saskatoon

ACCOUNTABLE TO : Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT

Brief Overview

The Financial Database & Analytics Specialist is responsible for the profiling, development, integration, and optimization of enterprise databases and reporting solutions that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, performance measurement, and operational analysis. This position serves as the government's technical specialist in database profiling, data availability, systems integration, business intelligence, and analytical reporting, helping transform data from multiple systems into reliable information for decision-making across government.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Compliance, Governance & Risk Management


Profiles, develop, maintains, and optimizes enterprise databases, data models, and reporting structures that support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, government reporting, operational analysis, and performance measurement.
Supports the integration of data across finance, payroll, human resource, procurement, project management, funding agreement, and other government systems.


Financial Analysis & Decision Support


Provides technical and analytical support for budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, funding agreement reporting, trend analysis, key performance indicators, and executive reporting.
Works closely with Finance to ensure reliable information is available to support financial planning, resource allocation, reporting obligations, and decision-making.


Enterprise Reporting & Business Intelligence


Develops and maintains reports, dashboards, data extracts, automated reporting solutions, and analytical models that support government-wide reporting requirements.
Translate business requirements into practical database structures, queries, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions that improve accessibility and use of information while maintaining data security, privacy protection standards.


Data Quality, Automation & Continuous Improvement


Improves the accuracy, consistency, reliability, and accessibility of enterprise data used for financial and operational reporting.
Identifies opportunities to streamline reporting processes, automate recurring reporting requirements, reduce manual effort, and improve the efficiency of data collection and analysis activities across government.


Technical Documentation, Collaboration & Advisory Support


Develops and maintains technical documentation related to databases, data models, data flows, and system integrations.
Works collaboratively with ministries, departments, program areas, internal consulting teams, external consulting teams, Information Technology, and system vendors to assess data availability, recommend appropriate data structures and classifications, and support reporting and analytical requirements.
Other duties as assigned by the Acting Deputy Chief, Finance, Administration & IT


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong proficiency in SQL, data extraction, transformation, and reporting development.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the ability to translate reporting requirements into technical solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power Query, and financial data analysis tools.
Ability to assess data availability, relationships, and appropriate categorization across multiple systems.
Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
Understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, performance measurement, and government reporting environments.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Economics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3-5 years progressive financial analysis, database development or relevant experience.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SSRS, or equivalent.
An equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, and progressively responsible experience may be considered


Additional Requirements


Must undergo a Criminal Record Check
Valid Saskatchewan driver’s license and access reliable transportation
Please submit your application by 9:59 PM on August 27, 2026.


Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
